title: Architect II
jobDescription:
Overview

Our teams take great pride in delivering some of the world's most prestigious projects. This success is driven by our talented people, whose diverse perspectives, expertise, and knowledge set us apart. Join us and you'll be part of our genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone is supported to make the most of their talents and expertise.

Your role

  • Understands design requirements and has knowledge of associated consultants/contractors and their level of involvement in the project.
  • Notifies senior team members of design requirements and highlights risks and early warnings.
  • Aware of a range of materials and suppliers as required.
  • Capable of checking drawings and understanding applicable standards and documentation.
  • Assists senior team members in ensuring compliance.
  • Actively involved in project administration processes, including:
    • Scope analysis
    • Time estimation
    • Technical design development
    • Identifying early risks and warnings
    • Preparing feasibility studies to support the technical lead
  • Ability to refer to applicable approved documents and regulations to verify compliance with guidelines and norms.
  • Understands project specifications and maintains professional relationships with team members and stakeholders.
  • Continues to develop project administration knowledge through ongoing project work.
  • Awareness of local planning authority procedures.
  • Assists senior team members in preparing feasibility studies and documentation.
  • Supports development of concept design options under senior supervision.
  • Assists in estimating hours per drawing and participates in project setup meetings (including preparing minutes).
  • Produces area/accommodation schedules and continues to build project administration expertise.

About you

  • Revit:
    • Assists in setting up multidisciplinary models and managing worksets.
    • Performs clash detection within and across disciplines.
    • Uses massing tools for concept and scheme design.
    • Applies design options to test multiple design solutions simultaneously.
    • Creates parametric families to enhance flexibility.
    • Links drawings to specifications using keynoting.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk tools (certification preferred).
  • Basic knowledge of Navisworks and awareness of Dynamo.
  • Awareness of Auto CAD, Sketch Up, Photoshop, In Design, and Enscape is preferred.

Architecture, Construction & Technology

  • Able to read and interpret client mark-ups and address them accurately without supervision.
  • Prepares clear mark-ups for revision by team members or junior staff and reviews mark-ups completed by junior team members.
  • Good understanding of construction sequences and the use of various building elements.
  • Familiar with technical terminology related to building components.
  • Competent in understanding requirements of other disciplines and supporting senior staff.
  • Continues to develop knowledge of drawing information through project progression.
  • Possesses good knowledge of materials and their applications in construction.
  • Takes initiative to research materials and demonstrates enthusiasm to learn under minimal supervision.
  • Continues to develop material knowledge throughout project work.

General

  • Strong ability to read and understand drawings, including orientation and information content.
  • Competent in producing detailed drawings with minimal supervision.
  • Able to annotate drawings with appropriate notes and specification clauses.
  • Provides mark-ups and comments for junior team members.
  • Participates in regular coordination discussions with internal teams and other disciplines.
  • Clear knowledge of different packages and their applications.
  • Capable of interrogating information and producing drawings independently with minimal guidance or mark-ups from seniors.
  • Able to identify and highlight discrepancies.
  • Possesses knowledge of package detailing and buildability.
  • Capable of developing sketches for junior team members.
  • Takes initiative in researching products and gathering information from manufacturers and consultants.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

We're Atkins Réalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Find out more.

title: BIM Engineer - Infrastructure Civil 3D / Water
jobDescription:
Overview

Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.

We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecycle—from concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.

Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore & Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.

Your role

Key Responsibilities

  • Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks, Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
  • Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
  • Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
  • Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
  • Stay informed the best practices & methodologies in BIM implementation.
  • Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
  • Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
  • Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
  • Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
  • In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers' calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
  • Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
  • Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
  • Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
  • Use of Vehicle tracking

Software Skills

  • Autodesk Civil 3D
  • Auto CAD
  • Micro Station / Open Roads
  • BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud
  • Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
  • Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
  • Good communication and coordination skills
  • Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

About You

Qualification

  • Graduate Engineers (Bachelor's degree) with up to 3 years or Diploma in Engineering with up to 7 years of relevant experience in the BIM domain or duly qualified having exceptional work experience track record

Desirable Experience

  • Canada infrastructure or consultancy project experience
  • Experience working within ISO 19650 BIM environment
  • Awareness of Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows

Rewards & Benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

title: BIM Designer - Revit & ISO 19650
jobDescription:
Overview

Atkins Réalis Business is hiring an experienced Junior Information Manager for our BIM Digital Engineering team. This person will be carrying out a mix of functions that span from internal process improvements to supporting construction project delivery supervision. The successful candidate should be a people, process and technology focused individual whose main duty will be to ensure that the project delivery team(s) adhere to agreed standards and best industry methodologies. The candidate will also actively support project teams on proposal/bids and project delivery tasks.

Your Role

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate the client EIR, project scope and delivery schedule.
  • Collaborate with clients to define digital delivery strategy for the project.
  • Create and maintain the BIM Execution Plan for projects.
  • Establish and manage Common Data Environment to support collaboration between all project stakeholders.
  • Setup models for individual disciplines and for federation.
  • Provide guidance and training to the delivery team.
  • Establish and configure clash detection process and conduct design co-ordination meetings.
  • Define processes for QA/QC of models and check compliance of models to client requirements.
  • Interact with clients and external stakeholders to manage delivery.
  • Setup dashboards and analytics to enable data driven delivery.
  • Support project leadership in tracking delivery progress and identifying potential risks to delivery.
  • Supports the deployment of innovative processes, tools, and methodologies.
  • Ensure project delivery in compliance with ISO19650 by performing regular audits across the project lifecycle.
  • Mentor junior personnel to take on the role of an Information Manager.

Skills

  • A good understanding of the data, information management including compliance to ISO 19650 standards.
  • Sound knowledge in engineering design and in assisting engineering disciplines in with Self/Inter and Multi-disciplinary design coordination and quality compliance.
  • Proficient knowledge of model federation and design co-ordination platforms such as Navisworks, BIM Track or Revizto for performing tasks like clash management, model walkthroughs, issue tracking and management.
  • Proficient knowledge of Common Data Environment (CDE) such as ACC, BIM360, ASITE or Project Wise.
  • A grounded understanding of construction quality processes.

About You

Experience & Knowledge

  • Minimum of 2 Years' experience in managing Multi-Disciplinary Co-ordination in large projects with geographically dispersed teams and digital delivery of complex, multidisciplinary projects (Information Management/BIM).
  • Comprehensive knowledge of ISO 19650 framework and related BIM standards
  • Experience in reviewing client EIRs and authoring BEPs.
  • Experience in creating client EIRs is preferred.

Educational Qualifications.

  • Bachelor's/master's degree in civil engineering and 5+ years' experience in AEC industry, minimum 2 years' experience in international projects.
  • Information Management (ISO19650) certification by a relevant institution e.g. BRE, Operam Academy, RICS etc is desirable.
  • Certification in BIM Tools and Processes would be an added advantage.

Software Skill

  • Expertise in setting up and managing projects on BIM360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud or Project Wise.
  • Expertise in Navisworks clash detection and multi-disciplinary co-ordination.
  • Expertise in one of more of the following BIM Authoring Tools – Revit, Civil3D, Plant 3D, Bentley Open Suite.
  • Knowledge of Power BI or other data visualization tools would be an added advantage.
  • Knowledge of automation tools such as Dynamo / Microsoft Power Automate would be an added advantage.

Rewards & Benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

title: Proposal Lead /Bid Manager-(Walk In Interview -08-August 2026-Bangalore)
jobDescription:
Overview

You will be working closely with regional win work/technical leads and business development & the engagement team across Atkins Réalis and the wider organisation to produce compelling bids. As a member of the central Bid Management team, you will also be responsible for contributing to the continuous improvement of the win-work capability (people, processes, tools, information, and governance). You will report to the Proposal Managers (Canada) and Win Work Team lead (GTC)

Your role

  • Lead the development and application of proposal/bid themes. Develop organization chart with the pursuit team.
  • Coordinate communication between SMEs and proposal writers. Lead teams through strategic reviews as per internal schedule.
  • Exercise considerable initiative and independent judgment about content, wording, completeness, correctness, and appropriateness of proposal contents and graphics materials, making recommendations directly to pursuit team.
  • Supervise marketing assistants and/or less experienced proposal coordinators. Give work directions to graphic artists and marketing assistants involved in proposal production.
  • Experience managing teams to deliver by established deadlines.
  • Ensuring that the proposal is run in accordance with best practice and the win work capture plan and pursuit process, and in compliance with the Service Delivery Process.
  • Provide client service, commitment, communication, innovation & continuous improvement, professionalism, quality and teamwork. (Note that "Clients" may be internal managers and staff.)
  • Added advantage if you have experience in capture planning
  • Implement and facilitate capture planning process
  • Facilitate kick off workshops and Go/No Go call
  • Facilitate win theme sessions and supporting strategies
  • Initiate and drive Go No Go calls and risk cat tool
  • Portal Management (CRM tools) and Review procurement documents and attachments.
  • Create and maintain a Proposal Management Plan.
  • Develop compliance matrix, Storyboard templates and allocate bid deliverables.
  • Review / approve response for standard prequalification questions.
  • Check PQQ responses from JV partners (if applicable).
  • Graphics co-ordination, (colour schemes; word templates; document covers and dividers; images / photos; graphics / charts / graphs (where applicable) and Graphics approval in accordance with company's Branding Guidelines.
  • Work involves knowledgeable application of quality control as well as standard procedures and criteria to the coordination of proposals which are of critical importance to the firm.
  • Assist in the development of preparation for Stage-gate reviews – and facilitate bid go/no-go decision.
  • Support development of CVs.
  • Work with the Business Development team to schedule & co-ordinate communications activities necessary to identify customer issues, hot buttons and the associated win themes and win strategy statements. Occasionally contact upper management for required signatures.
  • Support the production of case studies / evidence scenarios.
  • Coordinate with support services (legal, accounting, HR) on administrative sections of the pursuits (e.g., forms, statistics).
  • Take constructive feedback and apply it to enhance the delivery.

Submission

  • Final quality review of documents, post-formatting and after Bid Coordinator proofread /sense check.
  • Final proofread / compliance check of tender documents.
  • Close-out actions with JV partners (if required).
  • Client Presentation, Negotiate & Contract, Feedback, Handover
  • Lead, review, approve and disseminate Lessons Learnt feedback – Proposal Lead to lead the session with support from the Bid Co-ordinator.
  • Support response to Client Queries.
  • Support preparation for client interviews / presentations.

About you

  • Have 5-10 years (A/E/C industry)
  • Have experience leading pursuit responses – the larger and complex ones.
  • Understanding of Architectural-Engineering and project and construction management industry standards and disciplines. Can translate abstract ideas or narrative text into graphical concepts to illustrate concepts more effectively.
  • Works independently yet functions effectively as a member of a team.
  • Promote and demonstrate team values and behaviours in line with the win work team practices
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Relationship building
  • Ability to multi-task and manage several projects at once
  • Attention to detail
  • Collaborative approach
  • Time management skills
  • Enthusiastic, initiative and the confidence to start things from scratch
  • Confident using digital tools and learning new ones
  • Promote the use of Atkins Réalis work winning processes and tools
  • Instill a culture where others share knowledge, insights and learning

Specific skills required

  • A strong communicator with strong grammar, spelling, composition, and proofreading abilities.
  • Able to evaluate, monitor and present ideas and data.
  • Analytical with solid organisational skills, scheduling and prioritising activities.
  • A flexible but methodical approach to supporting bids.
  • Computer skills required and proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Creative Suite, CRM, and other software programmes including LLMs.

title: Lead Urban Drainage Modeller
jobDescription:
Overview

We are seeking talented individuals for our Water Team to work on diverse sewerage projects that deliver sustainable benefits to communities and the environment. This role involves hydraulic modelling (1D-2D) and engineering aspects of wastewater projects.

Your role

  • Perform hydraulic modelling (1D-2D), model verification, evaluation, feasibility studies, optioneering, and outline design of solutions.
  • Understand engineering constraints and opportunities to ensure realistic model outputs.
  • Develop automation tools to deliver high-quality work efficiently.
  • Maintain high standards through self-check methods and documentation.
  • Assist with project management and client relationship management.

title: Lead Architect
jobDescription:
Job Description

Overview

Atkins Réalis India is expanding its architectural team to support a wide range of multidisciplinary projects, including UK-based infrastructure and buildings commissions. As a Lead Architect, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering high-quality architectural solutions, leading coordination across disciplines, supporting technical excellence, and contributing to a well-integrated team that delivers world-class projects globally.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead architectural design development and coordination across disciplines including MEP, structural, landscape, and specialist sub-consultants.
  • Deliver coordinated design packages aligned with project requirements, global standards, quality benchmarks, and agreed programme expectations.
  • Interpret business, client, and project requirements to recommend appropriate technical solutions and challenge existing ways of working where improvement is possible.
  • Collaborate effectively with remote, cross-functional, and lead office teams to support integrated delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Support tender documentation, feasibility studies, design options, site-related queries, and project administration activities as required.
  • Contribute to stakeholder engagement, client presentations, team coordination meetings, scope reviews, time estimates, and early identification of design risks or warnings.
  • Mentor junior team members by preparing clear mark-ups, reviewing outputs, developing sketches, and supporting capability development within the practice.

Technical & Delivery Capability

  • Strong architectural design and delivery experience within infrastructure, buildings, or multidisciplinary project environments.
  • Hands-on ability to independently develop early-stage design proposals, using relevant BIM, visualisation, and presentation software to test options, communicate ideas, and support design decision-making.
  • Advanced understanding of drawing information, drawing orientation, annotation, specification notes, approved documents, regulations, and design compliance requirements.
  • Ability to execute instructions and client mark-ups independently, produce coordinated drawing information, identify discrepancies, and check outputs prepared by junior team members.
  • Full understanding of RIBA Stages of Work, interdisciplinary coordination, consultant scopes, and the integration of discipline packages within project delivery.
  • Good knowledge of construction sequence, buildability, technical terminology, materials, suppliers, and product research to support design development and decision-making.
  • Ability to work independently, lead functional teams when required, and maintain effective professional relationships with project teams, consultants, and stakeholders.

Project Tools

  • Advanced Revit capability, including multidisciplinary model setup, workset management, clash coordination, design options, massing tools, parametric families, and keynoting workflows.
  • Proficiency in BIM and coordination tools such as Navisworks, Auto CAD, and Autodesk platforms; Autodesk certification preferred.
  • Awareness of Dynamo, Sketch Up, Photoshop, In Design, Illustrator, Enscape, and other visualisation or presentation tools.
  • Experience in AECOsim/Open Buildings Designer and Micro Station is advantageous, particularly for infrastructure or multidisciplinary design environments.
  • Ability to use Power Point, In Design, Illustrator, rendering tools, and other presentation software to communicate design ideas clearly with lead office and client teams.
  • Awareness of sustainability frameworks such as LEED and a willingness to enhance skills in emerging technologies and digital tools.

Qualifications & Experience

  • B.Arch. or M.Arch. qualification with 10+ years of relevant architectural design and delivery experience.
  • Established track record of delivering work to agreed time, quality, and technical requirements.
  • Maturity and professional confidence to represent the GDC in LPO forums under appropriate supervision.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, coordination, and team leadership skills.

title: Mechanical Engineer, Grade 10
jobDescription:
Overview

Atkins Réalis is a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization, dedicated to engineering a better future for our planet and its people. Degree-qualified with a mechanical engineering. You will have Middle East (ME)/ UK water/wastewater industry experience with a minimum of 7-10 years of experience. A developing external profile and reputation; a desire and willingness to raise the profile of oneself and the Company. Willingness to contribute to and develop our technical knowledge networks.

Your role

  • Technically competent and ability to use engineering judgement independently to determine solutions
  • Prepare Technical Reports of acceptable technical quality with minimum guidance.
  • Apply new ideas/digital ideas to improve solutions and processes to improve efficiency.
  • Receive on-the-job technical training through performing tasks with minimum supervision.
  • Good knowledge of work procedures and ensure work adheres to procedures.
  • Responsible for completion of specifically assigned tasks to time and cost.
  • Able to work as a reliable and proactive member of the team, able to apply knowledge gained.
  • Able to work on several projects, and to communicate clearly with a range of people, including making presentations. Flexible and enthusiastic; team player.
  • Conversant with MS Office tools.
  • Experience of working on Middle East is must and desirable if he has worked on UK, and USA.
  • Opportunity to present your project work at company meetings.
  • A sound understanding of mechanical engineering principles and their application in Water, Wastewater treatment plant processes, and pumping stations.
  • Experience in the production of design documentation including optioneering reports and specifications of mechanical equipment.
  • Experience in producing design calculations of mechanical equipment for Water and Wastewater treatment plants.
  • Familiar with working to design national and international codes and industry standards appropriate for the Water and Wastewater industry.
  • Ability to produce hydraulic calculations for mechanical equipment, equipment datasheets/specifications, and schedules.

title: Senior Transport Planner
jobDescription:
Overview

Be at the forefront of strategic transport planning and modelling. As a Senior Transport Planner, you will help deliver transformational projects worldwide, from strategic model development and local plan assessments to supporting major development and master planning initiatives, enabling sustainable and future-ready transport networks.

Your role

You will contribute to the delivery of strategic transport modelling projects across global markets, supporting the development of evidence-based solutions that inform planning and investment decisions. This role offers the opportunity to work on a diverse portfolio of projects, including strategic transport model development, local plan modelling, development impact assessments and concept master planning support. Working closely with strategic modelling teams across the world, you will help to develop, maintain, and enhance transport models that support sustainable growth, mobility planning, and infrastructure development.

About you

Essential Requirements

  • Appropriate academic and professional qualifications (Bachelor's Degree with Master's degree in transport planning / economics)
  • Working experience (7+ years) in Transport Planning software like VISUM, SATURN, DIADEM, EMME.
  • Experience and knowledge of Strategic Modelling techniques and guidance.
  • Knowledge and experience in delivering transport planning/modelling projects for UK/ME/ USA/ Canada/ Australia regions
  • Strong Analytical skills with experience in handling and interpreting complex datasets
  • Experience in scripting using like Python, Excel-VBA and R.
  • Strong understanding of Arc GIS/QGIS, Power BI and Microsoft Office applications
  • Ability to work in a team as part of a wider project with minimal supervision.
  • Experience in leading smaller teams as part of a project delivery
  • Good written communication skills.

Desirable requirements

  • Be highly self-motivated and ambitious.
  • Be able to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers.
  • Be able to build excellent working relationships with colleagues and clients.
  • Experience in the use of analytical and research tools such as GIS and the use of databases
  • Appreciation of the transport industry and related policy context
  • Professional membership of a relevant institution.

title: BIM Engineer/BIM Coordinator
jobDescription:
Overview

Our Transmission & Distribution (T&D) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. We support integration of renewables, digital engineering, and global compliance standards to ensure reliable and sustainable energy delivery.The BIM team drives digital transformation by creating accurate 3D models, enabling clash detection, and supporting Scan-to-BIM workflows. Opportunities include advanced modelling, project coordination, automation using tools like Dynamo and collaboration on global projects—ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and multidisciplinary design.

Your role

  • Works alongside the Design/BIM manager to integrate outcomes and link information delivery with design delivery.
  • Works with Clients teams to help facilitate the set up and delivery of programme in accordance with their EIR (if they have one), if no EIR is present and BIM level 2 is mandated- the IM works with Client to advise on key elements of the EIR, however the BEP becomes the effective EIR.
  • Sets out the information exchange protocols, focussing on interoperability, programme, QA, frequency, purpose of exchange.
  • Ensures information management processes (ISO19650) and collaborative behaviours are fully embraced across the project
  • Works with the project team to embed the ethos of BIM delivery.
  • Brings to life the interdependencies of information in design delivery and embodies the contractual deliverables through a structured Master Information Delivery Plan (not just a MODEL information delivery plan)
  • Enforce the Project BIM standards for all disciplines and put in place suitable QAQC governance
  • Work with the document control and design team to ensure delivery of the information requirements is in line with BEP
  • Work with external parties involved in project delivery to ensure information exchange between all parties is planned, structured, and well managed
  • Maintains the model register and ensure information creation by any party is planned and communicated.

About you

Requirements

  • Must have an engineering or architecture background
  • Hands on experience of delivering multi-discipline projects
  • Ideally have experience / awareness of BIM software's, primarily Revit, Navisworks, Revizto, Auto CAD, Microstation, Dynamo and other BIM-related tools.
  • Ideally have experience with developing digital processes and workflows to support project delivery
  • Must be well versed in international BIM standards, primarily ISO19650.

Qualifications & Attributes

  • Excellent time management skills.
  • Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering / Architecture with minimum 10 years' experience in design coordination between multiple disciplines.
  • Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation
  • Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues
  • Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment
  • Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers
  • Highly IT literate with excellent command of standard BIM and office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware
  • Highly process based thinker

title: Plant 3D Modelling
jobDescription:
Overview

Atkins Réalis is seeking a Plant 3D Piping & P&ID Designer to join our Global Technology Centre (GTC) in Mumbai. The Plant 3D Piping & P&ID Designer is responsible for developing accurate 3D piping models, layouts, P&IDs, and related engineering deliverables using Autodesk Plant 3D in support of multidisciplinary projects across Industrial Plants, Minerals & Metals, Conventional & Renewable Power, and Nuclear facilities. The role involves routing piping with consideration for process flow, equipment access, maintenance, safety, constructability, and future expansion while incorporating sector‑specific constraints such as high‑volume utilities, abrasive slurry services, high‑pressure steam systems, and nuclear safety‑class and seismic requirements.

Your role

  • Responsibilities include developing and maintaining P&IDs based on process inputs, ensuring compliance with applicable ASME and ANSI standards, generating isometrics, fabrication drawings, BOMs, tie‑in details, equipment layouts, and construction drawings, and participating in 30%, 60%, and 90% model reviews using Navisworks.
  • The designer works closely with process, mechanical, civil/structural, electrical, instrumentation, safety, and quality teams to resolve clashes, address constructability issues, maintain consistent CAD standards, and produce audit‑ready documentation.
  • Develop detailed 3D piping models in Autodesk Plant 3D for industrial, mining, power and nuclear plants.
  • Route piping considering process flow, equipment accessibility, maintenance, expansion, and safety requirements.
  • Incorporate sector-specific constraints such as:
    • Industrial: high-volume utilities, continuous process layout.
    • M&M: abrasive slurry lines, rugged environments, large equipment footprints.
    • Power: high-pressure steam lines, turbine building layout constraints.
  • Nuclear: strict safety-class piping, seismic considerations, redundancy.
  • Develop, update, and maintain P&IDs in line with process engineering input.
  • Ensure compliance with sector-relevant standards (e.g., ASME, ANSI).
  • Generate piping isometrics, fabrication drawings, BOMs, tie-in details, equipment layout drawings, and support drawings.
  • Work closely with process, mechanical, civil/structural, electrical, instrumentation, safety, and quality teams.
  • Participate in 30%, 60% and 90% model reviews using Navisworks or similar tools.
  • Resolve design clashes, construction feasibility issues, and ensure alignment with project execution strategy.
  • Maintain consistent CAD standards, design methodologies and practices.
  • Produce documentation suitable for audits.
  • Required QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Degree / Diploma or ITI in Mechanical Engineering, Piping Design, or related discipline.

About you

Experience

  • 3 – 10+ years of piping design and 3D plant modeling experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Autodesk Plant 3D and P&ID module is essential.
  • Experience in one or more of the following is desirable:
  • Industrial manufacturing plants
  • Minerals & Metals concentrators, smelters, material handling
  • Thermal, renewable, or hybrid power plants
  • Nuclear power generation

Technical Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of piping systems, fittings, valves, pipe specs, and supports.
  • Ability to interpret PFDs, P&IDs, equipment datasheets, structural layouts, and vendor drawings.
  • Proficiency with: Autodesk Plant 3D, Auto CAD, Navisworks (for clash detection and model review).
  • Familiarity with BIM workflows for Revit

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication and stakeholder coordination capabilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and design accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deliver within schedule.
  • Proactive problem‑solving approach and willingness to learn sector-specific regulations.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

title: Information manager
jobDescription:
Overview

The Digital Engineering function within the Global Technology Centre (GTC) supports the digital transformation of infrastructure delivery across the highways, rail, utilities, water, energy, and aviation sectors.

The team combines information management, digital delivery, computational design, automation, data analytics, and emerging technologies to improve how infrastructure assets are planned, designed, constructed, and operated throughout their lifecycle.

As a Senior Digital Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across Digital Engineering projects and programmes, supporting the successful delivery of complex infrastructure projects through the application of information management, digital delivery, automation, data analytics, and emerging technologies.

title: Assistant Engineer
jobDescription:
Overview

We are looking for motivated engineers with strong analytical capability and an interest in early-stage engineering development to join our expanding WRMP29 Option Engineering team. In this role, you will work directly with UK colleagues to deliver high quality engineering support across multiple UK water companies.

The work focusses on concept development of water resource options, GIS analysis, generation of cost and carbon metrics, and preparation of technical option appraisal documents. You will be part of a dynamic, multidisciplinary environment that integrates engineering, environmental assessment, carbon appraisal and strategic planning.

This is an opportunity to contribute to significant programmes, influence future water supply investment decisions, and develop specialist skills in UK water resource planning.

Your role

Concept Development

  • Work collaboratively with UK teams and clients to develop coherent raw-to-tap water resource option concepts.
  • Apply creative engineering thinking to refine options, suggest mitigations, and adapt concepts to regional characteristics.
  • Ensure consistent application of assumptions across option portfolios and provide/receive reasoned technical challenge.
  • Engage with multi-disciplinary colleagues to maintain coherence between engineering, environmental and cost/carbon elements.

GIS & Spatial Analysis

  • Support spatial representation of options using GIS platforms (e.g., QGIS).

Metric Generation (Cost, Carbon & Decision-Making)

  • Use established client tools and Atkins Réalis workflows to prepare cost estimates (CAPEX, OPEX, whole life cost, NPV).
  • Undertake carbon assessments (operational and embodied), including monetisation of carbon.
  • Generate WRMP-specific decision metrics required for option comparison and selection.

Reporting

  • Support preparation of technical proformas and reporting for each project stage, incorporating engineering assumptions and datasets.

  • You should have a degree in civil engineering, environmental engineering, water resources, or a related discipline. Experience in the UK water sector or WRMP processes is advantageous but not essential.

title: Plant 3D Admin
jobDescription:
Overview

The Plant 3D Admin is primarily responsible for managing Autodesk Plant 3D models and associated data, including P&ID development, across complex industrial projects. The role also supports BIM integration to ensure cross-disciplinary coordination and digital delivery. Emphasis is placed on compliance with ISO 15926 for data interoperability and ISO 19650 for structured information management throughout the project lifecycle particularly in Industrial, M&M, Power, and Nuclear sectors.

Your Role

  • Lead the implementation and management of BIM processes and Plant 3D modeling across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Develop and maintain the BIM Execution Plan (BEP) and ensure adherence to ISO 19650 and project-specific standards.
  • Manage the Common Data Environment (CDE) and ensure accurate data exchange between stakeholders.
  • Lead the setup, development, and maintenance of Autodesk Plant 3D models for piping, instrumentation, and process systems.
  • Ensure model accuracy, version control, and adherence to project-specific standards and workflows.
  • Coordinate the creation of intelligent 3D models for piping, equipment, civil, structural, and electrical systems using Auto CAD Plant 3D, Revit, and other tools.
  • Facilitate integration of 3D models from Plant 3D and other applications with other platforms (e.g., Navisworks, BIM 360, asset management systems).
  • Conduct clash detection and model coordination using Navisworks Manage or similar platforms.
  • Integrate data from P&IDs, Piping and other systems into the BIM environment.
  • Manage construction deliverables such as isometrics, general arrangement drawings, and bills of materials (BOMs).
  • Provide training and support to project teams on BIM tools and workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to ensure model accuracy and data integrity.
  • Support digital twin and asset information delivery for operations and maintenance.

About you

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Civil, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in plant design using Autodesk Plant 3D and proven experience in BIM management for Industrial, Mining and Power projects.
  • Proficiency in Auto CAD Plant 3D, Revit, Navisworks, and Autodesk Construction Cloud.
  • Strong understanding of engineering documentation, P&IDs, and 3D model integration.
  • Knowledge of P&ID standards, Piping material specifications and standards, Data standards including ISO 19650 and ISO 15926.
  • Familiarity with Digital Twin concepts and integration workflows.
  • Excellent communication, coordination, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and deadlines.

title: Lead Software Engineer
jobDescription:
Overview

Engineering Automation & Platform Integrations Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Lead Software Engineer with strong exposure to work-related automations, engineering platform workflows, CAD/BIM processes, and digital delivery solutions.

The ideal candidate should have around 8–12 years of overall experience, preferably with hands-on involvement in automation initiatives, requirements analysis, stakeholder engagement, solution definition, and delivery support for engineering technology platforms.

This role requires someone who can work closely with business users, engineering teams, BIM/CAD teams, and software developers to identify automation opportunities, define clear requirements, support solution design, and ensure successful delivery of digital tools and integrations.

Your role

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with business and engineering stakeholders to understand requirements
  • Identify automation and workflow improvement opportunities
  • Gather and document detailed business requirements
  • Convert requirements into functional specifications
  • Collaborate with technical teams for solution design and delivery
  • Support development of Software tools, Plugins, Integrations, Automation solutions
  • Coordinate across business, engineering, and development teams
  • Participate in UAT activities: Test planning, Test case preparation, Defect tracking, Validation
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and priorities
  • Ensure alignment between business needs and technical solutions

About you

Mandatory Skills and Experience

  • Strong experience as Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Product Analyst
  • Experience in Digital transformation or automation projects, Engineering, BIM, CAD, construction, or infrastructure domains
  • Good understanding of Engineering project workflows, Data and document management processes
  • Ability to Capture business requirements, Convert them into functional specifications
  • Experience working with technical teams delivering: Software tools Plugins, Integrations, Automation solutions
  • Familiarity with platforms such as: Revit, Auto CAD, Civil 3D, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Micro Station, Smart 3D, Aconex
  • Strong skills in: Stakeholder management, Communication, Documentation, Coordination
  • Experience in UAT planning, Test case preparation, Defect tracking, Solution validation
  • Ability to: Independently own business analysis activities, Manage multiple stakeholders and priorities

Technical Awareness Required

  • Awareness of C# / .NET application or plugin development, Python automation or scripting
  • Understanding of APIs, SDKs, and system integrations
  • Basic knowledge of Databases (SQL / SQLite)
  • Familiarity with Data exchange between engineering platforms, Common Data Environments (CDE)
  • Knowledge of CAD/BIM models, drawings, documents, and metadata workflows

Good to Have Skills

  • Autodesk Revit, Auto CAD
  • Civil 3D

  • Bentley Micro Station
  • Hexagon Smart 3D / Smart Plant 3D
  • Aconex
  • Autodesk Platform Services / Forge APIs

  • Agile / Scrum methodologies

  • Mature and delivery-focused Business Analyst
  • Independently engage with stakeholders
  • Understand complex engineering workflows
  • Convert them into actionable automation requirements
  • Comfortable working in a technical environment
  • Strong coordination with Developers, Solution architects, BIM specialists, CAD users, Project delivery teams

title: BIM Engineer / Designer / Lead Designer / Senior Lead Designer - Utilities (Wet & Dry) - Civil 3D
jobDescription:
Overview

Our team within the Industrial Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.

We leverage Building Information Modeling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecycle—from concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.

Our expertise spans:

Water Treatment Plants – Advanced design for potable and wastewater treatment facilities.

Pumping Stations & Pipelines – Reliable and efficient conveyance systems.

Reservoirs & Storage Facilities – Safe and sustainable water storage solutions.

Flood Management & Drainage Systems – Infrastructure for climate resilience.

The opportunities we offer range from consultancy services to client-side project delivery, covering diverse scales and responsibilities. We also collaborate with other parts of Atkins' Water and Environment business, supporting projects from initial feasibility studies to decommissioning and asset management.

Your role

Responsibilities

  • Strong experience in modelling and detailing including production of Civil3D Utilities Models and extraction of information directly from the model to form 2D drawings, schedules, setting out, quantities and other deliverables.
  • Supporting technical delivery of Complex multi-disciplinary engineering projects.
  • Undertake designs, production and checking of 3D Models, drawings, calculations, reports and specifications.
  • Compliance with Quality, Safety, Environment, and governance procedures, thus ensuring work produced is technically accurate and delivered in accordance with the appropriate standards.
  • Supporting the preparation of specifications for construction, technical surveys and design. Supporting the preparation of tender and contract documentation to various forms of contract.
  • Undertake self-checking and assist with technical checks of work undertaken by the team. Provide quality control for compliance to company/project standards of deliverables.
  • Manage the Waters, Utilities discipline 3D models, check model quality and technical content including clash detection and compliance with the BEP.
  • Work with the Information Manager and project teams to assist in the development and implementation of BIM strategies, BIM Execution Plans, workflows and processes on projects in accordance with Atkins Réalis Corporate Standards, Client requirements and industry best practices.
  • Actively contribute to project design development by contributing to internal coordination, clash detection and design review sessions as well as external presentations to clients.
  • Provide over the shoulder support for junior staff, mentor and support them through technical training and live project work supervision.

Required attributes

  • High performing ability to work and integrate into multi-disciplinary teams and work independently. Ensuring your work is to the highest appropriate standards and in compliance with Atkins quality systems and standards.
  • Energetic and enthusiastic, with the desire to take on extra responsibilities and constantly upskilling team and oneself.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication within a business environment.
  • Ability to exercise initiative, take ownership of project issues and work independently with excellent time management skills.
  • You will demonstrate a high level of commitment, flexibility and be eager to accept responsibility and learn new skills, whilst always exercising an active interest in helping to solve technical problems faced by any member of the team.
  • You will act with integrity and professionalism, gaining the trust of colleagues and setting an example to junior staff.

About you

Required skills and experience

  • A Diploma or Bachelor's degree holder in Civil Engineering with 3-10 years of experience of delivering complex civil engineering projects, from the USA, UK & ME Utilities domain.
  • Having experience working for UK/US/ME projects is mandatory.
  • Extensive experience of detailing Dry and Wet infrastructure utilities.
  • Prepare and manage engineering plans and project documents.
  • Plan, coordinate, and execute work in a safe, timely, cost effective and compliant manner.
  • Follow BIM and CAD standards. Create, edit, and label alignments, Civil 3D parcels, and corridors.
  • Create, use, and edit Civil 3D labels. Create feature lines and surfaces.
  • Manage, data reference, label and interact with a Civil 3D surface.
  • Perform roadway design, including creating corridors, subassemblies, road FG, contour grading, and surface clean-up/manipulation through Tin/points.
  • Use Civil 3D to design plan and profiles of utilities, including using and creating pipe networks, editing and changing parts and styles, catch basin sizing/spacing and minimum cover, manhole sizing/spacing and minimum cover, hydrant spacing, and creating waterlines in profile with deflection and exaggeration, per jurisdictional requirements.
  • Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
  • Must be an advanced user or expert user in Autodesk Navisworks with capabilities to federate individual discipline BIM Models. Setup, maintain and run clash rules and clash tests across federated BIM Models. Must know how to create search sets, query, find and navigate through BIM Models.
  • Must be able to use Navisworks to generate clash results, manage clash resolution, redline BIM Models, capture viewpoints and cascade reports to discipline teams. Must be able to perform Navisworks model management.
  • Computational / Generative design tool experience such as Autodesk Dynamo or Bentley Generative Components.
  • Technical proficiency in the use of the latest common CDE systems: Bentley Project Wise and Autodesk BIM360 or ACC. Understanding and experience of handling Civil3D Data Shortcuts within the CDE Environment is a must.

title: BIM Coordinator / Information Manager
jobDescription:
Overview

Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is at the forefront of transforming how projects are delivered across the built environment. By leveraging advanced construction technologies, digital platforms, and integrated workflows, the GTC enables remote site operations that support clients and project teams worldwide. Our approach combines expertise in Building Information Modelling (BIM), data-driven decision-making, and collaborative digital ecosystems to enhance efficiency, quality, and sustainability throughout the asset lifecycle.

As part of this vision, the BIM Coordinator plays a critical role in extending design and engineering excellence into the construction and operational phases. This position governs, coordinates, and assures construction-stage (LOD 400) and as-built (LOD 500) BIM deliverables produced by contractors and vendors. The role manages the Common Data Environment (Autodesk Construction Cloud), drives clash-free, buildable, and data-complete federations, and ensures timely issue resolution and handover compliance—working remotely while collaborating closely with site-based teams, clients, and multiple contractors under demanding project timeline

Your role

Responsibilities

  • Mobilisation & Governance
  • Administer & oversee Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) (Docs, Model Coordination, Issues, Transmittals) workspaces and folder structures.
  • Establish and oversee adherence to project BEP addendum for construction & as-built phases.
  • Define acceptance criteria for LOD 400 and LOD 500 deliverables. Oversee adherence of the same.
  • Working knowledge on client CDEs' / EDMS such as Aconex, A-site
  • Model Coordination & QA/QC (Construction LOD 400)
  • Run weekly federations and clash detection using Navisworks Manage.
  • Review Contractor shop models/drawings for conformance.
  • Track clash metrics and publish coordination reports.
  • Enforce model health and data integrity.
  • Support site team in chairing BIM Coordination Meetings and record actions.
  • Vendor/Trade Integration
  • Onboard specialist vendors into ACC and validate workflows.
  • Coordinate fabrication models and vendor point-clouds.
  • As-Built & Handover (LOD 500)
  • Run as-built capture process including support towards site verification.
  • Validate LOD 500 deliverables for completeness.
  • Compile Handover Information through ACC.
  • Information Management Training and support
  • Support site engineers and Contractors on ISO 19650 workflows.
  • Run model/data audits and issue non-conformance reports.

Key Skill Requirements

  • A good understanding of the data, information management including compliance to ISO 19650 standards.
  • Sound knowledge in engineering design and in assisting engineering disciplines in with Self/Inter and Multi-disciplinary design coordination and quality compliance.
  • Good knowledge of authoring tools from key software vendors such as Autodesk, Bentley, Rhino, Trimble in delivery of multi-disciplinary projects.
  • Proficient knowledge of model federation and design co-ordination platforms such as Navisworks, BIM Track or Revizto for performing tasks like clash management, model walkthroughs, issue tracking and management.
  • Proficient knowledge of Common Data Environment (CDE) such as ACC, BIM360, ASITE or Project Wise.
  • Good knowledge of data visualization/analytics platforms such as Power BI.
  • Knowledge of automation tools such as Dynamo is desirable.
  • Knowledge of information management uses such as construction sequencing (4D), quantity take-offs (5D), extended reality (VR+AR).
  • A grounded understanding of construction quality processes.
  • Demonstrable ability to develop technical documentation for Information Management.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Well versed in coordination and collaboration with all stakeholders.
  • Proficient in problem-solving and critical thinking.
  • Must have developed Information Management documents e.g. Pre- and Post-BEP, federation strategy, Level Of Information Need, responsibility matrix etc.
  • Understanding of MIDP/TIDP is a must.

About you

Education And Experience

Essential

  • 10 to 15 years total experience in Buildings BIM; 5+ years in GCC construction-stage coordination, minimum 2 years' experience in Middle East region.
  • Minimum 2 years' experience in digital delivery of complex, multidisciplinary project (Information Management/BIM).
  • Expert in Revit (A/S/MEP), Navisworks Manage, and Autodesk Construction Cloud.
  • Proven track record delivering LOD 400 and LOD 500 BIM deliverables.
  • Strong grasp of information management and CDE administration.
  • Excellent written/spoken English; Arabic exposure is a plus.
  • Demonstrable experience of working with various stakeholders (such as but not limited to contractors, consultants, PMCs, vendors and clients.

Desirable

title: OHL engineer
jobDescription:
Overview

Power Grid Division is involved in electricity utilities sector in the UK & I, Canada, US, ME and APAC. We provide value-added engineering services and build solutions across the entire spectrum of electricity networks, from high voltage power transmission grids to low voltage industrial power distribution. We have designed HV Substations up to 400k V and Electrical infrastructure for large industrial/ Multi Use developments and Heavy industries. The team provides services to clients across the globe; however, the major clients are in UK and Middle East.

The Power T&D team is looking for experienced Principal engineers in HV Plant Discipline, as we look to grow the team in line with business requirements. We are looking for experienced engineers for mid to senior level role in 'Overhead Lines' design for transmission and distribution projects as we look to grow the team in line with business requirements. Using your experience and knowledge, you will be leading the delivery of a variety of projects drawing upon the wider team for the technical engineering requirements and building a strong relationship with our clients. You will be client-facing, responsible for the delivery of our work and making sure it meets our client's'expectations. This role will be based at our Atkins Réalis office in Bangalore, Mumbai, Gurgaon in India.

So, if you are interested in working for an internationally renowned consultancy and working on some of the challenging projects across Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) come and join us at Atkins Réalis.

Your role

  • Perform detailed engineering and design of overhead transmission lines ranging from HV, EHV, and UHV voltage levels.
  • Develop transmission line models using PLS-CADD and perform:
  • Route selection and optimization
  • Sag-tension calculations
  • Clearance analysis
  • Structure spotting
  • Material and construction reports
  • Conduct structural analysis and design of transmission line structures using:
  • PLS-TOWER for lattice steel towers
  • PLS-POLE for steel, concrete, and composite poles
  • Evaluate and apply loading criteria in accordance with applicable standards such as ASCE, IEC, IS, NESC, CSA, ECCS or utility-specific requirements.
  • Review and optimize structure loading, member utilization, and structural adequacy.
  • Prepare and review transmission line design deliverables including:
  • Design reports
  • Structure loading trees
  • Sag-tension reports

We are seeking an Environmental Consultant to join our growing team in this role in Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre (GTC); you will collaborate with multidisciplinary technical specialists and contribute to a diverse portfolio of projects.

  • Support the preparation and delivery of Environmental Impact Assessments (EIAs), screening/scoping reports, and environmental statements.

  • Prepare technical sections such as Land Use, Socioeconomics, Environmental Management, and Sustainability.
  • Conduct desktop research, data analysis, GIS mapping support, and preparation of constraints plans.
  • Coordinate with internal disciplines (ecology, transport, utilities, planning, air quality, etc.) to compile environmental inputs.

  • Assist senior consultants in project management tasks—programme tracking, documentation, QA/QC, and reporting.
  • Engage with clients and stakeholders professionally when required.

About you

  • Postgraduate degree qualified in an environmental or related discipline.

jobDescription:
Job Description

Your role

  • Ensure compliance with UK Health & Safety requirements and CDM Regulations and incorporate design for safety.

  • Ensure compliance with Atkinsrealis Quality Management Procedures.

  • Deliver projects on time and to quality and budget.

  • Mentoring of Graduate/Assistant Engineers.

  • Multi-disciplinary coordination.

  • Aware of best engineering practices, value engineering, civil designs with respect to buildability, ability to solve site related design issues.

  • Check and/or review of calculations and drawings to international codes of practice.

  • Enthusiastic and self-motivated.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with clients & colleagues from diverse backgrounds.

  • Flexible and adaptable.

  • Ability to learn new skills.

  • Awareness of limits of competence and when to seek assistance.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to make correct judgements.

  • Willingness to travel to various locations in India and abroad for short term assignments and training.

About you

  • 8+ years of experience in the Water & Wastewater Industry.

  • Experience of working in the water Industry; Civil / Structural design of water and wastewater assets, reservoirs, pumping stations, water and wastewater treatment works. UK or any other international experience is preferred.

  • Knowledge in MEPICA and Geotech for effective Multi-design coordination.

  • Experience in client coordination, Design management and Buildability aspects.

  • Experience of detailed design drawings and calculations.

  • Familiarity with IS/BS, US Codes of Practice.

  • Ability to contribute to the project management of detailed design of projects.

  • Strong analytical skills

title: Bid Manager/Proposal Manager (Bangalore)
jobDescription:
Overview

Atkins Réalis is one of the world's leading engineering design and programme management consultancies operating at the forefront of the infrastructure, transportation, and construction industry sectors. We're recruiting for an experienced proposal lead, to be responsible for managing different phases of the company's proposal process and oversee all required activities to develop RFP-compliant, competitive, and quality marketing materials, proposals, statements of qualification, and presentations.

You will be working closely with regional win work/technical leads and business development & the engagement team across Atkins Réalis and the wider organisation to produce compelling bids. As a member of the central Bid Management team, you will also be responsible for contributing to the continuous improvement of the win-work capability (people, processes, tools, information, and governance).

Your role

  • Lead the development and application of proposal/bid themes. Develop organization chart with the pursuit team. Coordinate communication between SMEs and proposal writers. Lead teams through strategic reviews as per internal schedule.
  • Exercise considerable initiative and independent judgment about content, wording, completeness, correctness, and appropriateness of proposal contents and graphics materials, making recommendations directly to pursuit team. Makes sound decisions.
  • Supervise marketing assistants and/or less experienced proposal coordinators. Give work directions to graphic artists and marketing assistants involved in proposal production.
  • Have experience leading pursuit responses – the larger and complex ones. Experience managing teams to deliver by established deadlines.
  • Understanding of Architectural-Engineering and project and construction management industry standards and disciplines. Can translate abstract ideas or narrative text into graphical concepts to illustrate concepts more effectively. Works independently yet functions effectively as a member of a team.
  • Ensuring that the proposal is run in accordance with best practice and the win work capture plan and pursuit process, and in compliance with the Service Delivery Process.
  • Provide client service, commitment, communication, innovation & continuous improvement, professionalism, quality and teamwork. (Note that "Clients" may be internal managers and staff.)
  • Added advantage if you have experience in capture planning
  • Implement and facilitate capture planning process
  • Facilitate kick off workshops and Go/No Go call
  • Facilitate win theme sessions and supporting strategies
  • Initiate and drive Go No Go calls and risk cat tool
  • Portal Management (CRM tools) and Review procurement documents and attachments.
  • Create and maintain a Proposal Management Plan.
  • Develop compliance matrix, Storyboard templates and allocate bid deliverables.
  • Review / approve response for standard prequalification questions.
  • Check PQQ responses from JV partners (if applicable).
  • Graphics co-ordination, (colour schemes; word templates; document covers and dividers; images / photos; graphics / charts / graphs (where applicable) and Graphics approval in accordance with company's Branding Guidelines.
  • Work involves knowledgeable application of quality control as well as standard procedures and criteria to the coordination of proposals which are of critical importance to the firm.
  • Assist in the development of preparation for Stage-gate reviews – and facilitate bid go/no-go decision.
  • Support development of CVs.
  • Work with the Business Development team to schedule & co-ordinate communications activities necessary to identify customer issues, hot buttons and the associated win themes and win strategy statements. Occasionally contact upper management for required signatures.
  • Support the production of case studies / evidence scenarios.
  • Coordinate with support services (legal, accounting, HR) on administrative sections of the pursuits (e.g., forms, statistics).
  • Take constructive feedback and apply it to enhance the delivery.

Submission

  • Final quality review of documents, post-formatting and after Bid Coordinator proofread / sense check.
  • Final proofread / compliance check of tender documents.
  • Close-out actions with JV partners (if required).
  • Client Presentation, Negotiate & Contract, Feedback, Handover
  • Lead, review, approve and disseminate Lessons Learnt feedback – Proposal Lead to lead the session with support from the Bid Co-ordinator.
  • Support response to Client Queries.
  • Support preparation for client interviews / presentations.

About you

  • Promote and demonstrate team values and behaviours in line with the win work team practices
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Relationship building
  • Ability to multi-task and manage several projects at once
  • Attention to detail
  • Collaborative approach
  • Time management skills
  • Enthusiastic, initiative and the confidence to start things from scratch
  • Confident using digital tools and learning new ones
  • Promote the use of Atkins Réalis work winning processes and tools
  • In-still a culture where others share knowledge, insights and learning

Specific skills required

  • A strong communicator with strong grammar, spelling, composition, and proofreading abilities.
  • Able to evaluate, monitor and present ideas and data.
  • Analytical with solid organisational skills, scheduling and prioritising activities.
  • A flexible but methodical approach to supporting bids.
  • Computer skills required and proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Creative Suite, CRM, and other software programmes including LLMs.
  • Comfortable and effective when working across all levels of an organisation.
  • Makes sound decisions, but also works with other stakeholders (e.g., sales lead, capture lead, PM) to gain buy-in.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

• Comprehensive life insurance coverage.

• Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.

• Generous annual leave balance.

• Flexible and hybrid work solutions.

• Remote work opportunities outside of country.

• Company gratuity scheme.

• Discretionary bonus program.

• Relocation assistance.

• Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

title: Quantity Surveyor - (Buildings & Places) - Middle East Experience
jobDescription:
Overview

We are looking for an experienced Quantity Surveyor to manage post-contract commercial and cost management activities across construction projects.The role involves cost control,contract administration,valuation,change management,and stakeholder coordination to ensure projects are delivered within budget and contractual requirements.This position may be offered as either a contract-to-hire or a regular full-time role,depending on your overall experience and the technical competencies demonstrated during the interview process.

​

Your role

Commercial & Cost Management

  • Manage project budgets, cost plans, and cost tracking throughout the construction phase.
  • Prepare monthly cost reports, forecasts, and cash flow projections.
  • Monitor cost performance and identify variances with root cause analysis.

Contract Administration

  • Administer post contract obligations in accordance with contract conditions (FIDIC/JCT/NEC or equivalent).
  • Draft and issue relevant contractual notices (EOT, claims, variations).
  • Maintain robust documentation and audit trails.

Measurement & Valuation

  • Carry out quantity measurements using drawings or BIM models for IFT, IFC drawings.
  • Prepare and review monthly and final valuations and certify contractor payments.
  • Evaluate subcontractor invoices and verify final quantities.

Change & Claims Management

  • Evaluate variations, maintain a change register, and prepare justification documents.
  • Assess time and cost impacts of changes.
  • Support preparation and evaluation of claims and dispute resolution submissions.

Stakeholder Management

  • Liaise with project teams, contractors, subcontractors, and consultants.
  • Participate in progress meetings and provide commercial updates.
  • Build strong working relationships with clients and internal teams.

About you

  • Strong relevant working experience and knowledge of post contract QS processes.
  • Proficiency in measurement software (Cost X, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of construction methods and contract legislation.
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work to deadlines.
  • Degree in Quantity Surveying / Civil Engineering / related field.
  • Relevant experience in buildings, infrastructure, or mixed-use projects.
  • Middle East Post Contract experience is an added advantage.
  • Minimum 07–09 years of relevant experience in Post Contract Projects.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced Quantity Surveyor to manage post-contract commercial and cost management activities across construction projects.The role involves cost control,contract administration,valuation,change management,and stakeholder coordination to ensure projects are delivered within budget and contractual requirements.This position may be offered as either a contract-to-hire or a regular full-time role,depending on your overall experience and the technical competencies demonstrated during the interview process.

​

Your role

Commercial & Cost Management

  • Manage project budgets, cost plans, and cost tracking throughout the construction phase.
  • Prepare monthly cost reports, forecasts, and cash flow projections.
  • Monitor cost performance and identify variances with root cause analysis.

Contract Administration

  • Administer post contract obligations in accordance with contract conditions (FIDIC/JCT/NEC or equivalent).
  • Draft and issue relevant contractual notices (EOT, claims, variations).
  • Maintain robust documentation and audit trails.

Measurement & Valuation

  • Carry out quantity measurements using drawings or BIM models for IFT, IFC drawings.
  • Prepare and review monthly and final valuations and certify contractor payments.
  • Evaluate subcontractor invoices and verify final quantities.

Change & Claims Management

  • Evaluate variations, maintain a change register, and prepare justification documents.
  • Assess time and cost impacts of changes.
  • Support preparation and evaluation of claims and dispute resolution submissions.

Stakeholder Management

  • Liaise with project teams, contractors, subcontractors, and consultants.
  • Participate in progress meetings and provide commercial updates.
  • Build strong working relationships with clients and internal teams.

About you

  • Strong relevant working experience and knowledge of post contract QS processes.
  • Proficiency in measurement software (Cost X, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of construction methods and contract legislation.
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work to deadlines.
  • Degree in Quantity Surveying / Civil Engineering / related field.
  • Relevant experience in buildings, infrastructure, or mixed-use projects.
  • Middle East Post Contract experience is an added advantage.
  • Minimum 07–09 years of relevant experience in Post Contract Projects.

title: Intercompany Lead
jobDescription:
Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Intercompany Lead to assist in designing, implementing, and overseeing our Intercompany Hub within the Shared Services organization. This role will play a critical part in driving process standardization, operational efficiency, and financial accuracy across global intercompany activities.

Initially operating as a senior individual contributor collaborating with the GPO, the successful candidate will provide cross-functional leadership and governance across intercompany processes, with the focus on building and leading a dedicated team.

Your role

  • Participate in the design, implementation, and evolution of the Intercompany Hub and its operating model
  • Standardize and optimize end-to-end intercompany processes (invoicing, payables, reconciliation, settlements) while driving automation and system improvements
  • Oversee intercompany accounting, including reconciliations, eliminations, accruals, and FX impacts, ensuring accurate and timely month-end close
  • Ensure integrity and alignment of intercompany balances across entities, with strong compliance and control framework
  • Provide functional oversight to intercompany AR/AP teams, ensuring alignment and effective dispute resolution
  • Act as escalation point for complex intercompany issues, managing stakeholder relationships and resolving disputes
  • Help Define and track KPIs, driving performance, transparency, and continuous improvement
  • Identify and implement efficiency opportunities, reducing manual work, rework, and aged balances
  • Serve as the central point of contact across Finance, business, GPO, and IT
  • Support the development of the future-state team and transition into a leadership role over time

About you

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline (CPA/CA preferred)
  • 7–10+ years of relevant experience in:
  • General Accounting / Record-to-Report
  • Intercompany accounting
  • Shared Services or Global Business Services environment
  • Month-end close and reconciliation processes
  • Key Skills & Competencies
  • Strong finance and accounting expertise, particularly in intercompany processes
  • Advanced analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities
  • Solid IT and systems acumen (ARCS, Oracle ERP systems, automation, data analysis tools)
  • Demonstrated ability to design and improve processes in a global environment
  • Experience working in a matrix organization with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to:
  • Partner effectively with business teams
  • Manage and resolve escalated disputes in a professional and timely manner
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and change management skills

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
