title: Transport Planner
jobDescription:
Overview

Shape the future of mobility with us. As a Transport Planner, you will contribute to impactful projects that improve connectivity, support sustainable growth, and create smarter, more resilient transport systems for communities around the world.

Your role

You will play a key role in the planning, assessment, and delivery of integrated transport and mobility solutions for large-scale developments, cities, and strategic planning initiatives across the Middle East and global markets. This position offers the opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects, including master planning, mobility strategy development, public transport planning, transport policy formulation, traffic impact assessments, and multi-modal integration. Working collaboratively with urban planners, infrastructure engineers, and multidisciplinary teams, you will help develop innovative, sustainable, and future-ready mobility solutions that enhance connectivity and support economic growth.

About you

Essential Requirements

  • Appropriate academic and professional qualifications (Bachelor's Degree with Master's degree in transport planning/transportation engineering)
  • Working experience (4+ years) in Transport Planning.
  • Knowledge and experience in delivering transport planning/modelling projects for UK/ME/ USA/ Canada/ Australia regions
  • Demonstrable Experience in one or more of the following:
    • Master Planning/Comprehensive Mobility Plans
    • Urban Mobility Strategy Development
    • Public Transport Planning
    • Traffic Impact Assessment
    • Multi-modal Integration Studies/Mobility Policy Development
  • Strong Analytical skills with experience in handling and interpreting complex datasets
  • Experience in scripting using like Python, Excel-VBA and R.
  • Strong understanding of Arc GIS/QGIS, Power BI and Microsoft Office applications
  • Proficiency in preparing high quality technical reports and presentations
  • Strong Verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work in a team as part of a wider project.

Desirable requirements

  • Be highly self-motivated and ambitious.
  • Be able to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers.
  • Be able to build excellent working relationships with colleagues and clients.
  • Appreciation of the transport industry and related policy context

title: Lead Engineer -Rail drainage
jobDescription:
Overview

As a Lead Engineer within our Drainage team, you will lead the end-to-end design, coordination, and delivery of stormwater drainage solutions for major infrastructure and highway projects across all stages, including feasibility, planning, detailed design, and construction support.

You will be responsible for ensuring full compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements across regions such as the UK, Ireland, the US, and Canada, including Network Rail, Transport Infrastructure Ireland, Su DS principles, Local Authority specifications, UK Sewerage Sector Guidance, and DOT standards. A key element of this role is delivering robust hydraulic and hydrological modelling using industry-standard software such as Info Drainage, Causeway Flow, and Info Works ICM, alongside effective BIM coordination using Autodesk and Bentley platforms.

Your role

  • Lead the design and delivery of rail drainage and stormwater solutions across multiple project stages.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable standards and guidance, including Network Rail/HS2, Su DS, Local .Authority requirements, and Sewerage Sector Guidance.
  • Manage project programmes, budgets, and associated risks to ensure successful delivery.
  • Oversee the preparation of technical documentation, reports, and Bills of Quantities (Bo Qs).
  • Proactively engage with the team, lead office, and other stakeholders to deliver efficient and innovative design solutions.
  • Coordinate effectively within multidisciplinary teams, including BIM integration using Autodesk and Bentley platforms.
  • Engage with clients, local authorities, regulators, and statutory bodies to secure approvals and ensure compliance.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to junior team members.
  • Support delivery across all design stages, including construction support.

About you

  • A minimum of 10+ years of experience in stormwater management in the UK and Ireland is mandatory.
  • A bachelor's degree in civil engineering is required; a master's'in water resources or environmental engineering is desirable
  • Proficiency in Info Drainage and Causeway Flow is desirable
  • Hands-on experience with Micro Station and Open Buildings Designer/Rail Designer is an advantage
  • Proficiency in Network Rail, HS2, Irish Rail standards, CIRIA standards, and Sewerage Sector Guidance
  • Knowledge of international codes (US, Canada, and the Middle East) would be an advantage
  • In-depth knowledge of UK drainage standards, design practices, and approval processes
  • Strong understanding of fundamental concepts, principles, and theories of system integration as applied to multidisciplinary designs and stormwater engineering
  • Knowledge of wet utilities (foul water, potable water, and treated sewage effluent) is an advantage
  • Strong understanding of Occupational Safety and Health (Construction Work) (Design and Management) Regulations
  • Understanding of sustainable solutions and their integration with stormwater drainage systems

Atkins Réalis is seeking a Solid Waste Management Engineer to support the delivery of solid waste management, circular economy and environmental compliance projects within multidisciplinary teams to support our Canada team.

Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

The Project Manager – IT Infrastructure is responsible for planning, driving, and delivering complex IT infrastructure programs including transitions, migrations, and carve‑out initiatives. This role requires strong ownership of end‑to‑end project delivery, coordination across multiple technical and business teams, vendor management, and adherence to timelines, quality, and governance standards.   • Track progress against plans and proactively manage risks and issues.

  • Vendors and service providers

  • Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks proactively

title: Software Asset Management (SAM) & Vendor Manager
jobDescription:
Job Title: Software Asset Management (SAM) & Vendor Manager

Job Location: Chennai, India

Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

The Software Asset Management & Vendor Manager is accountable for governing software assets and IT‑side vendor relationships across Linxon's engineering, enterprise, SAP ERP, Saa S, and AI‑enabled application landscape.

The role ensures license compliance, cost optimisation, vendor control, and audit‑ready governance, working in close partnership with Procurement for commercial execution.

What will you do?

Software Asset Management (SAM)

  • Maintain the single authoritative software inventory covering:
  • Engineering & BIM tools (Autodesk, Bentley, Trimble)
  • Project Controls (Primavera P6, MS Project, Procore)
  • Microsoft 365 and Power Platform
  • SAP ERP (S/4HANA, ARIBA)
  • Saa S and AI‑enabled applications
  • Track entitlements, usage, renewals, contracts, hosting models, and ownership
  • Ensure compliance across Saa S, subscription, and on‑prem licensing
  • Act as the data authority for all software asset records

Cost Optimisation & Rationalisation

  • Identify under‑utilisation, duplication, and overlapping tools
  • Drive license optimisation and application rationalisation with:
  • Solution Architects
  • Application / Product Owners
  • Support consolidation to strategic platforms and retirement of legacy tools
  • Provide usage‑based inputs to reduce run and subscription costs

Vendor Management (IT Ownership)

  • Own IT‑side vendor governance, including:
  • Vendor performance tracking
  • Dependency and lock‑in risk assessment
  • Act as IT's primary interface with vendors on portfolio and usage matters
  • Prevent shadow IT and unmanaged vendor relationships

Procurement Partnership (Clear Boundary)

  • Work closely with Procurement with clear ownership split:
  • IT owns: tool fit, usage, lifecycle, renewals validation, risk
  • Procurement owns: negotiations, contracts, POs, commercials
  • Provide Procurement with accurate renewal, usage, and consolidation data
  • Ensure no renewals occur without IT validation

ERP, Saa S & AI Licence Governance

  • Govern licenses and vendors across ERP and support‑function tools
  • Support ERP transitions (Oracle → SAP, Workday integrations) from a SAM perspective
  • Identify applications with embedded AI and track related license exposure
  • Support AI governance with ownership and cost transparency inputs

Audit, Risk & Governance

  • Support internal and external audits with clean, auditable data
  • Ensure defensible renewal and exit decisions
  • Identify and mitigate risks related to:
    • License non‑compliance
    • Vendor dependency
    • Contractual lock‑in
  • Enforce software governance standards across regions

Collaboration

  • Work with Solution Architects, Application Owners, Security, Procurement, and Finance
  • Ensure consistent asset governance across internal and outsourced teams
  • Influence without direct line authority

Required Experience & Skills

  • 8–12+ years in Software Asset Management and Vendor Management
  • Experience managing large, complex software portfolios
  • Strong knowledge of Saa S and subscription licensing models
  • Exposure to ERP licensing (SAP, Oracle – governance level)
  • Experience partnering with Procurement and Finance
  • Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills

About Linxon

Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity.

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon.

Linxon's vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects.

As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a new company as it evolves and help shape it for the future. If you like new challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are interested in working with other motivated professionals with expertise in the Substations EPC business, then this is the new opportunity for you.

title: Associate Technical Director
jobDescription:
Overview

Atkins Réalis is one of the world's leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment. You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We're proud to say it's thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise and knowledge. We offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world. And when you join us, you'll be a part of this genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone's voice is valued and treated equally.

Your role

  • Appropriate academic and professional qualifications (Bachelor's Degree with Master's degree in transport planning/ transportation engineering)
  • Working experience (15+ years) in Transport Planning software like VISUM, CUBE, EMME, SATURN, DIADEM.
  • Experience and knowledge of Strategic Modelling techniques and guidance.
  • Knowledge of the technical transport planning environment
  • Strong numerate and analytical abilities, including a high degree of competence in MS Excel
  • Able to write a quality technical report
  • Ability to work in a team as part of a wider project
  • Experience in leading smaller teams as part of a project delivery
  • Good written communication skills
  • Be able to work individually.

About you

  • Be highly self-motivated and ambitious.
  • Be able to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers.
  • Be able to build excellent working relationships with colleagues and clients.
  • Knowledge and experience of ME regional modelling guidance and approaches
  • Experience in the use of analytical and research tools such as GIS and the use of databases
  • An appreciation of the transport industry and related policy context
  • Professional membership of a relevant institution.

title: GTC Sustainability & Environment Lead
jobDescription:
Overview

  • Lead the Sustainability and Environment (S&E) practice for Atkins Réalis in India and support the Consulting, Strategy & Advisory (CS&A) capability practice.
  • Lead the development and implementation of the S&E team strategy to ensure its continued growth, technical excellence and positioning in the marketplace as a trusted advisor.
  • Oversee the successful delivery of projects, ensuring delivery on time, on budget, and to the highest quality.
  • Lead business development and bidding activities for the team, supporting key regional markets such as the Middle East (ME) and liaising with the UK.
  • Ensure the continued commercial success of the S&E team and contribute towards the sustained financial performance (utilization) of the team.
  • Strengthen and expand the team's capabilities, service offerings, project pipeline, and market reputation.
  • Serve as the client-facing lead on selected projects and opportunities in key regional markets, fostering client care, maintaining existing relationships, and cultivating new ones.
  • Ensure ongoing client satisfaction and retention, driving repeat business while also developing new client relationships.

Your role

  • Degree in relevant subject matter expertise (e.g., architecture, engineering, sustainability, environment, etc.)
  • Ideally post-graduate qualifications e.g., master's degree in relevant field.
  • A minimum of 15 years of professional experience in a similar industry, within the consulting environment.
  • Minimum 5 years strong management experience, leading a team of S&E subject matter experts.
  • Accreditation and experience with leading sustainability and environmental standards, including LEED, Estidama, WELL, Envision, BREEAM, Chartered Environmentalist (CEnv), and Certified Energy Manager (CEM). Additional credentials such as Certified Climate Change Professional (CC-P), Certified Environmental Professional (CEP), ISSP Sustainability Excellence Professional (SEP), SITES AP, and Certified Sustainability ESG Practitioner are highly desirable.
  • Proven leadership experience in managing large, multidisciplinary teams across diverse areas of sustainability and environmental services (e.g., sustainability certifications, corporate sustainability and ESG, energy modelling, waste management, climate advisory, environmental assessments, EIAs, etc.).
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrated excellence in providing high-quality client service.
  • Strong track record in leading diverse teams, aligning them with strategic goals, and managing performance and resources effectively.
  • Balance technical expertise with people management skills, including coaching, performance management, and resource allocation. High level of technical expertise with experience in numerous complex and prestigious projects.
  • Collaborate with S&E leads in key regions (e.g., Middle East and UK) to deliver high-quality services and strengthen Atkins Réalis' reputation as a trusted sustainability and environmental partner. Skilled in communicating complex concepts to diverse stakeholders, including clients and regional leadership.
  • Manage multiple client projects and relationships, driving repeat business and identifying new opportunities for growth.
  • Support development of team strategies and creation of detailed plans in collaboration with key regions. Manage resources, budgets, and timelines.
  • Leading creation / implementation of technical innovation to drive efficiencies across the business. Identify market trends, assess potential disruptions, and lead the development of long-term innovation plans.

About you

  • Independently lead and manage the S&E team to support key regional markets, including the ME with supporting the UK.
  • Oversee project execution and task delivery, managing day-to-day operations, team utilization, and resource allocation to meet regional requirements.
  • Ensure technical excellence and high-quality outputs through rigorous review and QA/QC of S&E team's deliverables.
  • Ongoing assessment and consideration of current and potential new service lines within S&E to ensure they are fit-for-purposes and aligned with key market expectations.
  • Provide clear career development pathways for S&E staff, monitor and track performance goals and conduct performance reviews.
  • Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentorship to team members, contributing towards raising & promoting the level of technical excellence.
  • Assess the competency of the S&E team, ensure succession planning is embedded in the team and provide L&D'opportunities including professional membership and chartership.
  • Lead and oversee select projects and bids independently, ensuring strategic alignment and quality delivery.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across Atkins Réalis to support complex regional projects and integrated solutions.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships to drive business growth and generate new opportunities.
  • Foster client retention through proactive engagement and high-quality service delivery.
  • Champion innovation and digital transformation by introducing technologies and process improvements that enhance efficiency and client value, while promoting a forward-thinking approach to sustainable solutions.

Reward & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
  • Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

title: Sustainability Consultant I
jobDescription:
Overview

We have an exciting opportunity for a dynamic and motivated Sustainability Consultant- I. We are seeking candidates who are looking to work on some of the largest and most interesting Sustainability framework and carbon projects in the Middle East (ME), UK and internationally.

Join our Environment and Sustainability Practice to deliver sustainability certifications and sustainability framework projects and assist with the development of sustainability consultancy within the ME and UK Markets for new build and existing buildings and communities. Work spans concept through stages of preconcept to detailed design and procurement, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and clients.

You will operate within a team of sustainability professionals delivering the highest standards of technical work and aiding the continued success of the Sustainability team by being an integral part of our client focused delivery of projects. You'll also get the opportunity to work on exciting and significant projects, delivering quality work that has a positive and lasting influence on the community and the environment.

Your role

  • Effectively convey the sustainability certification program and client requirements to project teams, ensuring alignment and tracking progress throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead and manage the certification process for LEED, WELL, Estidama, and Al Sa'fat, including preparation and submission of required documentation.
  • Possess working knowledge of additional green building frameworks such as Mostadam, GSAS, BREEAM, Envision, and CEEQUAL.
  • Understanding certification requirements, workflows, and submission procedures is highly advantageous.
  • Deliver whole-building/asset LCAs and embodied carbon studies; model scenarios, benchmark options, and generate client-ready insight and visuals.
  • Manage LCA-focused sustainability projects, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality outputs.
  • Collaborate directly with design disciplines to define and embed sustainability interventions to meet certification credits and drive sustainable design.
  • Apply PAS 2080:2023 / RICS WLCA (2nd ed.) and/or similar principles for whole-life carbon management and reporting.
  • Excellent skills in narrative writing for supporting highly rated sustainability projects.
  • Possess the ability to address challenges and devise effective solutions in a timely manner.
  • Review necessary design drawings, materials requirement, specifications, and contractual sustainability documents of the project.
  • Prepare the necessary documentation required to maintain project sustainability KPIs.
  • Prepare sustainability plans, guidelines, procedures, reporting and monitoring trackers, energy simulations & relevant reports.
  • Document clear technical notes, methods, and client presentations.
  • Demonstrate research experience, as this job will likely demand both directed and individual research into architectural materials and technology, building services systems, green building and urban policy, and social and human comfort issues.

About you

  • Holds a Bachelor / Masters level in Engineering, Architecture or Built Environment- related degrees.
  • LEED Accredited Professional.
  • 2–6 years' experience in building certification, LCA/embodied carbon for AEC/infrastructure projects.
  • Must have experience in Full lifecycle of LEED Certification
  • Experience in sustainability building and masterplan certifications (knowledge of rating systems such as LEED, Mostadam, WELL, Estidama, CEEUQAL, is preferred).
  • Experience with developing and implementing sustainability concepts for master planning projects.
  • Experience in building physics modeling, including energy, daylight, comfort, and parametric analysis, with hands-on experience using Design Builder and IES-VE software are advantageous.
  • Understand energy modelling and can interpret modelling results.
  • Experience in life cycle assessments is advantageous.
  • Skilled in liaising with design disciplines and managing relationships across all project phases.
  • Capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously with effective planning to meet deadlines
  • Experienced in managing diverse sustainability aspects of complex design and construction projects, including initiatives aimed at achieving Net-Zero carbon targets.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills in English with the ability to communicate results via Microsoft Power Point, Word, and related software, and craft compelling presentations and reports Flexible and open to work with the wider Environment and Sustainability disciplines. Comfortable working independently Solutions focused.
  • Be Self-motivated, dedicated, and proactive with a passion for detail.
  • Good experience with numerous platforms, including Microsoft Office, In Design, Auto CAD, Rhino and Grasshopper. Knowledge of IES is beneficial.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Accreditations: Estidama PQP, GSAS CGP, Mostadam AP, SITES AP.
  • Technical Skills: Proficient in architectural modeling software such as Revit, Sketch Up, and Rhino.
  • Sustainability Expertise: Experienced in conducting Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) using E-tool or similar platforms.

Reward & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
  • Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

title: Senior Engineer - Balance of Plant
jobDescription:
Overview

In GTC, Transmission & Distribution (T&D) business is part of Infrastructure vertical. T&D business is executing projects in the UK, Middle East, Canada, ANZ & other countries.

T&D business is looking for experienced engineers in Balance of Plant Discipline, as we look to grow the team in line with business requirements. So, if you are interested in working for an internationally renowned consultancy and working on some challenging projects across UK, Middle East, Canada and ANZ region come join us at Atkins Réalis.

Your role

  • Using your experience and knowledge, you will be responsible for the delivery of a variety of projects and making sure it meets our client's'expectations.
  • Preparation of basis of design, electrical design risk assessments, system configuration report etc.
  • Preparing the proposal and man hour estimations.
  • Technical bid evaluation and vendor drawing review.
  • Clash detection and co-ordination with other Utilities.
  • Review design drawings / models developed on software such as Navisworks, Plant 3D, Revit, Civil 3D etc.
  • Preparation of load list, Single Line Diagram (SLD)
  • Transformer, switchgears, Battery / UPS, Emergency generator and other electrical equipment sizing calculations
  • Electrical equipment protection and control including CT/PT sizing, control cable selection and preparation of the IO list.
  • LV and MV cable sizing, Cable Schedule and Routing
  • Preparation of electrical equipment layout and cable tray layout
  • Lightning risk assessment, earthing calculations and layout preparation.
  • Indoor and outdoor lighting calculation and preparation of illumination layout
  • Small power supply system design
  • Cable tray, cable duct, conduit sizing and routing

About you

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering with minimum 8-10 years of relevant detailed design experience in thermal / nuclear and renewable energy sector.
  • Detailed knowledge of power generation and distribution equipment such as Solar PV Cells, BESS, generator, transformer, switchgear, protective relays, cables, motors, battery system, UPS / Inverter / converter is required.
  • Good knowledge of software like Trimble Pro Design (Amtech), ETAP, DIALux evo
  • Familiarity with 2D and 3D BIM environment
  • Good knowledge on IEC / BS / IEEE standards and other international standards.
  • Ability to perform as an individual contributor or lead projects, depending on business needs.
  • Experience in renewable energy sector such as Solar PV / Wind / BESS Plant design
  • Knowledge of PVsyst / Helio Scope is desirable

Behavioural requirements

  • Strong English communication skills
  • Flexibility to be a part of the team which is working at different geographical locations and co-ordinate for the needs of the project.
  • Capability to work under tight deadlines while achieving objectives with the ability to deal with competing priorities and manage time appropriately.
  • Ability to work in Multi-Disciplinary Projects
  • Openness to share knowledge and mentor junior staff.
  • Flexibility to travel for short- and long-term international assignments

Software & design tools

  • Trimble Pro Design
  • ETAP
  • DIALux evo
  • PVsyst / Helio Scope
  • MS Office
  • Auto CAD, Navisworks

title: Technical Director - Civil Structures
jobDescription:
Overview

Shape the Future of our cities and environments.

The Design & Advanced Technology (D&AT) Practice of Atkins Réalis is seeking a Civil Engineering Structures Technical Director to join our team in the UK. We are looking for an energetic and experienced Civil Structures Engineer that can both lead as technical expert in design of heavy civil structures as well as drive forward business results.

Atkins Réalis specialise in all aspects of civil structures engineering within the Energy, Defence, and Nuclear Sectors in the UK and internationally. We're committed to providing industry-leading engineering solutions right through the project lifecycle from feasibility to commissioning, with value added through client-side support as well as construction phases.

As a key member of our technical leadership team, you'll play a vital role in shaping and delivering transformational programmes for critical UK infrastructure, with opportunities to work on landmark engineering projects across the Energy, Defence, and Nuclear sectors – projects like Hinkley Point C, Sizewell C, EPR2, Ministry of Defence Programmes, Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) and more. We're committed to providing industry-leading solutions throughout the project lifecycle, adding value through client-side and construction-phase support.

By providing technical leadership across the organisation you'll drive results, by contributing to functional strategy, influencing senior stakeholders, and leading within the heavy civil structures group and multidisciplinary project teams, to deliver measurable outcomes. In this role, you will set direction for complex, high-impact projects and initiatives, anticipate business and regulatory challenges or changes, and develop innovative solutions and offerings that move the business forward.

Become part of a team where every voice matters, and together we can tackle our clients' toughest challenges. We foster a diverse and inclusive environment where world-class talent thrives without boundaries. For us, collaboration isn't'a buzzword. We value the different perspectives our people bring and recognise everyone for their contributions equally. We also know that different people have different priorities, which is why we're here to support you with whatever you need.

Being a Technical Director with us involves UK wide travel. We offer hybrid working which involves 3 days per week travel/office based. This position can be based at any of our key locations: Epsom, London, Bristol, Exeter, Birmingham, Manchester, Newcastle or Glasgow

Your role

As a Civil Engineering Structures Technical Director in the D&AT Practice, the successful candidate would have the following RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide Technical Leadership within discipline for the national D&AT practice
  • Influence D&AT Practice wide initiatives and recommend best practices to improve internal process and services.
  • Serve as the recognised expert and technical authority in Civil Structural engineering of nuclear related structures across the D&AT Practice and wider Atkins Réalis business.
  • Provide visible representation of your and Atkins Réalis' Civil Structural Engineering technical expertise to our current and prospective clients.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders at all levels, including internal and external clients, operational staff, project teams, or external stakeholders.
  • Recommend and drive improvements to processes, services, and technical practices while ensuring robust engineering governance is consistently upheld.
  • Oversee technical input into bid proposals, defining the delivery strategy and working with cross‑functional teams to prepare high‑quality, compliant, competitive submissions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for cross‑selling and business growth, using commercial insight to strengthen and expand client relationships and selling our value proposition to clients.
  • Grow, develop, and manage the Civil Structures engineering capability, particularly in the context of nuclear energy and defence markets, within the national practice, supporting talent development and succession planning.
  • Anticipate emerging business, regulatory, and technology challenges, identifying risks and opportunities early and advising senior leadership.
  • Provide strategic oversight across multiple complex, multidisciplinary projects, ensuring technical excellence, safe delivery, and alignment with client and practice objectives.
  • Work independently even in the most challenging situations. Act as the point of escalation for the most complex technical matters and exercise personal judgement to find solutions.

About you

The ideal candidate would be a well-rounded and versatile individual who exemplifies the following key skills and attributes:

  • A degree in Civil or Structural Engineering or equivalent
  • Chartered Civil or Structural Engineer
  • Extensive experience in progressively senior technical roles, including significant leadership of complex, high‑risk, cross‑disciplinary projects and programmes.
  • Nationally or international recognised subject matter expertise in your discipline(s).
  • Experience in the nuclear industry is essential.
  • Proven nuclear-sector leadership experience in the analysis and design of nuclear safety-related civil engineering structures
  • Takes broad perspective to identify innovative solutions, challenges the status quo.
  • Comprehensive knowledge in design and analysis of heavy civil engineering structures, including reinforced concrete and steel with experience across all design phases and construction.
  • Expert knowledge of current design codes and standards as well as industry best practices including CDM Regulations, Eurocodes, British Standards, American Codes, etc.
  • Champion continuous improvement, driving enhancements to processes, services, technical standards, and innovation across the practice.
  • Commercially astute, with experience shaping winning proposals and driving practice or business growth.
  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas with clarity, anticipating challenges and persuading senior stakeholders to adopt new perspectives, and navigate diverse, international and cross-cultural delivery.
  • A proactive, highly motivated mindset with a collaborative approach to drive teamwork and shared success across projects and the wider Atkins Réalis D&AT practice.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

About Atkins Réalis

We're Atkins Réalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Find out more.

Additional information

Security clearance

This role may require security clearance and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application or CV, details of any current or previously held security clearance.

So, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements and employee resource groups to support all employees. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures and ability.

description:
Overview

Shape the Future of our cities and environments.

The Design & Advanced Technology (D&AT) Practice of Atkins Réalis is seeking a Civil Engineering Structures Technical Director to join our team in the UK. We are looking for an energetic and experienced Civil Structures Engineer that can both lead as technical expert in design of heavy civil structures as well as drive forward business results.

Atkins Réalis specialise in all aspects of civil structures engineering within the Energy, Defence, and Nuclear Sectors in the UK and internationally. We're committed to providing industry-leading engineering solutions right through the project lifecycle from feasibility to commissioning, with value added through client-side support as well as construction phases.

As a key member of our technical leadership team, you'll play a vital role in shaping and delivering transformational programmes for critical UK infrastructure, with opportunities to work on landmark engineering projects across the Energy, Defence, and Nuclear sectors – projects like Hinkley Point C, Sizewell C, EPR2, Ministry of Defence Programmes, Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) and more. We're committed to providing industry-leading solutions throughout the project lifecycle, adding value through client-side and construction-phase support.

By providing technical leadership across the organisation you'll drive results, by contributing to functional strategy, influencing senior stakeholders, and leading within the heavy civil structures group and multidisciplinary project teams, to deliver measurable outcomes. In this role, you will set direction for complex, high-impact projects and initiatives, anticipate business and regulatory challenges or changes, and develop innovative solutions and offerings that move the business forward.

Become part of a team where every voice matters, and together we can tackle our clients' toughest challenges. We foster a diverse and inclusive environment where world-class talent thrives without boundaries. For us, collaboration isn't'a buzzword. We value the different perspectives our people bring and recognise everyone for their contributions equally. We also know that different people have different priorities, which is why we're here to support you with whatever you need.

Being a Technical Director with us involves UK wide travel. We offer hybrid working which involves 3 days per week travel/office based. This position can be based at any of our key locations: Epsom, London, Bristol, Exeter, Birmingham, Manchester, Newcastle or Glasgow

Your role

As a Civil Engineering Structures Technical Director in the D&AT Practice, the successful candidate would have the following RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide Technical Leadership within discipline for the national D&AT practice
  • Influence D&AT Practice wide initiatives and recommend best practices to improve internal process and services.
  • Serve as the recognised expert and technical authority in Civil Structural engineering of nuclear related structures across the D&AT Practice and wider Atkins Réalis business.
  • Provide visible representation of your and Atkins Réalis' Civil Structural Engineering technical expertise to our current and prospective clients.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders at all levels, including internal and external clients, operational staff, project teams, or external stakeholders.
  • Recommend and drive improvements to processes, services, and technical practices while ensuring robust engineering governance is consistently upheld.
  • Oversee technical input into bid proposals, defining the delivery strategy and working with cross‑functional teams to prepare high‑quality, compliant, competitive submissions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for cross‑selling and business growth, using commercial insight to strengthen and expand client relationships and selling our value proposition to clients.
  • Grow, develop, and manage the Civil Structures engineering capability, particularly in the context of nuclear energy and defence markets, within the national practice, supporting talent development and succession planning.
  • Anticipate emerging business, regulatory, and technology challenges, identifying risks and opportunities early and advising senior leadership.
  • Provide strategic oversight across multiple complex, multidisciplinary projects, ensuring technical excellence, safe delivery, and alignment with client and practice objectives.
  • Work independently even in the most challenging situations. Act as the point of escalation for the most complex technical matters and exercise personal judgement to find solutions.

About you

The ideal candidate would be a well-rounded and versatile individual who exemplifies the following key skills and attributes:

  • A degree in Civil or Structural Engineering or equivalent
  • Chartered Civil or Structural Engineer
  • Extensive experience in progressively senior technical roles, including significant leadership of complex, high‑risk, cross‑disciplinary projects and programmes.
  • Nationally or international recognised subject matter expertise in your discipline(s).
  • Experience in the nuclear industry is essential.
  • Proven nuclear-sector leadership experience in the analysis and design of nuclear safety-related civil engineering structures
  • Takes broad perspective to identify innovative solutions, challenges the status quo.
  • Comprehensive knowledge in design and analysis of heavy civil engineering structures, including reinforced concrete and steel with experience across all design phases and construction.
  • Expert knowledge of current design codes and standards as well as industry best practices including CDM Regulations, Eurocodes, British Standards, American Codes, etc.
  • Champion continuous improvement, driving enhancements to processes, services, technical standards, and innovation across the practice.
  • Commercially astute, with experience shaping winning proposals and driving practice or business growth.
  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas with clarity, anticipating challenges and persuading senior stakeholders to adopt new perspectives, and navigate diverse, international and cross-cultural delivery.
  • A proactive, highly motivated mindset with a collaborative approach to drive teamwork and shared success across projects and the wider Atkins Réalis D&AT practice.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

About Atkins Réalis

We're Atkins Réalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Find out more.

Security clearance

This role may require security clearance and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application or CV, details of any current or previously held security clearance.

title: Technical Manager / Senior Technical Manager.
jobDescription:
Overview

The Senior BIM Leader / BIM Manager will lead and manage BIM and CAD delivery for water and wastewater infrastructure projects within Atkins' Water and Environment business. This role combines technical excellence, team leadership, and strategic BIM implementation to ensure high-quality, compliant, and efficient project outcomes across multidisciplinary teams.

Your Role

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the BIM/CAD function within the Water and Environment discipline.
  • Provide strategic direction and governance for BIM implementation across projects, ensuring alignment with client standards, international BIM mandates, and organizational objectives.
  • Deliver BIM-enabled design solutions for water and wastewater infrastructure projects across planning, design, and construction stages.
  • Oversee the development of project deliverables, including drawings, models, and technical reports, ensuring compliance with scope, budget, quality, and schedule requirements.
  • Act as the BIM subject matter expert, ensuring consistent application of BIM standards, workflows, and best practices.
  • Establish, maintain, and enforce BIM Execution Plans (BEP), CAD/BIM standards, and data management protocols.
  • Lead and mentor BIM Managers, Coordinators, Designers, and Technicians; train and onboard new team members.
  • Coordinate closely with Project Managers, Design Engineers, and subconsultants to ensure integrated project delivery.
  • Review and approve BIM/CAD outputs, resolving technical issues and improving efficiency and accuracy.
  • Drive innovation, continuous improvement, and adoption of new BIM technologies, tools, and processes.
  • Support project bids, proposals, and capability statements related to BIM and digital engineering.
  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure delivery is compliant with health, safety, quality, and environmental standards.
  • Interface directly with clients to represent BIM capabilities and deliver client-focused solutions.

Technical Competencies

  • Expert-level knowledge of BIM and CAD standards, workflows, and data environments.
  • Proficient in:
    • Civil 3D alignments, parcels, feature lines, corridors, surfaces, labels, and data references.
    • Roadway design including corridors, subassemblies, FG design, grading, contours, and surface cleanup.
    • Utility design in plan and profile, including pipe networks, manholes, catch basins, hydrants, cover requirements, spacing standards, and jurisdictional codes.
    • Mathematical calculations involving geometry, algebra, trigonometry, ratios, and proportions.
  • Ability to review, interpret, and develop design concepts from sketches, redlines, and engineering inputs.
  • Strong capability in evaluating engineering alternatives and resolving complex technical challenges.

Project & Leadership Skills

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute work safely, efficiently, and cost-effectively.
  • Manage engineering plans, project documentation, and digital deliverables.
  • Coordinate and review the work of subconsultants and offshore delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines while maintaining quality and accuracy.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.

Communication & Cultural Awareness

  • Excellent written and spoken English, suitable for a professional, client-facing environment.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across geographies, cultures, and disciplines.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build rapport and credibility with clients and project teams.

About you

Qualifications & Experience

  • Diploma or BTech in Civil Engineering from a recognized institution.
  • 15+ years of experience in Auto CAD Civil 3D, Revit, and AVEVA E3D, with extensive involvement in water and wastewater infrastructure projects.
  • Proven experience in a BIM leadership or BIM management role within large, multidisciplinary projects.
  • Strong background in detailing and modeling of water and wastewater assets, including pipelines, pump stations, treatment plants, utilities, and roadway interfaces.
  • Experience working with international clients and complying with varied jurisdictional and regulatory requirements.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

title: Mechanical Engineer design - Hydropower
jobDescription:
Overview

Responsible for the design, analysis, and coordination of mechanical systems for hydropower plants, including turbine-generator units, governors, MIV, EOT cranes, and balance-of-plant systems (cooling water, drainage/dewatering, HVAC, fire protection, compressed air).

Your role

To perform the role successfully, the candidate will be responsible for but not limited to the following independently or under the supervision of senior engineers. They will need to perform the following for the hydropower plant turbine-generator units, governors, MIV, EOT cranes and balance of plant systems such as cooling water, drainage-dewatering, HVAC, fire protection and compressed air systems.

  • Design analysis and calculations for selection and sizing of turbines and mechanical balance of plant equipment.
  • Prepare technical and performance specifications and work with vendors for the equipment supply contracts.
  • Prepare design basis memoranda, technical memoranda, and reports, and coordinate report preparation within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Work with drafting technicians to prepare design drawings and conceptual / tender level drawings.
  • Prepare Bills of Materials and cost estimation.
  • Review manufactures drawings, calculations, specifications and test reports.
  • Preparation of testing and commissioning procedures.
  • Preparation and review of as-built/ record/ closeout drawings and documents.
  • Preparation and review of quality assurance procedures, performing inspections at vendor's workshops.
  • Work effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team, coordinating with civil, electrical, and other mechanical engineers.
  • Work effectively with peers, junior engineers and other discipline designers to ensure accurate delivery that will meet utility Standards, industry standards and meet good engineering practices, policies and procedures.

About you

  • A bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from a recognized Institution.
  • A minimum of 7 to 12 years of experience in the hydroelectric industry with specific experience in turbine-generator units, balance of plant and/ or heavy mechanical equipment.
  • Knowledge of ASME, ASTM, IEC, ASHRAE, NFPA, USBR and other codes, standards, and regulatory requirements relevant to the work.

Power Grid Division is involved in electricity utilities sector in the UK & I, Canada, US, ME and APAC. We provide value-added engineering services and build solutions across the entire spectrum of electricity networks, from high voltage power transmission grids to low voltage industrial power distribution. We have designed HV Substations up to 400k V and Electrical infrastructure for large industrial/ Multi Use developments and Heavy industries. The team provides services to clients across the globe; however, the major clients are in UK and Middle East.

The Power T&D team is looking for experienced Principal engineers in HV Plant Discipline, as we are looking to grow the team in line with business requirements. So, if you are interested in working for an internationally renowned consultancy and working on some challenging projects across UK, Canada & ANZ, come join us at Atkins Réalis.

We are looking for experienced engineers for middle level role in 'Civils & Structures' design for transmission and distribution projects as we look to grow the team in line with business requirements. So, if you are interested in working for an internationally renowned consultancy and working on some of the challenging projects across Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) come and join us at Atkins Réalis.

Using your experience and knowledge, you will be leading the delivery of a variety of projects drawing upon the wider team for the technical engineering requirements and building a strong relationship with our clients. title: Sustainability Consultant I
jobDescription:
Overview

We have an exciting opportunity for a dynamic and motivated Sustainability Consultant- II. We are seeking candidates who are looking to work on some of the largest and most interesting Sustainability framework and carbon projects in the Middle East (ME), UK and internationally.

Join our Environment and Sustainability Practice to deliver sustainability certifications and sustainability framework projects and assist with the development of sustainability consultancy within the ME and UK Markets for new build and existing buildings and communities. Work spans concept through stages of preconcept to detailed design and procurement, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and clients.

You will operate within a team of sustainability professionals delivering the highest standards of technical work and aiding the continued success of the Sustainability team by being an integral part of our client focused delivery of projects. You'll also get the opportunity to work on exciting and significant projects, delivering quality work that has a positive and lasting influence on the community and the environment.

This position offers a flexible hybrid work arrangement, allowing a blend of home and office working.

Your role

  • Effectively convey the sustainability certification program and client requirements to project teams, ensuring alignment and tracking progress throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead and manage the certification process for LEED, WELL, Estidama, and Al Sa'fat, including preparation and submission of required documentation.
  • Possess working knowledge of additional green building frameworks such as Mostadam, GSAS, BREEAM, Envision, and CEEQUAL.
  • Understanding certification requirements, workflows, and submission procedures is highly advantageous.
  • Deliver whole-building/asset LCAs and embodied carbon studies; model scenarios, benchmark options, and generate client-ready insight and visuals.
  • Manage LCA-focused sustainability projects, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality outputs.
  • Collaborate directly with design disciplines to define and embed sustainability interventions to meet certification credits and drive sustainable design.
  • Apply PAS 2080:2023 / RICS WLCA (2nd ed.) and/or similar principles for whole-life carbon management and reporting.
  • Excellent skills in narrative writing for supporting highly rated sustainability projects.
  • Possess the ability to address challenges and devise effective solutions in a timely manner.
  • Review necessary design drawings, materials requirement, specifications, and contractual sustainability documents of the project.
  • Prepare the necessary documentation required to maintain project sustainability KPIs.
  • Prepare sustainability plans, guidelines, procedures, reporting and monitoring trackers, energy simulations & relevant reports.
  • Document clear technical notes, methods, and client presentations.
  • Demonstrate research experience, as this job will likely demand both directed and individual research into architectural materials and technology, building services systems, green building and urban policy, and social and human comfort issues.

About you

  • Holds a Bachelor / Masters level in Engineering, Architecture or Built Environment- related degrees.
  • LEED Accredited Professional.
  • Minimum 6 years' experience in building certification, LCA/embodied carbon for AEC/infrastructure projects.
  • Experience in sustainability building and masterplan certifications (knowledge of rating systems such as LEED, Mostadam, WELL, Estidama, CEEUQAL, is preferred).
  • Experience with developing and implementing sustainability concepts for master planning projects.
  • Must have experience in Full lifecycle of LEED Certification
  • Experience in building physics modeling, including energy, daylight, comfort, and parametric analysis, with hands-on experience using Design Builder and IES-VE software are advantageous.
  • Understand energy modelling and can interpret modelling results.
  • Experience in life cycle assessments is advantageous.
  • Skilled in liaising with design disciplines and managing relationships across all project phases.
  • Capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously with effective planning to meet deadlines.
  • Experienced in managing diverse sustainability aspects of complex design and construction projects, including initiatives aimed at achieving Net-Zero carbon targets.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills in English with the ability to communicate results via Microsoft Power Point, Word, and related software, and craft compelling presentations and reports Flexible and open to work with the wider Environment and Sustainability disciplines. Comfortable working independently Solutions focused.
  • Be Self-motivated, dedicated, and proactive with a passion for detail.
  • Good experience with numerous platforms, including Microsoft Office, In Design, Auto CAD, Rhino and Grasshopper. Knowledge of IES is beneficial.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

Desirable but not essential

  • Accreditations: Estidama PQP, GSAS CGP, Mostadam AP, SITES AP
  • Technical Skills: Proficient in architectural modeling software such as Revit, Sketch Up, and Rhino
  • Sustainability Expertise: Experienced in conducting Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) using E-tool or similar platforms

Reward & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

Comprehensive life insurance coverage.

• Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.

• Generous annual leave balance.

The Junior Environmental Scientist/Technician role will support Site Assessment & Remediation type projects by largely assisting with and learning fundamental tasks related to Phase I and II Environmental Site Assessments, including groundwater monitoring and sampling, and remedial excavation. title: Senior Engineer - Digital Workplace Services
jobDescription:
Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

What will you do?

We are looking for a skilled Sr. Engineer to develop and support Windows application packaging (Win32, MSI, Power Shell), Scripting developing knowledge on Power Shell, PSADT, vulnerability remediation, automation scripting and patching enterprise endpoint environments. The role requires hands-on experience in modern workplace technologies, endpoint security, application lifecycle management, and scripting-based automation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Packing the Application (Critical, Medium, Low) and delivering through Microsoft Intune services and other tools.
  • Create, test, package, and deploy Windows applications (MSI, EXE, MSIX, Win32 applications).
  • Develop and maintain Power Shell scripts for automation, reporting, and operational efficiency.
  • Application Deployments integrated with PSADT
  • Administer and support Microsoft Intune for Windows endpoint management and device compliance.
  • Manage Mobile Device Management (MDM) and Mobile Application Management (MAM) policies.
  • Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot applications through Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager.
  • Perform application lifecycle management including upgrades, patching, and retirement.
  • Create Remediation script for patch compliance, Vulnerability Management.
  • Review, analysis, and remediate endpoint vulnerabilities identified through security assessment tools.
  • Configure and support Windows Autopilot deployments and provisioning profiles.
  • Monitor endpoint health, compliance status, and patching effectiveness across the estate.
  • Configure security baselines, compliance policies, conditional access integration, and endpoint protection settings.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.
  • Participate in endpoint modernization, security enhancement, and digital workplace transformation initiatives.
  • Manage Incident/ Change request aligned with ITIL process.
  • Create and maintain weekly/Monthly reports related to your tower.

Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 7-8 years of experience in Endpoint Management and Modern Workplace technologies.
  • Hands-on experience in Windows application packaging and deployment methodologies.
  • Proficiency in Power Shell scripting for automation and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of vulnerability management and remediation processes.
  • Experience with Windows Autopilot, Azure AD/Entra ID, device enrollment, and compliance management.
  • Experience managing Windows 10 and Windows 11 enterprise environments.
  • Knowledge of endpoint security controls, compliance standards, and Microsoft security best practices.
  • Experience in working ITIL processes, incident management, and change management.
  • Certifications preferred: Microsoft Intune Administrator (MD-102), Microsoft Endpoint Administrator, AZ-104, or other relevant Microsoft certifications.

What we offer:

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits,

  • 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year.

  • Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression

  • When it comes to diversity and inclusion, we see things differently at Linxon - we encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations and more - so whoever you are, we hope you'll see things our way, too.

About Linxon

Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity.

Linxon's vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects.

As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a new company as it evolves and help shape it for the future. If you like new challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are interested in working with other motivated professionals with expertise in the Substations EPC business, then this is the new opportunity for you.

title: Civil Lead Designer
jobDescription:
Overview

Our Transmission & Distribution (T&D) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. We support integration of renewables, digital engineering, and global compliance standards to ensure reliable and sustainable energy delivery.

The BIM team drives digital transformation by creating accurate 3D models, enabling clash detection, and supporting Scan-to-BIM workflows. Opportunities include advanced modelling, project coordination, automation using tools like Dynamo, and collaboration on global projects—ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and multidisciplinary design.

Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Civil BIM Designer with 5 to 15 years of Substation experience with Revit to join our Bangalore office. This role involves working on single and multi-disciplinary Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), focusing on delivering high-quality BIM and CAD outputs that meet international standards. The role spans Power Generation, Transmission & Distribution (T&D), Renewables, Infrastructure, and Nuclear domains.

Your role

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead drawing and modelling production as a BIM coordinator for Electrical/Civil systems.
  • Prepare SLDs, control schemes, layouts, 3D models, and hazardous area classifications.
  • Develop substation layouts and infrastructure drawings including power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
  • Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.
  • Engage in BIM and Scan-to-BIM workflows.
  • Support project setup, customization, and delivery tracking.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • We are seeking a highly experienced CAD/BIM professional with:
  • Multidisciplinary exposure across Electrical, Civil, Structural, and Mechanical domains.
  • Proven leadership skills and the ability to mentor junior staff and manage teams effectively.
  • A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
  • Hands-on experience in Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), including project setup in Revit, layout preparation, support structure modelling, concrete structures reinforcement detailing, power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
  • Familiarity with National Grid standards is a significant advantage.
  • Proficiency in Revit, Auto CAD, Microstation, Dynamo, and other BIM-related tools.
  • Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC) and experience with Scan-to-BIM workflows.
  • Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.

About you

Technical Competencies

Essential

  • Proficiency in Revit, Auto CAD, Microstation, Dynamo.
  • Strong understanding of CAD/BIM standards and drawing protocols.
  • Ability to prepare and check complex drawings.
  • Familiarity with Electrical/Structural/Mechanical design basics.
  • Experience with EDMS and drawing control protocols.
  • Capable of implementing GDC BMS & QSE procedures.
  • Knowledge of project programming and resource utilization.

Desirable

  • Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).
  • Experience with 3D modelling and BIM standards.
  • Familiarity with BEP and Xrefs.

Behavioural Competencies

  • Strong communication and report-writing skills.
  • Team-oriented with leadership potential.
  • Detail-oriented and quality-focused.
  • Capable of giving and receiving clear instructions.
  • Proactive in career development and team contribution.
  • Assertive and responsive to client requirements.
  • Able to manage and motivate teams effectively.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage
  • Medical insurance for you and your dependents
  • Annual leave balance in accordance with local labour law
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions
  • Opportunity for local and global internal transfers
  • Company gratuity scheme
  • Discretionary bonus program
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition

title: P&C Electrical Designer/Lead Designer
jobDescription:
Overview

Our Transmission & Distribution (T&D) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization.

The Protection & Control (P&C) Design team plays a critical role in ensuring the safe operation, monitoring, automation, and protection of power system assets. The team develops engineering designs for 11k V,33k V,132k V,275Kv and 400k V substations, including protection schemes, control systems. Opportunities include working on complex international projects, developing detailed engineering deliverables, supporting multidisciplinary coordination, and driving design excellence through digital engineering tools and industry best practices. This role is ideal for professionals passionate about substation protection and control engineering, electrical system reliability, digital transformation, and delivering innovative solutions for the evolving energy sector.

Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical Protection & Control (P&C) Lead Designer with 5–10 years of substation design experience and strong proficiency in Auto CAD to join our Bangalore office. This role involves supporting the delivery of Protection & Control engineering and CAD deliverables for 132 k V to 400 k V AIS and GIS substations, covering both greenfield and brownfield projects across domestic and international markets.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing high-quality P&C design outputs, including protection schematics, control and relay panel drawings, wiring diagrams, interconnection diagrams, AC/DC schematics, cable schedules, and Substation documentation. Working closely with Protection Engineers and multidisciplinary project teams, the role requires ensuring compliance with international standards, client specifications, and project quality requirements.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to complex projects across Power Generation, Transmission & Distribution (T&D), Renewable Energy and nuclear sectors, while supporting the digital transformation of substations through modern engineering practices and innovative design solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical understanding of substation protection and control systems, excellent drafting skills, and a commitment to delivering engineering excellence.

Your role

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare Protection & Control (P&C) deliverables for 132 k V to 400 k V AIS/GIS substations
  • Develop SLDs, KLDs, AC/DC schematics, LVAC/LVDC diagrams, tripping schemes, relay wiring diagrams, panel layouts and cable schedules.
  • Prepare interface/interconnection diagrams, terminal block drawings, SCADA/SCS drawings, communication drawings and As-Built documentation.
  • Develop transformer, feeder and busbar protection drawings in accordance with project requirements.
  • Develop Control & Protection Bay Control Drawings, Relay Panel Drawings, DC Distribution Schemes, AC Auxiliary Schemes, RTU/SCADA Drawings, SCS Drawings, LAN/Fiber Network Drawings, Cable Routing & Termination Drawings, As-Built Documentation.
  • Develop and maintain engineering drawings using Auto CAD and other approved CAD tools in accordance with project and client standards.
  • Coordinate with Protection, Primary, Civil, Telecom, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to support project delivery.
  • Support design reviews, drawing updates, revisions, and preparation of As-Built documentation.
  • Perform self-checks and quality reviews to ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of engineering documentation.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
  • Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • We are seeking an experienced Protection & Control (P&C) Lead Designer with:
  • Proven experience in 132k V to 400k V AIS/GIS Substation Protection & Control design for both Greenfield and Brownfield projects.
  • Strong knowledge of protection schemes, control systems, SCADA, SAS, and IEC 61850-based substations.
  • Proficiency in Auto CAD and Raster Design; exposure to Micro Station, Revit, or other engineering design tools is advantageous and experience in preparing protection schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, interconnection diagrams, and cable schedules.
  • Good understanding of IEC, IEEE, utility, and client-specific standards related to substation design.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with Protection Engineers, Primary, Civil, Telecom, and multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Experience in preparing, checking, and reviewing P&C drawings while ensuring quality, accuracy, and compliance with project requirements.
  • A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
  • Familiarity with National Grid (UK) standards is a significant advantage.
  • Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
  • Exposure to international substation projects and utility standards is an advantage.
  • Strong technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to mentor junior designers and support project delivery.

About you

Technical Competencies

Essential

  • Proficiency in Auto CAD & Raster Design
  • Excellent drafting and detailing skills.
  • Strong understanding of substation protection and control systems.
  • Strong understanding of CAD/P&C standards and drawing protocols.
  • Ability to prepare and check P&C Interface drawings.
  • Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD standards, project procedures, and drawing control requirements

Desirable

  • Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).
  • Experience in 132 k V, 220 k V, and 400 k V AIS/GIS substation Protection & Control design projects.
  • Experience in greenfield and brownfield substation projects.
  • Proficiency in Auto CAD; exposure to Raster Design, Micro Station, Revit, or other electrical CAD tools is advantageous.

Behavioural Competencies

  • Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, accuracy, and compliance.
  • Ability to work independently and mentor junior designers.
  • Proactive, accountable, and capable of managing multiple priorities.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Collaborative team player with leadership potential.
  • Responsive to client requirements and project deadlines.
  • Committed to continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and engineering excellence.
  • Ability to manage, motivate, and support design teams effectively.

Rewards & benefits

This includes:

  • Medical insurance for you and your dependents
  • Annual leave balance in accordance with local labour law
