title: Oracle Systems Administrator
jobDescription:
Overview

The Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) System Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, security, performance, and availability of Oracle E-Business Suite environments. The role ensures stable and secure operation of Oracle EBS applications and supporting technology stack, manages system configurations and patches, supports upgrades and integrations, and collaborates with infrastructure, database, security, and application teams to deliver reliable Finance and Enterprise services.

This role is critical in maintaining operational excellence, minimizing system downtime, supporting audit and compliance requirements, and enabling continuous improvement across Oracle EBS platforms.

Your role

  • Administer and maintain Oracle E-Business Suite environments across Development, Test, UAT, Pre-Production, and Production.
  • Manage Oracle EBS application tier components, including Web Logic, Forms, Reports, Concurrent Processing, Workflow, and OAF technologies.
  • Perform Oracle EBS cloning, patching, upgrades, technology stack maintenance, and post-deployment validation activities.
  • Manage system configurations, profiles, responsibilities, menus, security accounts, and application access controls.
  • Monitor application availability, performance, capacity, and interface processing to proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Support deployment of application releases, customizations, integrations, and environment refresh activities.
  • Manage and troubleshoot concurrent managers, workflows, output processing, notifications, and scheduled jobs.
  • Collaborate with MSP DBA team, infrastructure teams, cloud teams, and application support teams to maintain platform stability and performance.
  • Lead root cause analysis activities for incidents and recurring issues, implementing corrective and preventative actions.
  • Ensure Oracle Critical Patch Updates (CPU), security fixes, and technology stack updates are implemented in accordance with organizational standards.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts for routine administration, deployment, and monitoring activities.
  • Support disaster recovery planning, backup validation, business continuity testing, and recovery exercises.
  • Maintain system documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and support knowledge articles.
  • Support IT General Controls (ITGC), audit requirements, segregation of duties controls, and security compliance activities.
  • Participate in change, release, incident, problem, and environment management processes aligned with ITIL practices.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to support analysts, administrators, and project teams.

About you

  • Extensive experience administering Oracle E-Business Suite R12.2 environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Oracle EBS architecture and technology stack.
  • Experience with
  • Oracle Web Logic Server
  • Oracle Application Server technologies
  • Oracle Forms and Reports
  • Oracle Workflow
  • Oracle XML Publisher (BI Publisher)
  • Oracle Concurrent Processing
  • Oracle OAF Framework
  • Experience performing:
  • Online patching (ADOP)
  • EBS cloning and refreshes
  • Environment provisioning
  • Application patching and upgrades
  • Performance monitoring and troubleshooting
  • Understanding of Oracle Database architecture and DBA concepts.
  • Knowledge of Linux/Unix administration and shell scripting.
  • Experience using automation and deployment tools.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
  • Understanding of ITIL Service Management processes.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

title: Geotechnical Senior Design Manager
jobDescription:
Overview

We currently have an outstanding opportunity for experienced Geotechnical Engineers in our rapidly expanding team in Bangalore GTC. An ideal opportunity for individuals looking to develop their international experience by working with a multidiscipline team of Geotechnical Engineers providing a comprehensive design service to our clients.

Your role

  • The successful applicant will be a senior geotechnical engineer with a proven technical and project management track record.
  • A strong academic background with degree in Civil engineering and master's degree or Ph D in Geotechnical Engineering or Equivalent
  • Ability to lead project teams.
  • With minimum 12-14 years of relevant design experience.
  • Proven experience of acting as a geotechnical engineer in a fast-moving engineering consultancy environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal and technical skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and confidence to liaise with international clients.
  • Good commercial track record in negotiating and running jobs successfully.
  • Excellent report writing skills with the ability to check and produce accurate work.
  • A flair for innovation and sustainability.
  • A willingness to travel on short term assignments both within India and overseas
  • Degree in Civil Engineering.
  • Professional Engineer, P.Eng. from US/ Canada Regions.
  • Master's Degree Ph D in Geotechnical Engineering or Equivalent with appropriate and sufficient experience in the field of geotechnical engineering in a fast-moving engineering consultancy environment.
  • Candidates will be asked to show how their experience demonstrates ability to:
  • Strong work experience in UK, US, Canada and Middle East Regions Transportation and Infrastructure Projects.
  • Analytical skills to assess complex problems and deliver appropriate solutions.
  • Design of modular and embedded retaining walls, slope stability analysis & pile group analysis.
  • Conversant with geotechnical analysis software like PLAXIS 2D/3D, GEOSTUDIO SUITE, WALLAP or FREW, PDISP and REPUTE..
  • Experience of soil structure interaction work and numerical analysis would be an advantage.
  • Experience of providing digital and sustainable solutions on the projects.

About you

  • Professional Engineer (PE) or Chartered Engineer certification, C.Eng or equivalent
  • Experience in large-scale infrastructure projects (roads, bridges, tunnels, ports, etc.).
  • Familiarity with local geotechnical codes and international standards.
  • Demonstrated leadership in managing teams and coordinating with stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and spoken English within a business environment.

Reward & benefits

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.

  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.

jobDescription:
Overview

Power Grid Division is involved in electricity utilities sector in the UK & I, Canada, US, ME and APAC. We provide value-added engineering services and built solutions across the entire spectrum of electricity networks, from high voltage power transmission grids to low voltage industrial power distribution. We have designed HV Substations upto 400k V and Electrical infrastructure for large industrial/ Multi Use developments and Heavy industries. The team provides services to clients across the globe, however the major clients are in UK and Middle East.

The Power T&D team is looking for experienced Sr. Principal engineers in HV Plant Discipline, as we look to grow the team in line with business requirements. So, if you are interested in working for an internationally renowned consultancy and working on some challenging projects across UK, Canada & ANZ, come join us at Atkins Réalis

Your role

Responsibilities

  • Using your experience and knowledge, you will be leading the delivery of a variety of projects drawing upon the wider team for the technical engineering requirements and building a strong relationship with our clients.
  • You will be client-facing, responsible for the delivery of our work and making sure it meets our client's'expectations.
  • You will be taking up the following RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Experience of undertaking FEED or Detailed design of HV and EHV (132k V to 765k V) AIS , GIS and HVDC Substations
  • Produce design drawings & documentation for Front End Engineering Design (FEED) such as Protection Single Line Diagram (or) Key Line Diagram (KLD), Work Specification, Assessment of requirement for Auxiliary Systems etc.
  • Complete Detailed Design Deliverables – Circuit Diagrams, Wiring Diagrams, Cable Schedules, Cable Block Diagrams, General Arrangement Diagrams, Termination Schedules etc.
  • Interface substation auxiliary systems and other equipment with Protection & Control Systems
  • Complete design calculations – LVAC & DC System Sizing, CT & VT adequacy checks, Cable Sizing etc.
  • You could also be working on Fault Current Calculations, Relay Settings and IED Configuration based on the skill set and project requirements.
  • Report Writing Skills.
  • Preparation of bid documents and bid evaluations.
  • Ensure interdisciplinary coordination.
  • Contribute to Tendering activities by supporting with preliminary design documentation & drawings, Bill of Quantities, Engineering Man Hour Estimates etc.
  • Lead P&C design on a project and engage with junior engineers & graduate engineers.
  • Mentoring other engineers and help them become better engineers.
  • Manage the team and actively involve in finding the requirements of engineers and find ways to fulfil.
  • Provide engineering support and solve queries during construction, testing and commissioning, attend site meetings and inspections.

About you

Qualification

  • Graduate/Post-Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering with around 15+ years of experience in Design of Protection & Control Systems.
  • Hands-on Experience in design of protection systems applied to Busbars, Feeders, Transformers, Reactors, Bus Section, Bus Couplers, Reactors etc. on the 132k V and above systems.
  • Appreciation for the principles of Current & Voltage Transformers, Auto Reclose, Circuit Breaker Fail & Plant Auto Switching arrangements.
  • Ability to complete design deliverables – Single Line Diagram (SLD) & Protection SLD (or) Key Line Diagram (KLD); Circuit Diagrams, Wiring Diagrams, General Arrangement Diagrams, Cable Schedules, Cable Block Diagrams and Termination Schedules etc.
  • Ability to produce design documentation – Design Basis Report, Case Studies and Project Design Specification.
  • Be competent to review/approve the design drawings & documents produced by other engineers.
  • Member of IET & working towards Chartered Engineer accreditation.
  • Desirable
  • Experience as Commissioning engineer will be added advantage.
  • Experience of working UK National Grid / SSEN substation projects / EPC Contractor.

Behavioural requirements

  • Strong English Communication Skills needed to co-ordinate with client and other internal stake holders.
  • Be a part of the team which is working at different geographical locations and co-ordinate for the needs of the project.
  • Flexibility to travel to client sites when required.
  • Capability to work under tight deadlines while achieving objectives with the ability to deal with competing priorities and manage time appropriately.
  • To provide support and advice to members the team, this may also include line management responsibilities. Atkins Réalis focus is on developing our staff to realise their full potential, with development plans geared to individual needs and abilities.

Software & Design Tools

  • MS Office
  • Auto CAD 2D
  • Trimble (Amtech) - Desirable
  • ETAP/PSCAD – Desirable

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

About Atkins Réalis

We're Atkins Réalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Job Title: Project Engineer-Primary

Job Location: Chennai, India

Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

The Project Engineer – OPC will be a member of Linxon GETS-Chennai Engineering Team and will contribute towards the effective operation of project unit.

The Project Engineer – OPC will work on project/Tender specific activities assigned to the OPC group along with skilled team on a wide range of international T&D substation projects. Individual contributors using prior theoretical learning or knowledge of methods and technologies to execute work assignments using established solutions.

The position provides design for engineering discipline across multiple engineering projects within the OPC. Complete the assignments on multiple projects of moderate size or portions of major projects, cost-effectively and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards. Highest quality standards are applied, and safety requirements are taken into consideration.

What will you do?

  • Evaluates, selects and applies standard techniques and procedures to perform engineering assignments. Provides technical support for installation and commissioning activities. Prepares project documentation within one's scope of deliverables.
  • Develop the tender engineering deliverable in short time with quality
  • Secure the completeness of the assigned packages and correct function of the resulting substation system.
  • Confirm the engineering is developed, taken into consideration the complete information and all inter discipline checks has been conducted, the results are documented in the project specific storage area.
  • Solves problems that appear during engineering development.
  • Focus on cost-efficient system solutions
  • Report and keep records for all engineering changes. Cooperate with the engineering team and agree on the project specific impacts, caused by the changes.
  • Ensure compliance with Linxon and Client engineering guidelines, standards and quality across the complete engineering process.
  • Creates work plans and cost estimates in own area of responsibility.
  • Co-ordinates clarify with engineers, sub-contractors and suppliers' technical issues (within the assigned scope of work) and technical interfaces.
  • Collaborate with the site team, attend site during construction phase if necessary.
  • Contribute to the risk & opportunity register, by communicating observations.

Experience and Education Required:

  • 6-10 years of experience in substation design with focus on HV Equipment expertise and overall system design.
  • Bachelor's Degree / master's degree in electrical / Power Engineering.
  • Sound knowledge on engineering of AIS & GIS transmission and distribution substation up to 500k V.
  • Should have sound knowledge in BESS and if worked in BESS projects will give an advantage.
  • Wide knowledge on ANSI / IEEE standards is preferred.
  • Knowledge on NESC, NFPA 70, NFPA 780, NFPA 850 standards for substation engineering is desired.

What we offer:

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits,

  • 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year.

  • Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression

  • When it comes to diversity and inclusion, we see things differently at Linxon - we encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations and more - so whoever you are, we hope you'll see things our way, too.

Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity.

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon.

Linxon's vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects.

As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a new company as it evolves and help shape it for the future. jobDescription:
Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

We are seeking an experienced SAP Success Factors Super Administrator / HRIS Specialist with strong expertise in system administration, backend configuration, and end-to-end setup across SAP Success Factors. The role will act as a key Success Factors super admin and configuration owner while also supporting day-to-day HR operations as a member of the HRC / HR Operations team. The successful candidate will participate in the Success Factors implementation phase, support ongoing enhancements, and contribute to other HRIS and HR-related activities as required.

This position requires a hands-on profile with solid HR process understanding, strong system configuration capability, and the ability to work closely with HR, IT, implementation partners, and business stakeholders.

What will you do?

1. Success Factors Administration & Backend Configuration

  • Act as a Success Factors Super Administrator and key point of contact for system configuration and administration.

  • Configure, maintain, and optimize Success Factors settings to support business requirements and HR processes.

  • Manage Foundation Objects, MDF Objects, Business Rules, Workflows, Event Reasons, Picklists, Employee Files, and Role-Based Permissions.

  • Maintain and support data models, corporate data models, succession data models, and XML configurations where applicable.

  • Support system enhancements, release updates, testing, and deployment activities across the Success Factors landscape.

  • Troubleshoot complex system issues and coordinate resolution with internal teams, IT, vendors, and implementation partners.

2. HR Operations & HRC Support

  • Act as an active member of the HRC / HR Operations team and support day-to-day HR operations through Success Factors.

  • Process and maintain employee lifecycle transactions including hiring, onboarding, employee data changes, transfers, promotions, organizational changes, and terminations.

  • Ensure timely and accurate maintenance of employee, position, reporting line, organizational, and employment data in Success Factors.

  • Support HR users, managers, and employees by resolving system-related queries and providing practical guidance.

  • Monitor data quality and take corrective actions to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with HR governance requirements.

  • Support operational HR activities, reporting requests, and administrative actions linked to Success Factors and related HR systems.

3. Success Factors Implementation & Project Support

  • Participate in all phases of Success Factors implementation, including design workshops, requirements gathering, configuration review, data preparation, testing, migration, cutover, go-live, and post-go-live stabilization.

  • Work with implementation partners, HR stakeholders, IT, and business users to translate HR requirements into system configuration and process design.

  • Support User Acceptance Testing, regression testing, defect tracking, issue resolution, and release validation.

  • Contribute to documentation of business processes, configuration decisions, system procedures, and user guides.

  • Assist in data migration activities including template preparation, validation, cleansing, and reconciliation.

  • Support change management activities, user communication, training support, and adoption of new Success Factors processes.

4. Security, Access & Governance

  • Administer Role-Based Permissions, permission roles, permission groups, security access, and system authorization structures.

  • Manage user access requests, role changes, and security updates in line with company governance and control requirements.

  • Conduct periodic access reviews and support audit requirements related to Success Factors security and data access.

  • Maintain system documentation, configuration logs, and change-control records for key system updates.

Experience and Education Required:

  • 5-7 years of hands-on SAP Success Factors experience.

  • Strong experience in a Super Admin, System Administrator, HRIS Specialist, or Success Factors Configuration Consultant role.

  • Strong configuration knowledge in Employee Central and related Success Factors platform components.

  • Experience with all Success Factors modules such as Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Goals, Compensation, Succession & Development, Learning, and Time Off.

  • Hands-on experience with Role-Based Permissions, MDF Objects, Business Rules, Workflows, Foundation Objects, Picklists, and data imports/exports.

  • Practical experience supporting day-to-day HR operations through Success Factors.

  • Experience participating in Success Factors implementation, enhancement, migration, testing, or stabilization projects.

  • Good understanding of HR processes, employee lifecycle management, organizational management, and HR data governance.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced HR systems environment.

What we offer:

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits,

  • 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year.

  • Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression

  • When it comes to diversity and inclusion, we see things differently at Linxon - we encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations and more - so whoever you are, we hope you'll see things our way, too.

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to global HR operations and multi-country HR environments.
  • Experience working on HR system implementations, upgrades, or optimizations.

Our Transmission & Distribution (T&D) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. We support integration of renewables, digital engineering, and global compliance standards to ensure reliable and sustainable energy delivery.

title: Advisor - Talent Sourcing (North America)
jobDescription:
Overview

We are 270+ talents operating under one Hub, diversified into different process groups Recruitment, Lifecyle, Offboarding, Service Excellence and Contact Management.

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. The future focussed HR organisation largely possess a strong Onshore Partnering Team and the Centre of Excellence, complimented by a robust Service Delivery Team offering top class services to employees from the HR People Hub, Bangalore.

The Sourcing Centre of Expertise as an integral part of the Recruitment Shared Service and supports the Atkins Réalis Global business in all aspects of Talent acquisition and candidate selection. We are seeking a Senior Advisor – Talent Sourcing to join our Bangalore based HR Centre. They will be working in partnership with Global Recruitment Teams to create talent pools (talent communities) and identify candidates for engineering and related technical positions for geographies spanning Canada.

Your role

  • Create, maintain and strengthen contact with talent communities for both active and passive candidates within Atkins Réalis core engineering skill sets for Canada region.
  • Act as a CRM subject matter expert to engage and mentor sourcing team members.
  • Utilise creative sourcing approaches, experience in X-ray searches, search engine optimization, social sourcing, and Boolean strings.
  • Lead the development of meaningful talent pools that fulfil business needs, as defined by regional / business specific recruitment plans.
  • Ensure data integrity in maintaining records in our ATS/CRM and maintain high data integrity.
  • Proactively identify and drive opportunities for improvements.
  • Provide value-add sourcing advice to key stakeholders to influence and persuade talent decisions and strategies.
  • Collaborate with regional sourcing teams and share best practices with the larger sourcing team.

About you

  • At least 3 to 5 years of working experience in similar industry and prior experience in recruiting for Design and Engineering is a plus.
  • Review, pre-screen and interview candidates to determine the appropriateness of skills, experience and knowledge in relation to position requirements.
  • Prior experience sourcing/recruiting for Canadian market is an added advantage.
  • Ability to leverage a data-driven approach to make hiring decisions.
  • Ability to build talent maps, pools and talent market reports.
  • Successful track record of achieving targets, whether those be deadlines or hiring targets.
  • Self-starter with an incredible work ethic and team first mentality.
  • Ability to source across different engineering roles for different business practices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

title: Principal Engineer -Structures
jobDescription:
Overview

Seeking a Structural Engineer with experience in concrete and steel structure design, specializing in both sub‑structure and super structure analysis and design and proficient in tools such as SAFE, ROBOT, STAAD Pro, ETABS, SAP2000, IDEA Statica, and RAM Connections. The engineer will assist with the development, coordination, and quality assurance of structural designs across concept, preliminary, and detailed stages, ensuring full compliance with relevant codes and project requirements while collaborating with teams across the UK, France, and Canada within the GTC Nuclear New Build group. This role involves multidisciplinary coordination and contributing to safe, durable, and constructible structural solutions for a variety of building types and project environments, supporting NNB projects.

Your role

  • Preferably Chartered Engineer or progressing towards their Chartership
  • Strong communication skills, written and verbal.
  • Commercial awareness.
  • Team working, being comfortable working in international teams.
  • A sound understanding of structural analysis methods and structural/building design including applicable codes and standards.
  • Able to identify the key issues/information associate with a task.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ensure projects are delivered to Atkins internal quality standards and processes and industry standards within cost schedule and quality constraints.
  • Gather and maintain all criteria to ensure that the work meets all requirements.

About you

  • Minimum year of experience in heavy civils Concrete structures – 15+ Years
  • Design and FEA Analysis of Buildings, Tunnels, pipes support structures for the plant design
  • Design of Seismic Qualification of machinery support structures.
  • Experience in any of the software like ABAQUS/ANSYS/Robot etc.

title: Associate Technical Director
jobDescription:
Overview

Responsible for leading the engineering and multidisciplinary design management of complex rail and transit infrastructure projects (Metro, LRT, High-Speed Rail, Freight Rail) across the global with key focus on Middle East. The role ensures integrated, safe, and compliant delivery of engineering solutions, aligned with client requirements, international rail standards, and project commercial objectives.

Your role

Key Responsibilities

  • Engineering & Design Management
  • Develop and maintain the Engineering & Design Management Plan aligned with project and client requirements.
  • Contribute to and support the Project Execution Plan (PEP) and overall engineering delivery strategy.
  • Ensure delivery of high-quality engineering outputs, including Basis of Design, design reports, and specifications.
  • Establish and enforce technical governance, QA/QC systems, and configuration control across all design disciplines.

title: Sustainability Consultant II
jobDescription:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Sustainability Consultant to join our India team. This role will support the delivery of strategic advisory and technical solutions for buildings, masterplans, mixed-use developments, and large-scale community projects.

The role focuses on delivering sustainability certifications and sustainability framework projects and assist with the development of sustainability consultancy for new build and existing buildings and communities. Work spans concept through stages of preconcept to detailed design and procurement, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and clients.

You will operate within a team of sustainability professionals delivering the highest standards of technical work and aiding the continued success of the Sustainability team by being an integral part of our client focused delivery of projects. You'll also get the opportunity to work on exciting and significant projects, delivering quality work that has a positive and lasting influence on the community and the environment.

Your role

  • Effectively convey the sustainability certification program and client requirements to project teams, ensuring alignment and tracking progress throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead and manage the certification process for LEED, WELL, Estidama, and Al Sa'fat, including preparation and submission of required documentation.
  • Possess working knowledge of additional green building frameworks such as Mostadam, GSAS, BREEAM, Envision, and CEEQUAL.
  • Understanding certification requirements, workflows, and submission procedures is highly advantageous.
  • Deliver whole-building/asset LCAs and embodied carbon studies; model scenarios, benchmark options, and generate client-ready insight and visuals.
  • Manage LCA-focused sustainability projects, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality outputs.
  • Collaborate directly with design disciplines to define and embed sustainability interventions to meet certification credits and drive sustainable design.
  • Apply PAS 2080:2023 / RICS WLCA (2nd ed.) and/or similar principles for whole-life carbon management and reporting.
  • Excellent skills in narrative writing for supporting highly rated sustainability projects.
  • Possess the ability to address challenges and devise effective solutions in a timely manner.
  • Review necessary design drawings, materials requirement, specifications, and contractual sustainability documents of the project.
  • Prepare the necessary documentation required to maintain project sustainability KPIs.
  • Prepare sustainability plans, guidelines, procedures, reporting and monitoring trackers, energy simulations & relevant reports.
  • Document clear technical notes, methods, and client presentations.
  • Demonstrate research experience, as this job will likely demand both directed and individual research into architectural materials and technology, building services systems, green building and urban policy, and social and human comfort issues.

About you

  • Holds a Bachelor / Masters level in Engineering, Architecture or Built Environment- related degrees.
  • LEED Accredited Professional
  • 6-12 years' experience in building certification, LCA/embodied carbon for AEC/infrastructure projects.
  • Experience in sustainability building and masterplan certifications (knowledge of rating systems such as LEED, Mostadam, WELL, Estidama, CEEUQAL, is preferred).
  • Experience with developing and implementing sustainability concepts for master planning projects.
  • Experience in building physics modeling, including energy, daylight, comfort, and parametric analysis, with hands-on experience using IES-VE software are advantageous.
  • Understand energy modelling and can interpret modelling results.
  • Experience in life cycle assessments is advantageous.
  • Skilled in liaising with design disciplines and managing relationships across all project phases.
  • Capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously with effective planning to meet deadlines
  • Experienced in managing diverse sustainability aspects of complex design and construction projects, including initiatives aimed at achieving Net-Zero carbon targets.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills in English with the ability to communicate results via Microsoft Power Point, Word, and related software, and craft compelling presentations and reports Flexible and open to work with the wider Environment and Sustainability disciplines. Comfortable working independently Solutions focused.
  • Be Self-motivated, dedicated, and proactive with a passion for detail.
  • Good experience with numerous platforms, including Microsoft Office, In Design, Auto CAD, Rhino and Grasshopper.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Accreditations: Estidama PQP, GSAS CGP, Mostadam AP, SITES AP
  • Technical Skills: Proficient in architectural modeling software such as Revit, Sketch Up, and Rhino
  • Sustainability Expertise: Experienced in conducting Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) using E-tool or similar platforms
  • LEED Commissioning: Experience with design stage commissioning preferably with LEED with relevant professional credentials.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Sustainability Consultant to join our India team. This role will support the delivery of strategic advisory and technical solutions for buildings, masterplans, mixed-use developments, and large-scale community projects.

The role focuses on delivering sustainability certifications and sustainability framework projects and assist with the development of sustainability consultancy for new build and existing buildings and communities. Work spans concept through stages of preconcept to detailed design and procurement, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and clients.

You will operate within a team of sustainability professionals delivering the highest standards of technical work and aiding the continued success of the Sustainability team by being an integral part of our client focused delivery of projects. You'll also get the opportunity to work on exciting and significant projects, delivering quality work that has a positive and lasting influence on the community and the environment.

Your role

  • Effectively convey the sustainability certification program and client requirements to project teams, ensuring alignment and tracking progress throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead and manage the certification process for LEED, WELL, Estidama, and Al Sa'fat, including preparation and submission of required documentation.
  • Possess working knowledge of additional green building frameworks such as Mostadam, GSAS, BREEAM, Envision, and CEEQUAL.
  • Understanding certification requirements, workflows, and submission procedures is highly advantageous.
  • Deliver whole-building/asset LCAs and embodied carbon studies; model scenarios, benchmark options, and generate client-ready insight and visuals.
  • Manage LCA-focused sustainability projects, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality outputs.
  • Collaborate directly with design disciplines to define and embed sustainability interventions to meet certification credits and drive sustainable design.
  • Apply PAS 2080:2023 / RICS WLCA (2nd ed.) and/or similar principles for whole-life carbon management and reporting.
  • Excellent skills in narrative writing for supporting highly rated sustainability projects.
  • Possess the ability to address challenges and devise effective solutions in a timely manner.
  • Review necessary design drawings, materials requirement, specifications, and contractual sustainability documents of the project.
  • Prepare the necessary documentation required to maintain project sustainability KPIs.
  • Prepare sustainability plans, guidelines, procedures, reporting and monitoring trackers, energy simulations & relevant reports.
  • Document clear technical notes, methods, and client presentations.
  • Demonstrate research experience, as this job will likely demand both directed and individual research into architectural materials and technology, building services systems, green building and urban policy, and social and human comfort issues.

About you

  • Holds a Bachelor / Masters level in Engineering, Architecture or Built Environment- related degrees.
  • LEED Accredited Professional
  • 6-12 years' experience in building certification, LCA/embodied carbon for AEC/infrastructure projects.
  • Experience in sustainability building and masterplan certifications (knowledge of rating systems such as LEED, Mostadam, WELL, Estidama, CEEUQAL, is preferred).
  • Experience with developing and implementing sustainability concepts for master planning projects.
  • Experience in building physics modeling, including energy, daylight, comfort, and parametric analysis, with hands-on experience using IES-VE software are advantageous.
  • Understand energy modelling and can interpret modelling results.
  • Experience in life cycle assessments is advantageous.
  • Skilled in liaising with design disciplines and managing relationships across all project phases.
  • Capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously with effective planning to meet deadlines
  • Experienced in managing diverse sustainability aspects of complex design and construction projects, including initiatives aimed at achieving Net-Zero carbon targets.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills in English with the ability to communicate results via Microsoft Power Point, Word, and related software, and craft compelling presentations and reports Flexible and open to work with the wider Environment and Sustainability disciplines. Comfortable working independently Solutions focused.
  • Be Self-motivated, dedicated, and proactive with a passion for detail.
  • Good experience with numerous platforms, including Microsoft Office, In Design, Auto CAD, Rhino and Grasshopper.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Accreditations: Estidama PQP, GSAS CGP, Mostadam AP, SITES AP
  • Technical Skills: Proficient in architectural modeling software such as Revit, Sketch Up, and Rhino
  • Sustainability Expertise: Experienced in conducting Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) using E-tool or similar platforms
  • LEED Commissioning: Experience with design stage commissioning preferably with LEED with relevant professional credentials.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

title: Manager / Senior Manager - Network
jobDescription:
Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

We are seeking a highly experienced Network Lead/Manager to design, implement, and manage enterprise network infrastructure across global operations. The role requires a hands‑on leader with deep expertise in Cisco switches, firewalls, routers, and cloud networking (Azure/AWS), combined with strong vendor/client management skills and the ability to drive KPI‑based governance and reporting.

What will you do?

  • Lead the network infrastructure function across on‑prem and cloud environments.
  • Architect and design enterprise network solutions ensuring scalability, resilience, and security.
  • Manage and configure Cisco switches, routers, and firewalls (ASA, Palo Alto, Fortinet).
  • Oversee cloud networking in Azure and AWS (VNETs, VPNs, routing, security groups).
  • Ensure network security including DMZ management, VPN, and firewall policies.
  • Define and enforce network processes, standards, and documentation.
  • Monitor and report on KPIs, SLAs, and compliance metrics.
  • Collaborate with ITSM, Security, Hosting, and Application teams to ensure seamless connectivity.
  • Manage vendor relationships for network hardware/software contracts and negotiate renewals.
  • Partner with clients and stakeholders to ensure transparency and alignment on network performance.
  • Drive automation and monitoring initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce downtime.
  • Prepare network performance reports, dashboards, and capacity planning for leadership.
  • Mentor and guide network engineers, fostering a culture of accountability and innovation.

Experience, Education and other Required:

  • Experience: 12–15 years in enterprise networking, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong hands‑on expertise in Cisco networking (switches, routers, firewalls).
  • Proven experience in cloud networking (Azure/AWS) design and operations.
  • Solid understanding of network security frameworks and compliance standards.
  • Experience in vendor management and contract negotiation for network services.
  • Strong knowledge of SLA/OLA governance, KPI tracking, and reporting frameworks.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and client engagement skills.
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and ITSM tools (Service Now, Remedy, Jira Service Management).
  • Exposure to automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, Cisco DNA Center) is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Certifications: CCNP mandatory; Azure/AWS networking certifications is added advantage.
  • ITIL v4 certification is an advantage.
  • Strong knowledge of network design, architecture, and capacity planning.

What we offer:

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits,

  • 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year.

  • Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression

As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation.

title: Lead Engineer- Land Development
jobDescription:
As a Technical Lead within the Land Development team, you will:

  • Support the lead engineer on the project, on the end-to-end design and delivery of wet utility infrastructure, including water supply, foul and surface drainage, stormwater management, and flood mitigation, across all project stages—from feasibility and planning through detailed design and construction.
  • Independently manage smaller schemes within large projects, overseeing the management of both dry (power, telecom, gas, thermal) and wet utilities. This includes developing options for decommissioning, rerouting, and new network design; discussion with project leads and other sub leads in the project, first level coordination with stakeholders; and supporting multidisciplinary teams to resolve clashes and prepare utility reports and federated models.
  • Prepare and/or check grading and levels plans for plot sections, ensuring cut-and-fill balance and alignment with access strategies in coordination with landscape architects and client teams.
  • Prepare and follow basis of design with reference to the regional regulations and design standards while preparing high-quality hydraulic and hydrological modelling, CAD/BIM coordination (Civil 3D, Water GEMS, Sewer GEMS), and preparation of Bills of Quantities.
  • Assist the project lead in managing project programmes, budgets, and risks, and collaborate with internal teams to ensure coordinated design delivery
  • Participate in mentoring activities for junior engineers and support the immediate team with necessary training and upskilling. Work towards fostering multidisciplinary collaboration and offer assistance in training initiatives with focus on driving digital innovation.
  • Work with the Subject matter expertise in the relevant disciplines to improve technical understanding, progressing toward SME roles or Technical Authority for a specific technology area.
  • Work towards chartered status (CEng/MICE or equivalent) and demonstrate proven experience in land development or major infrastructure projects.

About you

  • Good understanding of system integration principles for multi-disciplinary design, with solid experience in utilities, grading, and roads design, and general awareness of supporting disciplines such as safety, human factors, and sustainability.
  • Around 10+ years of experience delivering projects within time, cost, and quality requirements, with involvement across different project stages.
  • Working knowledge of relevant international codes and standards (e.g., UK, Middle East, North America) and ability to apply sustainability considerations where required.
  • Able to understand client requirements, contribute to developing technical solutions, and support technical reviews on medium to large projects.
  • Experience in core project management activities such as supporting bids, tracking progress, cost awareness, and participating in client meetings and technical discussions.

title: Principal Engineer- Aviation
jobDescription:
Your role

  • Lead the planning, design, and delivery of complex airport and aviation infrastructure projects across all project lifecycle stages (Feasibility, Concept, Preliminary Design, Detailed Design, Construction Support, and Operational Readiness)
  • Provide technical leadership for airside and landside infrastructure, including runways, taxiways, aprons, aircraft stands, terminal developments, ground support facilities, airport access roads, utility networks, and supporting infrastructure systems.
  • Develop and review airfield geometric layouts, airside pavements, grading and drainage systems, ensuring compliance with ICAO, FAA, EASA, IATA, and local aviation authority regulations.
  • Lead the integration of multidisciplinary utility systems and infrastructure with other airport systems like airfield lighting, navigation aids, fuel systems, security systems, baggage handling interfaces, terminal facilities, and air traffic operations requirements.
  • Develop hydraulic and hydrological models using industry-standard software (e.g., Info Drainage, Micro Drainage, Sewer GEMS, Water GEMS), including network analysis, attenuation sizing, runoff estimation, and compliance with allowable discharge criteria and return period requirements.
  • Manage and coordinate both wet and dry utility interfaces, including power, telecom, gas, district cooling/heating, and water systems, ensuring optimized corridor planning, clash-free routing, and efficient use of utility corridors within constrained urban developments.
  • Lead utility diversion, protection, and phasing strategies, including assessment of existing assets, preparation of relocation schemes, and coordination with statutory authorities for approvals, shutdown planning, and service continuity.
  • Produce and review technical deliverables including airfield layouts, design reports, specifications, engineering calculations, construction drawings, procurement documentation, and Bills of Quantities (Bo Qs).
  • Develop and oversee pavement engineering designs for runways, taxiways, aprons, and service roads, including pavement evaluations, rehabilitation strategies, and lifecycle asset management planning.
  • Ensure compliance with international aviation standards and best practices, including ICAO Annexes, FAA Advisory Circulars, EASA Regulations, IATA Airport Development Reference Manual (ADRM), and local civil aviation requirements.
  • Produce and review technical deliverables, including drawings, design reports, utility layouts, longitudinal profiles, hydraulic calculations, specifications, and Bills of Quantities (Bo Qs), ensuring accuracy, completeness, and coordination across disciplines.
  • Utilize BIM and Digital Engineering tools (Civil 3D, Open Roads, Revit, Navisworks, Infra Works, GIS platforms, Digital Twins) for model-based design, clash detection, quantity take-offs, and multidisciplinary coordination.
  • Plan and monitor project schedules, resource allocation, and design progress, while managing technical risks, identifying mitigation strategies, and ensuring alignment with project milestones and commercial targets.
  • Engage with airport operators, civil aviation authorities, airlines, stakeholders, regulatory agencies, contractors, and developers to obtain approvals, resolve technical issues, and support project delivery.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers and designers, including checking of deliverables, supporting skill development in drainage design and modelling, and promoting best practices in engineering design.
  • Contribute to bid preparation and business development activities by providing technical inputs, design concepts, effort estimation, and risk identification for proposals and tenders.
  • Develop and strengthen subject matter expertise in specific areas such as stormwater management, utility coordination, or digital design workflows, contributing to continuous improvement, innovation, and standardization within the team.

About you

  • Strong expertise in airport infrastructure design and multidisciplinary systems integration, with deep knowledge of airside and landside engineering and awareness of aviation safety, operational efficiency, sustainability, resilience, and human factors.
  • Proven track record of 12+ years in delivering increasingly complex aviation and airport infrastructure projects, including major international airport developments and expansion programs.
  • Extensive knowledge of international aviation codes, standards, and regulatory frameworks, including ICAO, FAA, EASA, IATA, CAA, and Middle East aviation authority requirements.
  • Ability to understand airport operational requirements and translate them into practical, safe, and efficient engineering solutions while serving as Technical Leader, Design Reviewer, or Project Director on major aviation programs.
  • Strong competence in project management activities, including bid preparation, programme and financial reviews, risk awareness, and participation in client presentations, technical workshops, and lessons learned sessions.
  • Advanced understanding of technical integration processes and analytical/problem-solving approaches, with the ability to resolve complex and unique challenges that impact business outcomes.
  • Leadership mindset with high accountability, capable of working autonomously, making informed decisions, guiding teams, and driving technical excellence and strategic direction within a specific area.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence stakeholders at all levels, embrace diverse perspectives, promote innovation, and proactively adopt digital tools and systems to enhance project delivery.
  • Chartered Engineer (CEng, MICE, or equivalent) or actively working towards chartership
  • Experience working in international environments across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific, and Middle East aviation markets would be highly desirable.

Reward & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.

title: Lead Environmental Consultant
jobDescription:
Overview

Atkins Réalis is one of the worlds' leading engineering design consultancies. We have the breadth and depth of expertise to respond to the most technically challenging and time critical infrastructure projects. As a provider of multi-discipline technical services, Atkins Réalis is committed to design excellence and delivery of excellent solutions which combine innovation, ingenuity, and best practice.

We currently have an opportunity for a Senior Consultant specialising in contaminated land or waste management to join the Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre in India. The role involves significant work on UK and International projects being delivered by the Atkins Réalis UK Sustainable Land and Resource Management practice across a range of market sectors like Highways, Rail, Tunnels, including the development of Cities, Mass Transit and Energy infrastructure.

We are looking for an individual with knowledge and experience of Environmental Site Assessments and Investigations, chemical assessment and quantitative risk assessment relating to land contamination, waste and brownfield regeneration, to join our Environment team and support an expanding project workload and client base.

Your role

  • 10+ years' experience in environmental assessment, either in contaminated/ brownfield land or waste assessments.
  • Post Graduate Degree qualified in a relevant engineering or science subject e.g. geology, geosciences, chemistry, environmental science and hydrogeology.
  • Experience of conducting Phase 1 Site Assessment and Phase 2 intrusive Site Investigation, with experience of multiple site investigation techniques.
  • Knowledge and technical understanding of conceptual site models and generic risk assessments for soils and waters.
  • Ability to interpret and analyse large and complex soil and water data and produce well written factual and interpretative reports.
  • Good communication and presentation skills with ability to network and build strong links to the UK practice. ·
  • Understanding of environmental regulations ideally in the UK.
  • Ability to take initiative and work independently or within a team.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to the project/team/wider team.
  • Located near an Atkins Réalis India office ideally Bengaluru or Mumbai, or willingness for regular travel to visit the team.

About You

  • Experience of working for global regions will be preferable either in an excellence centre or in the region.
  • Knowledge / experience in soil waste management/waste handling/waste remediation is an advantage.
  • Field work experience would be an advance but not essential.
  • Knowledge and technical understanding of human health risk assessments, controlled waters (surface water and groundwater) and screening criteria used in the UK.
  • UK industry standards and codes of practice for ground investigations and potentially contaminated sites i.e. CIRIA, 2001. Contaminated land risk assessment. A guide to good practice (C552), and have broad understanding of DEFRA, 2012. Environmental Protection Act 1990: Part 2A, Contaminated Land Statutory Guidance etc.
  • Build excellent network, excellent professional relationships and strong links to the UK practice including utilising good communication and presentation skills. ·
  • Originate and check soil and material management and permitting requirements and technical documents that may be required as part of the project.
  • Originate and check contaminated land assessments and factual/interpretive reports including organisation, collation, and assessment of desk-based information as part of Phase 1 Desk Studies and Phase 2 ground investigation reports.
  • Data management of large data sets of soils and water data using software packages such as sample scheduling, data transfer and statistics.
  • Assisting in designing or able to design (then organise) environmental/geo-environmental site investigations, including soil sampling and ground gas/vapour/leachate/groundwater and surface water monitoring/sampling.
  • Preparing Method Statements, Specifications and Drawings.
  • Scheduling and managing work to acceptable quality, on time and to budget.
  • Compliance with Health and Safety Policies and Procedures, including preparing and reviewing health and safety plans and managing health and safety on sites.

  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.

title: Senior Quantity Surveyor-Electrical
jobDescription:
Overview

The Senior Electrical Quantity Surveyor is responsible for accurate measurement and quantity take‑offs of electrical works, ensuring precise cost estimation, tender documentation, and contract administration. The role requires expertise in electrical systems such as LV, MV, HV distribution, lighting, cabling, and ELV systems, with a strong focus on BOQ preparation, claims verification, and cost control throughout the project lifecycle.The Payroll Associate is responsible for payroll activities for all regions, Support streamlining the process, understand the payroll elements & support the HR team in running the payroll monthly cycles

Your role

1. Quantity Take‑Off & Measurement

  • Perform detailed quantity take‑offs from electrical drawings and specifications.
  • Measure quantities for:
  • Lighting systems
  • LV/MV/HV power distribution
  • ELV systems (Data, security, Telecom and FAPA)
  • Substations, cabling, and earthing
  • Verify site measurements and reconcile with design documents.
  • Maintain measurement sheets and records for audit and reporting.

2. Estimation & BOQ Preparation

  • Prepare cost estimates and Bills of Quantities (Bo Qs) for electrical and ELV works.
  • Conduct rate analysis and cost build‑ups for materials, labour, and equipment.
  • Validate vendor/subcontractor quotations against measured quantities.

3. Tendering & Contract Support

  • Develop tender documents and pricing schedules.
  • Support bid evaluations and comparisons based on measured quantities.
  • Assist in negotiations with contractors and suppliers.

4. Cost Control & Claims Verification

  • Monitor project costs against measured quantities.
  • Verify contractor invoices and certify progress payments.
  • Assess variations/change orders with proper substantiation (time & cost impact).
  • Prepare and defend claims with accurate measurement records.

5. Risk & Value Engineering

  • Support risk management activities by providing accurate measurement data.
  • Highlight potential cost optimization opportunities identified during quantity take‑off.

6. Coordination & Documentation

  • Liaise with engineers, project managers, and contractors for measurement clarifications.
  • Raise and respond to RFIs related to quantity and scope.
  • Prepare cost reports, dashboards, and financial summaries.

About you

  • Use estimation software such as:
  • Cost-X (mandatory)
  • Auto CAD
  • Excel-based cost models
  • Ensure proper documentation and version control of estimates.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical systems and construction practices for Industrial projects.

  • Analytical, detail‑oriented, and accurate in documentation.

Job Location: Chennai, India

Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

The position provides design for engineering discipline across multiple engineering projects within the OPC.   • Prepare all technical documentation for the equipment specification as input to the purchase requisitions
  • Contribute to the Up-to-date design issue log
  • Safety – Understand and follow Linxon OHS procedures and guidelines
  • Participate at design reviews.
  • Provide input for close out report and lessons learned, and follow/review lessons learned for next projects

Experience, Education and other Required:

  • 6-10 years of experience in substation design with focus on HV Equipment expertise and overall system design.
  • Bachelor's Degree / master's degree in civil engineering.
  • Complete Design knowledge on Civil design and detail engineering of AIS & GIS substation foundation, Structures up to 500k V and transmission line design for various voltage levels.
  • Knowledge on ANSI standards for substation Civil engineering is desired.
  • Overall engineering design experience on Base, Detail Civil, structural engineering in GIS or AIS substation and transmission line for UK utilities is required.
  • Well-versed handling of ANSI units like – Feet and inches, Pounds etc is preferred.
  • Hands on experience in HV Substation Civil, Structural Design engineering preparation of Site Grading, Foundation design and detailed engineering drawings, Structural design and detailed engineering drawings, Preparation BOM, building design and detailing etc.
  • Review of Consultant design and drawing and provide in depth comments
  • Coordinate with Site, Customer, consultant and contactor.
  • Work with complete engineering team.
  • Complete design experience on Civil software like STAAD Pro, SAP 2000 Structural Analysis, SAFE Foundation Analysis, L pile, L Shaft, RISA, AUTOCAD applications and tools.
  • Should have experience in Transmission line design using PLS CAD, PLS tower, PLS pole etc.,
  • Understanding of electronic records management systems.
  • High attention to detail and quality.
  • Pile foundation design skills.
  • Site / Grading development grading plan, section, details and cut & fill quantities table
  • Site drainage layout preparation.
  • Final finish surfacing plan, section and details
  • Knowledge on ANSI standards for substation civil engineering is desired.
  • Looking for Civil engineer who has experience in UK utilities

What we offer:

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits,

  • 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year

  • Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression

  • When it comes to diversity and inclusion, we see things differently at Linxon - we encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations and more - so whoever you are, we hope you'll see things our way, too.

Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity.

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon.

Linxon's vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects.

As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation.

Job Title: Project Engineer - Secondary substation

Job Location: Chennai, India

Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

The Secondary Engineer will be a member of the Linxon INOPC Engineering Team and will contribute towards the effective execution of the engineering functions within projects and tenders. The Secondary Engineer will work in a skilled team on a wide range of international T&D substation projects. The position will focus on the project and tender engineering and its interfaces and scope of work involved in HV - substation design and construction projects, within the Linxon EPC and technical lead of the electro-mechanical design of substation to meet customer needs, legislative demands, and standards. Also, to ensure project execution within budget and time with required quality & efficiency.

What will you do?

  • Responsible for Secondary engineering activities from project/tender start till the As-Built stage with strict adherence to Project Specifications & Linxon standards including QA/QC, HSSE & Integrity.
  • Coordinate within Linxon engineering team (local & remote/global), internal & external partners, sub-suppliers, primary engineers & civil engineers.
  • Responsible for engineering for protection and control (P&C) system, Metering, SCADA, Tech Net/Communication for HV and MV electric power substations.
  • Provide technical calculations for CT/VT sizing, Relay settings, Aux. System equipment sizing, MV/LV Cable sizing etc. Exposure to relevant tools including reading/editing of ICD/CID files etc.
  • Responsible for interface engineering of assigned equipment packages like Switchgear, Transformer, Reactors, CT/VT, Auxiliary system etc.
  • Supporting LE for engineering related tasks assigned.
  • Provide technical solution for substations comprising Single line diagram, Relay & Metering diagram, three-lines, control schematics, signal list, interlocking, interconnection and wiring diagrams, auto-synchronizer & switch-sync/point-on-wave switching application, interface engineering, MV/LVAC & DC SLDs and associated detail drawings and documents by established applicable standards, processes, operation & maintenance requirements, OHSE considerations and customer specifications.
  • Develop technical concepts for Panel Layouts/Room Layout, technical specifications, selection of equipment and connection material considering costs, quality, international standards, and material.
  • Provide technical purchasing specification and schedules (RFQ) for all equipment for projects or tenders.
  • Prepare bill of quantities & cost estimation, deviations & clarifications for technical solutions.
  • Develop cable schedules & interface engineering documents for complete plant including Auxiliary system, Communication/SCADA etc.
  • Review of Suppliers design, Factory acceptance test plans, attend factory & site tests.
  • Provide technical support and to develop tender scheme options and related project scope documents.

Experience, Education and other Required:

  • Master or Bachelor's degree in an Electrical engineering discipline with ability to demonstrate experience of delivering HV Substation project.
  • Minimum 6-10 years substation engineering experience in Utilities or EPC companies for HV Substations. Knowledge of required legislative demands and German standards is plus.
  • Work experience of Power Infrastructure project in Germany is also plus.
  • Expert knowledge in Substation secondary design and engineering
  • Awareness of Cyber security requirement & Digital Substation concepts
  • Basic understanding of Primary engineering interface/inputs & system studies/calculations related to Secondary engineering will be plus.
  • Strong in MS Office, Basic knowledge of Auto CAD is preferred.

title: Sr. Principal Engineer – HVDC & HV Substation
jobDescription:
Overview

Power Grid Division is involved in electricity utilities sector in the UK & I, Canada, US, ME and APAC. We provide value-added engineering services and built solutions across the entire spectrum of electricity networks, from high voltage power transmission grids to low voltage industrial power distribution. We have designed HV Substations upto 400k V and Electrical infrastructure for large industrial/ Multi Use developments and Heavy industries. The team provides services to clients across the globe, however the major clients are in UK and Middle East.

The Power T&D team is looking for experienced Sr. Principal engineers in HV Plant Discipline, as we look to grow the team in line with business requirements. So, if you are interested in working for an internationally renowned consultancy and working on some challenging projects across UK, Canada & ANZ, come join us at Atkins Réalis.

Your role

Using your experience and knowledge, you will be leading the delivery of a variety of projects drawing upon the wider team for the technical engineering requirements and building a strong relationship with our clients. You will be client-facing, responsible for the delivery of our work and making sure it meets our client's'expectations.

You will be taking up the following RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Experience of undertaking FEED or Detailed design of HV and EHV (132k V to 765k V) AIS , GIS and HVDC Substations
  • Detail understanding on both LCC & VSC HVDC technologies.
  • Hands on experience in preparation of detailed primary deliverables / drawings such as Single Line Diagram, Layout, Convertor station layout, Elevation, Clearance diagram, Erection key diagram, Control room building layouts, Cable trench details and layouts, Cable routing layouts etc.
  • Experience in preparation of BOQ's, Specifications and Data sheets for Primary Equipment's.
  • Prepare HVDC Performance Specifications, Converter Station and Equipment specifications
  • Hands on Experience on Power system studies involving Network modelling, simulation, analysis and Validation of HVDCs using PSCAD Software. Knowledge of OEM models of HVDCs and Library models in PSCAD Software
  • Support and solve queries during construction, testing and commissioning, attend site meetings and inspections.
  • Report Writing Skills.
  • Preparation of bid documents and bid evaluations.
  • Ensure interdisciplinary coordination.
  • Contribute to Tendering activities by supporting with preliminary design documentation & drawings, Bill of Quantities, Engineering Man Hour Estimates etc.
  • Lead HV Plant design on a project and engage with junior engineers & graduate engineers.
  • Mentoring other engineers and help them become better engineers.
  • Manage the team and actively involve in finding the requirements of engineers and find ways to fulfil.
  • Provide engineering support and solve queries during construction, testing and commissioning, attend site meetings and inspections.

title: Power System Study Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description

Join Us!

We combine SNC-Lavalin's project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

Linxon, a leader in EPC power system infrastructure projects, seeks experienced and motivated Power System Studies & Substation Design Engineer, a critical role in ensuring the reliability, efficiency, and sustainability of the organization's'electrical infrastructure projects. This position is central to the technical backbone of the company, bridging advanced engineering analysis with practical design implementation. As a Power System Studies & Substation Design Engineer, you will be responsible for conducting advanced engineering and simulation studies to support the design, analysis, and optimization of electrical power systems. This includes industrial, utility, and renewable energy applications.

What will you do?

  • Perform power system studies, such as but not limited to:

    • Load Flow Analysis

    • Short Circuit Analysis

    • Harmonic Analysis

    • Reactive Power Compensation Study

    • Transient Stability Studies

    • Arc Flash Analysis

    • Grounding studies

    • Protection Coordination and Relay Settings

  • Conduct substation design studies, including:

  • Equipment sizing (transformers, breakers, CTs, PTs)

  • Busbar configuration and layout optimization

  • Grounding system design and analysis

  • Insulation coordination and lightning protection (TOV, TRV, LIOV and SOV)

  • Hands on experience simulation tools like ETAP, ASPEN, PSCAD, PSS/E

  • Ensure compliance with national and international standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC).

  • Prepare technical reports, documentation, and presentations.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including project managers, civil, protection, and SCADA teams for integrated substation design.

  • Support grid integration studies for renewables, data centers, and industrial loads.

  • Provide technical support during tendering and project execution phases.

Experience, Education and other Required:

  • Bachelor'S or master's degree in electrical engineering (preferably with a focus on Power Systems).

  • 5+ years of experience in power system analysis or related fields.

  • Proficiency in electrical power system simulation software(s) and technical documentation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Good communication and interpersonal abilities.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and deliver innovative solutions.

  • Proficiency with GIS/AIS substation design.

  • Experience with battery energy storage systems (BESS) and renewable energy integration.

  • Familiarity with grid codes and utility standards.

  • Knowledge of protection relays and SCADA systems.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.

What we offer:

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits,

  • 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year

  • Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression

  • We also have a brilliant smarter working policy, too. That means many of folks are able to either work from home or as part of our hybrid model.

  • When it comes to diversity and inclusion, we see things differently at Linxon - we encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations and more - so whoever you are, we hope you'll see things our way, too.

About Linxon

Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity.

We combine SNC-Lavalin's project management expertise and ABB's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon.

Linxon's vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects.

As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a new company as it evolves and help shape it for the future. If you like new challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are interested in working with other motivated professionals with expertise in the Substations EPC business, then this is the new opportunity for you.

jobDescription:

jobDescription:
Overview

The role is for a design engineer for UK / Any geography Rail sector within the Telecoms and Information Systems team.

The candidate shall be responsible for the production and co-ordination of Communication Systems designs. The candidate must be aware of UK Rail process and worked on Network Rail and London Underground rail projects.

Your role

The candidate is required to have a proven working knowledge of the activities necessary to produce fully assured designs for the following systems:

  • Public Address / Voice Alarm systems,
  • Closed Circuit Television systems,
  • Access Control systems,
  • Passenger Help Point systems,
  • Emergency Telephone systems
  • Station Management Systems
  • TCP / IP Networks,
  • Clock and Master Clock Systems
  • Public Wifi
  • Wifi simulation and planning - Appreciated

The candidate is also expected to have an appreciation of the interfaces (physical and other) with other railway system disciplines.

The candidate's responsibilities will comprise of the production of the communications elements of both discipline-integrated and stand-alone station designs. This will involve;

  • Co-ordination with other disciplines (internal and external) in the placement and integration of communication equipment within the overall design.
  • Production of design deliverables including specifications, reports, schedules, drawings, and technical schematics.
  • Producing designs in CAD using Auto CAD, Micro Station – 2D and 3D, AECOSIM, Revit
  • Management of 3rd party design resource utilised in producing elements of the design (e.g., acoustic consultants, Lifts, Escalators etc).
