title: Advisor/Senior Advisor - Talent Acquisition (Early Careers - UK)
jobDescription:
Overview

We are 270+ talents operating under one Hub; diversified into different process groups - Recruitment, Lifecyle, Offboarding, Service Excellence and Contact Management.

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. The future focussed HR organisation largely possess a strong Onshore Partnering Team and the Centre of Excellence, complimented by a robust Service Delivery Team offering top class services to employees from the HR People Hub, Bangalore.

Your role

  • Be part of the team delivering high volumes of graduate, placement and apprentice recruitment, taking responsibility end to end for a number of roles from attraction support, selection and assessment, through to onboarding, aligned to one or more of our business areas.
  • Working closely with the UK Recruitment Team to ensure a joined-up approach on the delivery of recruitment.
  • Shortlisting of candidates for roles throughout the cycle across all 3 streams, using the selection information and insight available alongside your knowledge of the business needs to put candidates forward for interviews (graduates and apprentices), matching candidates to summer placements or for business interview (year in industry placements).
  • Manage the relationship with the business and the wider Early Careers Team, to educate, influence and ensure the smooth delivery of your vacancies.
  • Help manage a high volume of candidates through our selection process providing an exceptional customer service and an outstanding candidate experience.
  • There's lots of business and candidate engagement so you'll need to enjoy communicating with people in all parts of the process, enabling the right decisions to be made.
  • Use our early careers Applicant Tracking System (ATS), we'll provide training, but you'll want to have used systems before for candidate management in a recruitment environment.
  • Deliver virtual interview days, we'll train you on how we do things, and you'll manage the business decisions around hiring ensuring consistency and objective decisions are being made.
  • Support our key business themes such as candidate experience, equality diversity and inclusion, our local value proposition and living our values.
  • Continuously review candidate pipelines using the reports and data available to ensure a manageable flow of candidates for the roles to be filled.
  • Work really closely with the wider early careers team to ensure that everything we do is aligned and that you support each other for the benefit of the business, the candidate and to help us be as efficient as we possibly can.

About you

  • Excellent communication of English, both written and verbal with presentation skills.
  • The ability to manage a high volume of vacancies from start to finish, ensuring the business needs are translated and built into the attraction strategy and system delivery, ensuring consistency throughout the process and excellent attention to detail.
  • Experience in Early Careers would be desirable, however if not a strong interest in learning this area of recruitment.
  • Highly organised with a structured approach to work, juggling priorities well whilst being self-managing a lot of the time with the support of the team around you.
  • Great IT skills in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel and Power Point and be comfortable with in house recruitment systems.
  • Excellent customer focus, helping us to always put the candidate first, at the same time as supporting the business.
  • Have the confidence and ability to build strong relationships with people, getting close to your colleagues, our business stakeholders and candidates.
  • Like following process where there needs to be and comfortable to look for flexible improvements where the opportunity exists.
  • Great at multi-tasking, regularly prioritising your workload and being agile enough to support the team as and when needed.
  • Self-sufficient and independent, you'll be confident working autonomously at times but capable of staying connected with the team.

Rewards & benefits

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.

title: Senior Waste Management and Circular Economy Consultant
jobDescription:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Waste Management and Circular Economy Consultant to join our India team. This role will support the delivery of strategic advisory and technical solutions for buildings, masterplans, mixed-use developments, and large-scale community projects.

The role focuses on embedding circular economy principles and advancing sustainable waste management strategies across the full project lifecycle. It requires strong technical capability in waste characterisation, systems design, infrastructure planning, stakeholder engagement, and sustainability certification integration.

Your role

  • Systems and infrastructure design: Design waste systems and infrastructure, including space planning, logistics modelling, operational workflows, collection systems, segregation areas, and processing facilities.
  • Circular design integration: Embed material efficiency, design for disassembly, reuse potential, adaptability, lifecycle thinking, and waste minimisation into building and masterplan design.
  • Spatial planning and coordination: Assess waste system requirements at building and city scales, ensuring coordination with architecture, Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP), infrastructure, environmental, and cost consultant teams.
  • Frameworks and technical guidance: Lead the development of circular economy frameworks, guidance, and toolkits aligned with international best practice, including ISO 20887, ISO 59004/59010, BS 8001, and the Ellen Mac Arthur Foundation framework.
  • Project requirements: Define clear design and technical requirements for circularity and embed them into project briefs, specifications, and delivery documentation.
  • Waste audits and characterisation: Prepare and conduct remote waste audits and characterisation studies using industry-standard methodologies, including waste composition analysis, generation forecasting, and infrastructure capacity planning.
  • Forecasting and analysis: Develop waste forecasting models to project waste volumes, composition, infrastructure requirements, operational needs, and lifecycle costs.
  • Tools, templates, and supplier intelligence: Establish and maintain a Middle East supplier and technology database, and standardise method statements, templates, and technical specifications for consistent deployment across projects.
  • Strategy and advisory: Lead the development of waste management and circular economy strategies for buildings, masterplans, and community-scale developments, translating circular economy principles into practical, implementable solutions.
  • Integrated waste planning: Develop strategies covering waste minimisation, source segregation, recycling, recovery, and treatment options, aligned with Middle East regional regulations and global best practice.
  • Client engagement and thought leadership: Engage with clients and stakeholders, translate technical concepts into clear recommendations, and provide insight on emerging waste and circular economy practices.
  • Business development and team leadership: Support proposals, case studies, and client presentations, while providing task leadership, direction, and mentorship to junior team members.

About you

Core Skills

  • 8+ years' proven experience in waste management and circular economy consulting across buildings, mixed-use developments, and large-scale community or masterplan projects.
  • Strong understanding of waste collection systems, segregation infrastructure, treatment technologies, and logistics planning for urban developments.
  • Familiarity with relevant standards, frameworks, and certifications, including Cradle to Cradle, and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR).
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented, with a commitment to high-quality client service.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to varied audiences.
  • Strong project management capability, including the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives, stakeholders, and timelines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify opportunities for improved circularity and operational performance.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with automated waste collection systems (AWCS) and smart waste management technologies.
  • Experience planning and coordinating the sizing and siting of waste facilities, such as waste transfer stations, mini-Material Recovery Facilities (MRFs), and recycling stations within masterplan developments.
  • Background in cost-benefit analysis (CBA) and financial modelling for waste infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Degree qualification in engineering or a related discipline; a master's degree or professional certification in circular economy, sustainable business, or a similar field is preferred.
  • Chartered Institution of Waste Management (CIWM) membership, or equivalent professional body registration, is preferred.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Strong understanding of waste collection systems, segregation infrastructure, treatment technologies, and logistics planning for urban developments. Familiarity with relevant standards, frameworks, and certifications, including Cradle to Cradle, and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR). Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented, with a commitment to high-quality client service. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to varied audiences. Strong project management capability, including the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives, stakeholders, and timelines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify opportunities for improved circularity and operational performance. Desirable Experience Experience with automated waste collection systems (AWCS) and smart waste management technologies. Experience planning and coordinating the sizing and siting of waste facilities, such as waste transfer stations, mini-Material Recovery Facilities (MRFs), and recycling stations within masterplan developments. Background in cost-benefit analysis (CBA) and financial modelling for waste infrastructure. Qualifications Degree qualification in engineering or a related discipline; a master’s degree or professional certification in circular economy, sustainable business, or a similar field is preferred. Chartered Institution of Waste Management (CIWM) membership, or equivalent professional body registration, is preferred. Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents. Generous annual leave balance. Flexible and hybrid work solutions. Remote work opportunities outside of country. Company gratuity scheme. title: Planning engineer
jobDescription:
Job Title: Planning engineer

Job Location: Chennai, India

Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

We are looking for a collaborative and sharp minded person to:

  • Develop and implement high-quality planning and scheduling standards to inform Project Managers.

  • Produce detailed logic linked project plans in P6.

  • Ensure integration of project control procedures into the project delivery process.

  • Provide expert advice including weekly or monthly schedule updates.

  • Production of monthly planning reports, resource updates and projections.

  • Production of ad-hoc reports informing the Project Manager of significant schedule impacts and their effect on progress and completion.

  • Prepare information and attend regular planning and progress meetings.

  • Able to accurately define project programmes and schedules with clarity.

  • Lead and aid development for leading a team of Planners.

Your purpose:

  • A recognized degree in electrical engineering or be qualified by experience.

  • An expert user of Primavera P6 and ideally MS project in all aspects of planning and scheduling.

  • Supporting the project team in the successful delivery of the project to agreed targets, e.g., programme, budget, and quality.

  • Breadth of experience across whole project and programme lifecycle. (e.g., Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation/Commissioning processes).

  • Proficient with Commercial and financial aspects of project management. The ability to reconcile cost information as it applies to the programmes of work.

  • Proficient in the use of Earned Value Analysis and experience of Schedule, Risk and Cost analysis.

  • Identifying, escalating, and managing any matters that could pose a potential contractual/commercial risk such as project deviations, slippage reports, opportunities, mitigations.

  • Proficient knowledge in the management in accordance with corporate, commercial governance and business policies, directives, and guidance.

  • Monitoring and reporting performance against programme, technical quality, financial and KPI targets; any necessary mitigation actions to prevent targets being missed.

  • Controlling change and managing effective change control process including claims.

  • Experience of working with company Enterprise systems and programmes in relation to contracts, e.g., NEC 4; FIDIC etc. Proficient in the use of NEC type contracts and management and implementation of the applying the contract clauses.

  • Effective client interface skills and experience with the ability to offer both strategic and project advice. Working knowledge of relevant Health and Safety legislation.

  • Experience in Variation claim will be an added advantage.

  • PMP certification will be an added advantage.

What you can bring:

  • Experienced Engineering Professional with professional qualification in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.

  • A confident and professional manner, coupled with excellent communication skills, with clients and colleagues alike, to ensure clarity in all situations and to effectively influence.

  • An analytical thinker, you'll also be able to show initiative and examples of creativity.

  • Ability to collaborate and build relationships across the wider teams.

  • Good report writing and presentation skills.

  • Self-motivated and able to work well on your own initiative.

  • Ability to work well under pressure and proven ability to deliver to deadlines.

  • Proven years of experience required.

  • Experience in overseas project in middle east , Europe and North American regions will be added advantage.

  • Experience in Substation, BESS, offshore-wind, renewables and railway electrification will be added advantage.

What we offer:

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits,

  • 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year.

  • Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression

  • When it comes to diversity and inclusion, we see things differently at Linxon - we encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations and more - so whoever you are, we hope you'll see things our way, too.

About Linxon

Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity.

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon.

Linxon's vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects.

As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a new company as it evolves and help shape it for the future. If you like new challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are interested in working with other motivated professionals with expertise in the Substations EPC business, then this is the new opportunity for you.

title: Electrical Engineer
jobDescription:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Electrical Design Engineer to join our multidisciplinary team, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions for rail depots, station buildings, and associated infrastructure. The role involves design leadership and coordination across UK rail projects, with additional exposure to Canadian and Middle Eastern markets.

Your role

  • Develop and check LV distribution designs, load calculations, short‑circuit and voltage‑drop studies, and protective device coordination in accordance with BS 7671 and other relevant standards.
  • Produce compliant lighting designs (platforms, concourses, yards, tunnels, FOB, Indoor and Outdoor area of the building) incl. illuminance/uniformity, glare, and emergency lighting using Dialux EVO; integrate energy‑efficient strategies aligned with project sustainability goals.
  • Perform earthing and bonding assessments for stations/lineside assets; prepare calculations, drawings and details.
  • Complete lightning protection risk assessments and layouts using Furse Strike (or equivalent), coordinating with structural and architectural constraints.
  • Size cables and containment (tray/trunking/ladder) considering installation methods, grouping, thermal effects and route feasibility.
  • Specify and integrate transformers, diesel generators (DG), UPS, Active Harmonic Filters (AHF), Power Factor (PF) correction, and Solar PV systems; develop SLDs, schematics, and I/O schedules.
  • Build and update ETAP models for load‑flow, short‑circuit, protection coordination and harmonics; translate study outcomes into practical settings and protection philosophies.
  • Prepare design documents (calculation notes, Bo Qs, specifications, method statements, design reports) and ensure quality/technical assurance.

About you

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • 8–10 years of experience in Electrical design, preferably within rail or large infrastructure projects.
  • Proven knowledge of UK standards (BS, Network Rail & LU standards) and familiarity with international codes (IEC, IEEE and Middle East standards).
  • Strong working knowledge of BS 7671 and UK rail design practices for LV distribution, earthing/bonding, junction/station lighting, and lineside E&P.
  • Prepare design documents (calculation notes, Bo Qs, specifications, method statements, design reports) and ensure quality/technical assurance.
  • Proficiency in Electrical design software (Amtech/Trimble, ETAP, Dialux Evo, EOM & Furse Strike) and BIM tools (Revit MEP or equivalent).
  • Strong communication and report-writing skills.
  • Experience with UK rail projects and GRIP/PACE stages.
  • Exposure to Canadian and Middle Eastern rail/building projects.
  • Working towards or holding professional accreditation (CIBSE/ CEng).

title: Environment Consultant II
jobDescription:
Overview

Atkins Réalis is one of the worlds' leading engineering design consultancies. We have the breadth and depth of expertise to respond to the most technically challenging and time critical infrastructure projects. As a provider of multi-discipline technical services, Atkins Réalis is committed to design excellence and delivery of excellent solutions which combine innovation, ingenuity, and best practice.

We currently have an opportunity for either an Assistant or Associate Consultant (depending on level of experience) to join the Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre in India. The role involves significant work on UK and International projects being delivered by the Atkins Réalis UK Sustainable Land and Resource Management practice across a range of market sectors like Highways, Rail, Tunnels, including the development of Cities, Mass Transit and Energy infrastructure.

We are looking for an individual with knowledge and experience of Environmental Site Assessments and Investigations, chemical assessment and quantitative risk assessment relating to land contamination, waste and brownfield regeneration, to join our Environment team and support an expanding project workload and client base.

Your role

  • 2-5 years' experience in conducting Phase 1 Site Assessment and Phase 2 intrusive Site Investigation, with experience of multiple site investigation techniques.
  • Post Graduate Degree qualified in a relevant engineering or science subject e.g. geology, geosciences, chemistry, environmental science and hydrogeology.
  • Demonstrate good, relevant land contamination/brownfield land experience in Phase 1 Desk Studies.
  • Knowledge and technical understanding of conceptual site models and generic risk assessments for soils and waters.
  • Proficient ability to interpret, review and analyse large and complex soil and water data sets.
  • Experience of producing well written factual and interpretative reports.
  • Good communication and presentation skills. ·
  • Understanding of environmental regulations ideally in the UK.
  • Ability to take initiative and work independently or within a team.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to the project/team/wider team.
  • Located near an Atkins Réalis India office ideally Bengaluru or Mumbai, or willingness for regular travel to visit the team.
  • Experience of working for global regions will be preferable either in an excellence centre or in the region.
  • Knowledge / experience in soil waste management/waste handling/waste remediation is an advantage.
  • Field work experience would be an advance but not essential.
  • Knowledge and technical understanding of controlled waters (surface water and groundwater) and human health generic risk assessments and screening criteria used in the UK.
  • UK industry standards and codes of practice for ground investigations and potentially contaminated sites i.e. CIRIA, 2001. Contaminated land risk assessment. A guide to good practice (C552), and have broad understanding of DEFRA, 2012. Environmental Protection Act 1990: Part 2A, Contaminated Land Statutory Guidance etc.

About You

  • Work primarily with contaminated land, soils materials and waste specialists in the UK to undertake project specific soil re-use and waste classification and assessment requirements.
  • Training provided as part of the role to undertake waste classification and gain better understanding of the tasks and tools involved.
  • Originate waste classification tasks, including assessment and reporting deliverables prior to issuing for check and review.
  • Originate soil and material management and permitting requirements and technical documents that may be required as part of the project.
  • Originate contaminated land assessments and factual/interpretive reports including organisation, collation, and assessment of desk-based information as part of Phase 1 Desk Studies and Phase 2 ground investigation reports.
  • Data management of large data sets of soils and water data using software packages such as sample scheduling, data transfer and statistics.

  • Assisting in designing or able to design (then organise) environmental/geo-environmental site investigations, including soil sampling and ground gas/vapour/leachate/groundwater and surface water monitoring/sampling.

  • Preparing Method Statements, Specifications and Drawings.
  • Scheduling and managing work to acceptable quality, on time and to budget.
  • Preparing and reviewing health and safety plans as part of managing health and safety on sites.
  • Developing own competence with support from the business on own training and development needs.

Rewards & benefits

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
  • Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Overview

Atkins Réalis is one of the worlds' leading engineering design consultancies. We have the breadth and depth of expertise to respond to the most technically challenging and time critical infrastructure projects. As a provider of multi-discipline technical services, Atkins Réalis is committed to design excellence and delivery of excellent solutions which combine innovation, ingenuity, and best practice.

We currently have an opportunity for either an Assistant or Associate Consultant (depending on level of experience) to join the Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre in India. The role involves significant work on UK and International projects being delivered by the Atkins Réalis UK Sustainable Land and Resource Management practice across a range of market sectors like Highways, Rail, Tunnels, including the development of Cities, Mass Transit and Energy infrastructure.

We are looking for an individual with knowledge and experience of Environmental Site Assessments and Investigations, chemical assessment and quantitative risk assessment relating to land contamination, waste and brownfield regeneration, to join our Environment team and support an expanding project workload and client base.

Your role

  • 2-5 years' experience in conducting Phase 1 Site Assessment and Phase 2 intrusive Site Investigation, with experience of multiple site investigation techniques.
  • Post Graduate Degree qualified in a relevant engineering or science subject e.g. geology, geosciences, chemistry, environmental science and hydrogeology.
  • Demonstrate good, relevant land contamination/brownfield land experience in Phase 1 Desk Studies.
  • Knowledge and technical understanding of conceptual site models and generic risk assessments for soils and waters.
  • Proficient ability to interpret, review and analyse large and complex soil and water data sets.
  • Experience of producing well written factual and interpretative reports.
  • Good communication and presentation skills. ·
  • Understanding of environmental regulations ideally in the UK.
  • Ability to take initiative and work independently or within a team.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to the project/team/wider team.
  • Located near an Atkins Réalis India office ideally Bengaluru or Mumbai, or willingness for regular travel to visit the team.
  • Experience of working for global regions will be preferable either in an excellence centre or in the region.
  • Knowledge / experience in soil waste management/waste handling/waste remediation is an advantage.
  • Field work experience would be an advance but not essential.
  • Knowledge and technical understanding of controlled waters (surface water and groundwater) and human health generic risk assessments and screening criteria used in the UK.
  • UK industry standards and codes of practice for ground investigations and potentially contaminated sites i.e. CIRIA, 2001. Contaminated land risk assessment. A guide to good practice (C552), and have broad understanding of DEFRA, 2012. Environmental Protection Act 1990: Part 2A, Contaminated Land Statutory Guidance etc.

About You

  • Work primarily with contaminated land, soils materials and waste specialists in the UK to undertake project specific soil re-use and waste classification and assessment requirements.
  • Training provided as part of the role to undertake waste classification and gain better understanding of the tasks and tools involved.
  • Originate waste classification tasks, including assessment and reporting deliverables prior to issuing for check and review.
  • Originate soil and material management and permitting requirements and technical documents that may be required as part of the project.
  • Originate contaminated land assessments and factual/interpretive reports including organisation, collation, and assessment of desk-based information as part of Phase 1 Desk Studies and Phase 2 ground investigation reports.
  • Data management of large data sets of soils and water data using software packages such as sample scheduling, data transfer and statistics.

  • Assisting in designing or able to design (then organise) environmental/geo-environmental site investigations, including soil sampling and ground gas/vapour/leachate/groundwater and surface water monitoring/sampling.

  • Preparing Method Statements, Specifications and Drawings.
  • Scheduling and managing work to acceptable quality, on time and to budget.
  • Preparing and reviewing health and safety plans as part of managing health and safety on sites.
  • Developing own competence with support from the business on own training and development needs.

Rewards & benefits

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
  • Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Overview

Atkins Réalis is one of the worlds' leading engineering design consultancies. We have the breadth and depth of expertise to respond to the most technically challenging and time critical infrastructure projects. As a provider of multi-discipline technical services, Atkins Réalis is committed to design excellence and delivery of excellent solutions which combine innovation, ingenuity, and best practice.

We currently have an opportunity for either an Assistant or Associate Consultant (depending on level of experience) to join the Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre in India. The role involves significant work on UK and International projects being delivered by the Atkins Réalis UK Sustainable Land and Resource Management practice across a range of market sectors like Highways, Rail, Tunnels, including the development of Cities, Mass Transit and Energy infrastructure.

We are looking for an individual with knowledge and experience of Environmental Site Assessments and Investigations, chemical assessment and quantitative risk assessment relating to land contamination, waste and brownfield regeneration, to join our Environment team and support an expanding project workload and client base.

Your role

  • 2-5 years' experience in conducting Phase 1 Site Assessment and Phase 2 intrusive Site Investigation, with experience of multiple site investigation techniques.
  • Post Graduate Degree qualified in a relevant engineering or science subject e.g. geology, geosciences, chemistry, environmental science and hydrogeology.
  • Demonstrate good, relevant land contamination/brownfield land experience in Phase 1 Desk Studies.
  • Knowledge and technical understanding of conceptual site models and generic risk assessments for soils and waters.
  • Proficient ability to interpret, review and analyse large and complex soil and water data sets.
  • Experience of producing well written factual and interpretative reports.
  • Good communication and presentation skills. ·
  • Understanding of environmental regulations ideally in the UK.
  • Ability to take initiative and work independently or within a team.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to the project/team/wider team.
  • Located near an Atkins Réalis India office ideally Bengaluru or Mumbai, or willingness for regular travel to visit the team.
  • Experience of working for global regions will be preferable either in an excellence centre or in the region.
  • Knowledge / experience in soil waste management/waste handling/waste remediation is an advantage.
  • Field work experience would be an advance but not essential.
  • Knowledge and technical understanding of controlled waters (surface water and groundwater) and human health generic risk assessments and screening criteria used in the UK.
  • UK industry standards and codes of practice for ground investigations and potentially contaminated sites i.e. CIRIA, 2001. Contaminated land risk assessment. A guide to good practice (C552), and have broad understanding of DEFRA, 2012. Environmental Protection Act 1990: Part 2A, Contaminated Land Statutory Guidance etc.

About You

  • Work primarily with contaminated land, soils materials and waste specialists in the UK to undertake project specific soil re-use and waste classification and assessment requirements.
  • Training provided as part of the role to undertake waste classification and gain better understanding of the tasks and tools involved.
  • Originate waste classification tasks, including assessment and reporting deliverables prior to issuing for check and review.
  • Originate soil and material management and permitting requirements and technical documents that may be required as part of the project.
  • Originate contaminated land assessments and factual/interpretive reports including organisation, collation, and assessment of desk-based information as part of Phase 1 Desk Studies and Phase 2 ground investigation reports.
  • Data management of large data sets of soils and water data using software packages such as sample scheduling, data transfer and statistics.

  • Assisting in designing or able to design (then organise) environmental/geo-environmental site investigations, including soil sampling and ground gas/vapour/leachate/groundwater and surface water monitoring/sampling.

  • Preparing Method Statements, Specifications and Drawings.
  • Scheduling and managing work to acceptable quality, on time and to budget.
  • Preparing and reviewing health and safety plans as part of managing health and safety on sites.
  • Developing own competence with support from the business on own training and development needs.

Rewards & benefits

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
  • Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

title: Engineer - Enterprise Service Management
jobDescription:
Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

What will you do?

We are seeking a motivated Engineer – Enterprise Service Management (ITSM & PMO) to support and strengthen IT service delivery and governance. This role is a blend of IT Service Management operations and Project Management Office (PMO) support, making it ideal for candidates who enjoy both operational excellence and reporting/analytics.

This role will play a critical role in ensuring high-quality IT services, maintaining SLA compliance, and driving continuous service improvement through data-driven insights.

Additionally, the role requires stepping in as a Major Incident Manager (MIM), ensuring rapid response, coordination, and resolution of critical business-impacting incidents.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and oversee daily ITSM process including incidents, service requests, changes and Problems.
  • Ensure adherence to SLA targets and service quality standards.
  • Monitor and track service performance against SLAs and OLAs.
  • Prepare and publish daily, weekly, and monthly reports.
  • Analyze trends and provide insights into service performance and improvements.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and metrics reports.
  • Support PMO activities including Status tracking, Dashboard preparation, Project reporting.
  • Develop executive-level presentations with key insights and recommendations.
  • Assist in governance and documentation activities.
  • Act as Major Incident Manager when required.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, vendors and stakeholders.
  • Facilitate bridge calls and stakeholder communication during critical incidents

Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in IT Service Management / PMO support
  • Strong understanding of ITIL processes (ITIL foundation certification is preferred).
  • Knowledge in ITSM tools (Service Now/ Fresh service etc.).
  • Good knowledge of reporting tools and dashboards (Excel, Power BI, etc.)
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and coordination skills.

What we offer:

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits,

  • 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year.

  • Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression

title: Manager - Project Planning & Controls
jobDescription:
Overview

The Project & Programme Services (PPS) team is a critical component of the Global Project & Programme Management Office (GPMO). The team delivers predictable and efficient project performance management, reporting, and business intelligence across global portfolios. Operating from the Global Technology Centre (GTC) in India, PPS provides cost‑efficient, agile, and scalable programme services using an onshore–offshore delivery model. Our ambition is to become the global leader in Programme Management Services by building a future-ready, digitally enabled, high-performing team.

The Manager Project Planning & Controls (P3B) is responsible for leading project controls functions for complex, high-value programmes. The role requires advanced expertise in planning, scheduling, cost control, performance analytics, and stakeholder management. The position acts as a specialist advisor, leading teams, guiding clients, resolving issues, and ensuring high-quality delivery across programmes.

The Manager Project Planning & Controls (P3B) will manage client engagements, lead multidisciplinary project control teams, drive best practices, and ensure governance and compliance across the project lifecycle.

Your role

Planning & Scheduling

  • Develop, lead and manage comprehensive project schedules using Primavera P6, ensuring compliance with the Client /Region specific guidelines/standards.
  • Plan and sequence project activities across all phases, including design, procurement, and construction.
  • Conduct Critical Path Analysis (CPA) and propose mitigation measures to maintain project timelines.
  • Prepare detailed 4-week and 8-week lookahead programs and integrate them into the master schedule.
  • Perform regular updates and integrity checks on project schedules, ensuring alignment with Client /Region specific Scheule Management Manual & DCMA criteria.
  • Identify key dependencies and assess project risks to develop mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure integration of cost, schedule, and resource plans.
  • Track milestones and ensure adherence to key delivery timelines.
  • Identify schedule variances and recommend corrective actions.
  • Guide team in preparation of S-curves, EV reports, dashboards, and schedule analytics.
  • Support project teams with cost-loaded schedules and conduct Earned Value Analysis (EVA) to track project performance.
  • Identify potential schedule risks and incorporate risk mitigation strategies, including quantitative risk analysis (e.g., Monte Carlo simulations).
  • Implement and manage change control processes as per NH guidelines to adjust Performance Measurement Baselines (PMB) for scope or schedule variations.
  • Provide strategic input in meetings, addressing technical planning challenges.
  • Support delay analysis, impact assessment, and time extension claims.
  • Collaborate with planning engineers to improve planning methodologies.

Cost Management & Controls

  • Develop, lead and manage budgeting, forecasting, cost monitoring, and financial reporting activities.
  • Establish and manage Cost Breakdown Structures (CBS) aligned with the WBS.
  • Provide detailed cost reports that highlight any discrepancies between actual costs and forecasted budgets, ensuring that project stakeholders are informed promptly.
  • Analyze cost variances and trends to recommend corrective actions.
  • Prepare earned value assessments and monthly cash flow forecasts.
  • Standardize and automate tools for pricing, estimation, and cost tracking.
  • Generate financial dashboards and visual reports to present cost trends, highlighting cost savings, potential risks, and areas requiring attention.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational cost governance processes.
  • Support early warnings, change orders, and client negotiations.
  • Performance Reporting & Analytics
  • Produce and review weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc project performance reports.
  • Create and present accurate reports, including Schedule Narratives, Key Milestone Variance Reports, and Program Review Reports (PRR).
  • Develop, track, and report KPIs across cost, schedule, quality, and risk.
  • Ensure high-quality, consistent reporting standards across all deliverables.
  • Generate Power BI dashboards for progress visualization and stakeholder communication.
  • Preparation and Submission of Monthly Progress Report, Program Attributes List, Change logs, S Curves and CPA Reports, Variance Reports, Trend Analysis reports, EVM dash Boards Etc.
  • Present project performance insights to senior management and clients.
  • Analyse large datasets and convert insights into actionable recommendations.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Act as a Subject matter expert and provide technical guidance and recommendations to the team.
  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of planners, schedulers, cost controllers, and analysts.
  • Drive capability development and skill enhancement across the team.
  • Conduct performance reviews and ensure continuous professional growth.
  • Maintain healthy team morale, collaboration, and effective conflict resolution.
  • Ensure quality assurance and sign-off for all project control deliverables.
  • Build succession plans and develop next-generation project controls leaders.

Stakeholder & Client Engagement

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary team, project managers, engineering teams, contractors, and clients.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Project planning & project controls-related discussions.
  • Ensure alignment of all stakeholders on planning, scheduling, and cost objectives.
  • Participate in client meetings, steering committees, and cross‑functional reviews.
  • Maintain strong working relationships to support successful project outcomes.
  • Provide expert guidance to internal and external stakeholders on best practices.

About you

  • Minimum 12–18 years of project delivery experience in engineering consultancy, design, or project management environments.
  • Bachelor's/master's degree in engineering: Civil, Mechanical, Construction Management, Building Technology, or related field.
  • Excellent communication, client-facing, presentation, and report-writing skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to work under pressure and adapt to change.
  • Strong project management acumen and experience in cost & schedule governance.
  • Ability to propose innovative solutions, processes, and working methods.
  • Desired Requirements / Technical Expertise
  • Subject Matter Expertise in Planning / Project Controls.
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 and MS Project.
  • Experience in delay analysis, impact assessments, and baseline development.
  • Proficiency in Cost Management tools (Eco Sys preferred).
  • Deep knowledge of Earned Value Management (EVM), CBS, budget control, cash flow, contingency management, and change control.
  • Experience in baseline creation, progress tracking, and CL31, CL32 & CL62 schedule analysis.
  • Experience with global (UK, US, Middle East) transportation, infrastructure, E&M projects.
  • Knowledge of NEC3/NEC4 contracts.
  • Experience in large-scale Enterprise Project Management environments.
  • Data Analytics & Power BI Expertise
  • Advanced Power BI development, including dashboards, data models, DAX, and custom analytics.
  • Ability to analyze large datasets and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience with ETL design, automation, and BI system optimization.
  • SQL proficiency for data retrieval and transformation.
  • Experience in automation using VBA, Python, or web technologies is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of O365 productivity suite.
  • Certifications (Preferred)
  • Relevant certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), AACE's Certified Cost Professional (CCP), or PMI's Scheduling Professional (PMI-SP)
  • Primavera / Eco Sys Certifications
  • Chartered status or equivalent professional certifications (e.g., RICS, PMP) is added advantage.
  • Other relevant project controls or construction management credentials
  • Strong leadership and people management capability
  • Client-centric approach
  • Analytical and critical-thinking skills
  • Ability to influence and manage conflict
  • Proactive problem solving
  • High emotional intelligence and team motivation ability

title: Plumbing and Fire Protection Engineer (BIM Engineer)
jobDescription:
Overview

Experienced in undertaking PHE (Plumbing), Fire Protection, and associated building services design in accordance with local and international standards, including Canada, Middle East (ME), and UK regions. Well-versed in applying Canada, British, European, ME, and Atkins Réalis standards across diverse project types.
Proficient in designing a wide range of plumbing systems such as domestic cold and hot water services, sanitary and vent systems, and underground drainage networks. Possesses strong technical knowledge of wet and dry fire protection systems, covering both design fundamentals and operational requirements.
Skilled in the design of Medical Gas and LPG systems with a strong focus on safety compliance and engineering best practices. Experienced in conducting peer reviews for fire protection system designs and preparing detailed technical review reports.

Your role

  • Undertake PHE (Plumbing) and Fire Protection system design to local and international standards, including Canada, Middle East (ME), UK region.
  • Understand and apply Canada / British / European, ME and Atkins Réalis standards.
  • Undertake design of a variety of Plumbing design elements i.e. Domestic cold and hot water services, Sanitary and Vent, underground drainage.
  • Thorough understanding of wet and dry fire protection systems, including their design principles and operational requirements.
  • Proficient in Medical Gas and LPG systems, with expertise in design principles and adherence to safety standards.
  • Conducting peer reviews of fire protection system design and producing technical review reports.
  • Responsible for completion of projects within his/her team to time and cost.
  • Assist the Team leader/ Senior Engineer / Engineers in presenting design solutions in meeting with clients and contractors.
  • Check own PHE/Plumbing designs deliverables and able to check design prepared within own team and other groups within area of expertise.
  • Realistically estimate pricing associated with projects within their area of expertise.
  • Undertake liaison with System engineers, third parties and specialist system suppliers and incorporate their requirements in the detail design.
  • Coordinate with all other disciplines and improve inter-discipline working with other disciplines such as Architecture, Civil, MEP and Structural.

About you

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering , with prior experience in plumbing / Fire protection design within a design consultancy environment.
  • Working towards Professional registration (P Eng, C Eng or IEng) or be able to prove progression towards Chartership.
  • Should be capable of handling Revit and Plumbing/FPS design concurrently, with demonstrated proficiency in hydraulic calculation software such as Hydra CALC, Sprink CALC, HASS, and similar tools.
  • Must have thorough knowledge of Plumbing design calculations, including water supply, drainage, and pump sizing as per relevant codes and standards.
  • Relevant and appropriate experience of 10 to 13 years as a Plumbing and Fire engineer within building services.
  • Wider Knowledge on other disciplines is desirable.
  • Demonstrate knowledge and experience of the use of BS codes, NFC, NPC, LEED, NFPA, FM global guidelines, CIBSE, UPC, IBC, IPC and IOP
  • Experience of working in Multi-D'environment and good understanding of co-ordination and interfaces with other disciplines.
  • Experience of large-scale infrastructure projects.
  • Be a competent user of IT tools in particular Word, Excel, Outlook and Industry design tools.
  • Authors technical reports of acceptable technical and presentational quality. Able to present their work on the project presentations and meetings.
  • Able to deliver work and integrate with larger project teams.
  • Good report writing skills, experience of making presentations to and attending meetings with clients is essential.
  • Proactive and Member of IOP, IET or CIBSE with PEng , CEng or IEng status or working towards would be preferred.
  • Relevant and appropriate experience as a designer within building services.
  • You will be a competent designer to BS, NFC, NPC, IPC, CIBSE and various NFPA standards.
  • You should have hands-on experience in preparing Revit 3D models, review Navisworks files and managing design delivery using BIM expertise.
  • Demonstrates the necessary level of competence and responsibility according to the grade.
  • You will manage productivity and quality of your deliverables.
  • Maintains harmony and a productive atmosphere by being open about the work activities and project status.
  • Good command of the English language and effective communication skills, both written and verbal. Knowledge of French is beneficial, and willingness to undertake French language training as per business requirements.

Reward & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage
  • Medical insurance for you and your dependents
  • Annual leave balance in accordance with local labour law
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions
  • Opportunity for local and global internal transfers
  • Company gratuity scheme
  • Discretionary bonus program
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

title: Lead Hydrogeologist / Modeller
jobDescription:
Overview

Atkins Réalis is one of the worlds' leading engineering design consultancies. We have the breadth and depth of expertise to respond to the most technically challenging and time critical infrastructure projects. As a provider of multi-discipline technical services, Atkins Réalis is committed to design excellence and delivery of excellent solutions which combine innovation, ingenuity, and best practice.

We currently have an opportunity for a Senior Hydrogeologist specialising in hydrogeology, groundwater management or subsurface modelling to join the Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre in India. The role involves significant work on UK, ME and other International projects being delivered by the Atkins Réalis UK Sustainable Land and Resource Management practice across a range of market sectors like Highways, Rail, Tunnels, including the development of Cities, Mass Transit and Energy infrastructure.

Your role

  • 10+ years' experience for senior and team lead role.
  • Experience in environmental assessment, especially in hydrogeological impact studies, development of ground models, monitoring data analysis, and groundwater risk analysis.
  • Post Graduate Degree qualified in a relevant engineering or science subject e.g. geology, geosciences, geochemistry, water resources, environmental science, groundwater and hydrogeology.
  • Experience of conducting baseline site assessment, interpreting Site Investigation reports, with experience of multiple data processing and visualization techniques.
  • Experiene in developing conceptual site and numerical models (2D and 3D).
  • Hands-on experience with data analysis / characterisation / simulation process / data management.
  • Ability to interpret and analyse large and complex geology, soil and water data sets and produce well written factual and interpretative reports.
  • Skills to conduct generic and detailed quantitative risk assessments for soils and waters.
  • Good communication and presentation skills with ability to network and build strong links to the UK practice.
  • Knowledge on Regulatory Compliance and Permitting process of UK and ME.
  • Ability to take initiative and work independently or within a team.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to the project/team/wider team.
  • Located near an Atkins Réalis India office ideally Bengaluru / Mumbai / Pune / Noida / Gurgaon, or willingness for regular travel to visit the team.

About you

  • Experience of working for global regions will be preferable either in an excellence centre or in the region.
  • Experience in hydrogeological modelling (LEAPFROG), mapping analysis (SURFER, Arc GIS), field pumping data analysis (AQUTESOLV), etc.
  • Experience in integrated groundwater modelling (FEFLOW, MODFLOW), water management, constructional dewatering (DC-DW), subsurface drainage design, risk mitigation is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience in water balance studies integrating different sectors of hydrogeological cycle.
  • Field work experience would be an advance but not essential.
  • Knowledge and technical understanding of controlled water (surface water and groundwater), generic risk assessments on environment and human health, and hydrogeological studies conducted in the UK.
  • UK industry standards and codes of practice for ground investigations and potentially contaminated sites i.e. CIRIA, 2001, Constructional dewatering CIRIA, C750, A guide to good practice (C552), and have broad understanding of Environmental Protection Act 1990, etc.
  • Build excellent network, excellent professional relationships and strong links to the UK practice including utilising good communication and presentation skills.
  • Work to high standards, ensuring the right first-time delivery and taking ownership of the self work.
  • Check the originated geological, soil - water management analysis and reporting deliverables prior to issuing for review.
  • Oringate and check the originated abstraction, construction and other license permitting requirements and technical documents that may be required as part of the project.
  • Originate and check hydrogeological factual/interpretive reports including organisation, collation, and assessment of desk-based information as part of Phase 1 Desk Studies and Phase 2 ground investigation reports.
  • Data management of large data sets of soils and water data using software packages such as R, Power BI, MS-Excel, Statistics.
  • Assisting in designing or able to design (then organise) environmental/geo-environmental site investigations, including soil sampling and ground gas / vapour / leachate / groundwater and surface water monitoring / sampling.
  • Preparing Method Statements, Specifications and Drawings.
  • Scheduling and managing work to acceptable quality, on time and to budget.
  • Compliance with Health and Safety Policies and Procedures, including preparing and reviewing health and safety plans and managing health and safety on sites.
  • Developing own competence with support from the business on own training and development needs.

Reward & benefits

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
  • Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

description:
Overview

Atkins Réalis is one of the worlds' leading engineering design consultancies. We have the breadth and depth of expertise to respond to the most technically challenging and time critical infrastructure projects. As a provider of multi-discipline technical services, Atkins Réalis is committed to design excellence and delivery of excellent solutions which combine innovation, ingenuity, and best practice.

We currently have an opportunity for a Senior Hydrogeologist specialising in hydrogeology, groundwater management or subsurface modelling to join the Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre in India. The role involves significant work on UK, ME and other International projects being delivered by the Atkins Réalis UK Sustainable Land and Resource Management practice across a range of market sectors like Highways, Rail, Tunnels, including the development of Cities, Mass Transit and Energy infrastructure.

Your role

  • 10+ years' experience for senior and team lead role.
  • Experience in environmental assessment, especially in hydrogeological impact studies, development of ground models, monitoring data analysis, and groundwater risk analysis.
  • Post Graduate Degree qualified in a relevant engineering or science subject e.g. geology, geosciences, geochemistry, water resources, environmental science, groundwater and hydrogeology.
  • Experience of conducting baseline site assessment, interpreting Site Investigation reports, with experience of multiple data processing and visualization techniques.
  • Experiene in developing conceptual site and numerical models (2D and 3D).
  • Hands-on experience with data analysis / characterisation / simulation process / data management.
  • Ability to interpret and analyse large and complex geology, soil and water data sets and produce well written factual and interpretative reports.
  • Skills to conduct generic and detailed quantitative risk assessments for soils and waters.
  • Good communication and presentation skills with ability to network and build strong links to the UK practice.
  • Knowledge on Regulatory Compliance and Permitting process of UK and ME.
  • Ability to take initiative and work independently or within a team.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to the project/team/wider team.
  • Located near an Atkins Réalis India office ideally Bengaluru / Mumbai / Pune / Noida / Gurgaon, or willingness for regular travel to visit the team.

About you

  • Experience of working for global regions will be preferable either in an excellence centre or in the region.
  • Experience in hydrogeological modelling (LEAPFROG), mapping analysis (SURFER, Arc GIS), field pumping data analysis (AQUTESOLV), etc.
  • Experience in integrated groundwater modelling (FEFLOW, MODFLOW), water management, constructional dewatering (DC-DW), subsurface drainage design, risk mitigation is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience in water balance studies integrating different sectors of hydrogeological cycle.
  • Field work experience would be an advance but not essential.
  • Knowledge and technical understanding of controlled water (surface water and groundwater), generic risk assessments on environment and human health, and hydrogeological studies conducted in the UK.
  • UK industry standards and codes of practice for ground investigations and potentially contaminated sites i.e. CIRIA, 2001, Constructional dewatering CIRIA, C750, A guide to good practice (C552), and have broad understanding of Environmental Protection Act 1990, etc.
  • Build excellent network, excellent professional relationships and strong links to the UK practice including utilising good communication and presentation skills.
  • Work to high standards, ensuring the right first-time delivery and taking ownership of the self work.
  • Check the originated geological, soil - water management analysis and reporting deliverables prior to issuing for review.
  • Oringate and check the originated abstraction, construction and other license permitting requirements and technical documents that may be required as part of the project.
  • Originate and check hydrogeological factual/interpretive reports including organisation, collation, and assessment of desk-based information as part of Phase 1 Desk Studies and Phase 2 ground investigation reports.
  • Data management of large data sets of soils and water data using software packages such as R, Power BI, MS-Excel, Statistics.
  • Assisting in designing or able to design (then organise) environmental/geo-environmental site investigations, including soil sampling and ground gas / vapour / leachate / groundwater and surface water monitoring / sampling.
  • Preparing Method Statements, Specifications and Drawings.
  • Scheduling and managing work to acceptable quality, on time and to budget.
  • Compliance with Health and Safety Policies and Procedures, including preparing and reviewing health and safety plans and managing health and safety on sites.
  • Developing own competence with support from the business on own training and development needs.

Reward & benefits

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
  • Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

title: BIM Modeller - Dry utilities ( Infrastructure / Civil 3D )
jobDescription:

  • To work as part of Atkinsrealis' BIM/CAD team under the Middle East delivery Team.

  • To assist in delivering a range of projects relating to infrastructure utility design and planning.

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electrical / Civil Engineering or equivalent technical discipline plus 3 to 10 years of experience in progressive drafting and design experience.

title: Lead Landscape Architect
jobDescription:
Overview

Atkins Réalis is one of the world's most respected design, engineering and project management consultancies, with a proven track record of more than 75 years of relevant experience in the industry. Atkins Réalis a leading provider of consultancy services in the field of master planning, economics and sustainability; architecture environmental management; landscape & urban design; infrastructure planning; and engineering and transportation analysis, offering professional advice, engineering and environmental consultancy and design solutions.

As a provider of multi-disciplinary technical design services to the built environment, Atkins Réalis India is committed to design excellence in the delivery of first-class solutions which combine innovation, imagination and best practice.

The Landscape & Urban Design practice in Atkins Réalis India is currently expanding to contribute to the different sectors including Property, Infrastructure & Transportation all around the world. We are keen to take on board highly motivated and capable landscape architects and urban designers to shape a well-integrated team delivering projects across the globe.

Your role

  • Lead Middle East projects with complete design and delivery ownership reporting to Practice Lead.
  • Take ownership and lead medium to large scale projects from landscape and public realm work packages.
  • Draft technical reports and contractual documents, of acceptable technical and presentation quality with minimum guidance.
  • Design and manage multi-disciplinary Landscape development projects.
  • Liaise with key clients and technical and non-technical stakeholders for positive project outcomes.
  • Draft technical reports and contractual documents, of acceptable technical and presentation quality with minimum guidance.

  • Demonstrate strategic thinking to expand the landscape & urban design business across different regions in the ME.

title: Lead Civil Engineer
jobDescription:
Overview

Power Grid Division is involved in electricity utilities sector in the UK & I, Canada, US, ME and APAC. We provide value-added engineering services and built solutions across the entire spectrum of electricity networks, from high voltage power transmission grids to low voltage industrial power distribution. We have designed HV Substations upto 400k V and Electrical infrastructure for large industrial/ Multi Use developments and Heavy industries. The team provides services to clients across the globe; however the major clients are in UK and Middle East.

The Power T&D team is looking for experienced Principal engineers in HV Plant Discipline, as we look to grow the team in line with business requirements. So, if you are interested in working for an internationally renowned consultancy and working on some challenging projects across UK, Canada & ANZ, come join us at Atkins Réalis.

Your role

  • Engineer – Senior (Lead) Civil / Structural
  • We are looking for highly experienced engineers for a Senior role in 'Civils & Structures' design for transmission and distribution projects as we look to grow the team in line with business requirements. So, if you are interested in working for an internationally renowned consultancy and working on some of the challenging projects across Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) come and join us at Atkins Réalis.
  • Using your experience and knowledge, you will be leading the delivery of a variety of projects drawing upon the wider team for the technical engineering requirements and building a strong relationship with our clients. You will be client-facing, responsible for the delivery of our work and making sure it meets our client's'expectations.
  • Designing of GIS buildings, Control Rooms, Switchyard civils, Transformer bunds and foundations.
  • Civils/Structure detailing, calculations and material take-off.
  • Design Basis Reports based client specifications,
  • Perform studies, write reports, specifications and other technical documentation.
  • Prepare construction details and supervise the work of technicians and designers.
  • Stay up to date on the latest technologies to integrate them into the process of conception.
  • Coordinate the work internally as well as with the client.
  • Respond to request for proposals (RFP) by preparing proposals & estimation of man-hours.
  • Mentoring junior staffs and able to provide training on subject of expertise and present study results to Clients.
  • Strong conceptualization ability, strong interpersonal communication and organizational
  • skills are a must, including the capability to explain and resolve complex technical issues, critical thinking and decision-making ability. Candidate must have good oral and written communication skills, be willing to travel, and work successfully in a customer focused, project-oriented environment.

About you

  • Broad knowledge of Civil Engineering components of Power, Transmission & Distribution Project.
  • Sound understanding of technical principles underlying civil engineering, particularly civil engineering structures, foundation and equipment foundations related to Power Business – Including Generation and Power Networks
  • Awareness of current international design codes and standards, especially BS and Euro codes.

title: Enterprise Architect
jobDescription:
Job Title: Enterprise Architect – ERP, Migration & AMS (Build + Run Ownership)

Job Location: Chennai, India

Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

The Enterprise Architect is responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the organization's'enterprise architecture across business applications, engineering platforms, project delivery systems, enterprise services, data, AI, cloud, cybersecurity, and operational support functions.

This role serves as the enterprise-wide architecture authority, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and solutions align with business strategy, operational goals, digital transformation objectives, and long-term enterprise roadmaps.

The Enterprise Architect owns the architecture lifecycle for a diverse portfolio of business-critical applications spanning Engineering, Project Delivery, ERP, Finance, HR, Procurement, Collaboration, AI, Data & Analytics, Security, and Enterprise Services. ERP is one component of the broader enterprise landscape and not the primary focus of the role.

The role is accountable for ensuring platforms are:

  • Business-aligned
  • Secure by design
  • Integrated and data-driven
  • Scalable and resilient
  • Operationally supportable
  • Cost-effective
  • Governed throughout their lifecycle

What will you do?

Enterprise Architecture & Technology Strategy

  • Define and maintain enterprise architecture principles, standards, and governance frameworks.
  • Develop current-state, target-state, and transition-state architectures.
  • Create multi-year technology and business capability roadmaps.
  • Align technology investments with strategic business outcomes.
  • Lead Architecture Review Boards and enterprise design governance.
  • Serve as the organization's'architecture authority.

Enterprise Application Portfolio Management

  • Govern the enterprise application portfolio.
  • Lead application rationalization and simplification initiatives.
  • Drive platform consolidation and standardization.
  • Reduce technology duplication and technical debt.
  • Establish lifecycle management practices across all platforms.

Ensure every application has:

  • Business Owner
  • Product Owner
  • Technical Owner
  • Support Model
  • Lifecycle Roadmap

Engineering & Digital Delivery Architecture

  • Establish Digital Engineering Architecture standards.
  • Define Common Data Environment (CDE) strategy.
  • Drive BIM governance and platform alignment.
  • Develop Project Information Management architecture.
  • Enable Digital Twin and intelligent engineering initiatives.
  • Standardize engineering platforms and collaboration models globally.

Enterprise Platform Architecture

  • Provide architecture leadership across Finance, Procurement, HR, ERP, Project Delivery, Engineering, and Corporate platforms.
  • Drive platform modernization and transformation initiatives.
  • Ensure interoperability across enterprise systems.
  • Maintain enterprise-wide application standards and governance.

Integration Architecture

  • Define enterprise integration strategy.
  • Establish API-first and event-driven architecture principles.
  • Define middleware and integration platform standards.
  • Ensure seamless integration across business-critical platforms.
  • Drive reusable and scalable integration patterns.

Data Architecture & Governance

  • Define enterprise data architecture.
  • Establish master data ownership and governance.
  • Drive data quality, stewardship, and lifecycle management.
  • Enable enterprise reporting, analytics, and business intelligence.
  • Ensure trusted and consistent data across business domains.

AI, Automation & Digital Innovation

  • Define enterprise AI architecture and governance.
  • Lead Microsoft Copilot strategy and implementation governance.
  • Establish Responsible AI principles.
  • Govern AI, machine learning, and automation solutions.
  • Enable intelligent business services and digital innovation.

Cloud & Technology Platform Strategy

  • Define cloud adoption and hosting strategies.
  • Establish architecture standards for Saa S, cloud, and hybrid platforms.
  • Drive platform resilience, scalability, and cost optimization.
  • Lead cloud governance and Fin Ops practices.
  • Ensure high availability and disaster recovery readiness.

Application Management Services (AMS) Governance

  • Define enterprise application support and operational governance standards.
  • Ensure seamless transition from project delivery to operational support.
  • Establish support models, service KPIs, and operational controls.
  • Drive continuous service improvement and automation.
  • Reduce application incidents, support costs, and operational risks.

Security, Risk & Compliance

  • Embed Security-by-Design principles into all solutions.
  • Govern identity, access management, and platform security standards.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and corporate requirements.
  • Support Zero Trust and enterprise cyber-security initiatives.
  • Partner with security teams to maintain an audit-ready technology landscape.

Vendor & Technology Governance

  • Govern strategic technology partnerships and vendor roadmaps.
  • Lead software asset management and licensing optimization initiatives.
  • Ensure vendor solutions align with enterprise standards.
  • Drive commercial optimization and technology value realization.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with business leaders, engineering leaders, finance leaders, HR leadership, and technology teams.
  • Influence strategic technology decisions at executive level.
  • Lead architecture communities and technical governance forums.
  • Mentor architects and develop enterprise architecture capabilities.
  • Build a culture of innovation, governance, standardization, and operational excellence.

Experience, Education and other Required:

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, Digital Transformation, or Technology Leadership roles.
  • Experience governing large-scale enterprise application portfolios.
  • Experience leading complex business and technology transformation programs.
  • Experience working across engineering, business, corporate, and digital platforms.
  • Experience operating in global, multi-vendor environments.
  • Experience balancing strategic transformation with operational excellence.

What we offer:

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits,

  • 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year
  • Global Career Progression Opportunities
  • Medical Insurance, Life Insurance

Building the infrastructure to power the world with carbon-free energy.

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's leading technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon.

Linxon's vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects.

As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a new company as it evolves and help shape it for the future. If you like new challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are interested in working with other motivated professionals with expertise in the Substations EPC business, then this is the new opportunity for you.

jobDescription:
Overview

Our teams are agile, collaborative and driven by possibilities. At every career stage, we have a structure of support and training to help you develop what you need to succeed. Our career programs put you in the driving seat, so you can manage your achievements and build on your strengths and abilities. With so many opportunities across the project lifecycle, your career route with Atkins Réalis can be as broad and varied as your vision.

Atkins Réalis Environment has one of the most experienced environmental and geosciences engineering consulting teams in Canada and is currently seeking a Senior Groundwater Analyst/Modeller to support our Canadian team from India. The employment opportunity will allow the successful applicant to support our expanding hydrogeology team on a variety of projects related to geotechnical, contaminated sites, water resourcing, mining, infrastructure, and/or environmental assessment.

Your role

  • The successful candidate will be part of a team involved in a wide variety of simulation of groundwater flow, surface water, and contaminant transport projects. These would include such projects as: tunnel and mine dewatering, tailings migration assessments, evaluation of injection and production well fields, aquifer evaluation, and various projects related to geotechnical, resource management, contaminated land and infrastructure projects, and environmental impact assessments.
  • The successful candidate will play a role in the field investigations, conceptual model development, problem assessment, analytical and numerical modelling, project communication and project management.

About you

  • University degree in Geology, Hydrogeology, or Geological / Environmental / Civil Engineering along with a minimum of 10-15 years of relevant experience. A post-graduate degree is an asset.
  • Must have experience using FEFLOW (3D), Geo Studio (CTRAN/W, SEEP/W, SEEP3D, SLOPE/W).
