title: PHE Engineer
jobDescription:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced PHE Design Engineer to join our multidisciplinary team, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions for rail depots, station buildings, and associated infrastructure. The role involves design leadership and coordination across UK rail projects, with additional exposure to Canadian and Middle Eastern markets.

Your role

  • Design water supply, Foul and Storm water drainage, and fire protection systems for rail depots and station facilities.
  • Address depot-specific challenges, including:
  • Oil-water separators for maintenance bays and wash-down areas.
  • Specialized drainage systems for maintenance pits and heavy-duty cleaning zones.
  • Frost protection strategies for water systems in cold climates (Canada, UK).
  • Develop schematic layouts, hydraulic calculations, and sizing of pumps, pipes, and tanks.
  • Ensure compliance with UK standards (BS EN), Network Rail specifications, and adapt designs for Canadian and Middle Eastern codes.
  • Working knowledge on BIM software such Auto CAD, Revit, Bentley- Micro Station, Open Building Designer
  • Prepare design reports, specifications and respond to technical queries.
  • Coordinate within MEP and other working disciplines for integrated design solutions considering buildability and operational requirements.
  • Utilize tools such as Auto CAD, Revit MEP, BIM 360 Or Bentley equivalent for reviewing models and generating schematics.

title: Senior Project Engineer - Primary
jobDescription:
Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

The Senior Project Engineer will be a member of the Linxon INOPC Engineering Team and will contribute towards the effective execution of the engineering functions within projects and tenders. The Engineer will work in a skilled team on a wide range of international T&D substation projects. The position will focus on the project and tender engineering and its interfaces and scope of work involved in HV - substation design and construction projects.

What will you do?

  • Evaluates, selects and applies standard techniques and procedures to perform engineering assignments. Provides technical support for installation and commissioning activities. Prepares project documentation within one's scope of deliverables.

  • Develop the tender engineering deliverable in short time with quality

  • Secure the completeness of the assigned packages and correct function of the resulting substation system.

  • Confirm the engineering is developed, taken into consideration the complete information and all inter discipline checks has been conducted, the results are documented in the project specific storage area.

  • Solves problems that appear during engineering development.

  • Focus on cost-efficient system solutions

  • Report and keep records for all engineering changes. Cooperate with the engineering team and agree on the project specific impacts, caused by the changes.

  • Ensure compliance with Linxon and Client engineering guidelines, standards and quality across the complete engineering process.

  • Creates work plans and cost estimates in own area of responsibility.

  • Co-ordinates clarify with engineers, sub-contractors and suppliers technical issues (within the assigned scope of work) and technical interfaces.

  • Collaborate with the site team, attend site during construction phase if necessary.

  • Contribute to the risk & opportunity register, by communicating observations.

  • Prepare all technical documentation for the equipment specification as input to the purchase requisitions

  • Contribute to the Up-to-date design issue log

  • Safety – Understand and follow Linxon OHS procedures and guidelines

  • Participate at design reviews.

  • Provide input for close out report and lessons learned, and follow/review lessons learned for next projects

Experience, Education and other Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree / master's degree in electrical / Power Engineering.

  • 8-14 years of experience in substation design with focus on HV Equipment expertise and overall system design.

  • Sound knowledge on engineering of AIS & GIS transmission and distribution substation up to 500k V.

  • Should have sound knowledge in BESS and if worked in BESS projects will give an advantage.

  • Wide knowledge on ANSI / IEEE standards is preferred.

  • Knowledge on NESC, NFPA 70, NFPA 780, NFPA 850 standards for substation engineering is desired.

  • Overall engineering design experience on 30%, 60%, 90% and IFC stages on Primary engineering in GIS/AIS substation & BESS projects for North America utilities is required.

  • Well-versed handling of ANSI units like – Feet and inches, Pounds etc is preferred.

  • Knowledge on international standards and best practices related to HV substation & equipment.

  • Hands on experience in HV Substation Electromechanical Design engineering preparation of One line diagram, three-line diagram, AIS/GIS & BESS substation layout, Sections, Cable trench / Conduit layout, Grounding layout and details, Specifications, Request For Quotation, Master Material List, SAG tension calculation, Bus bar selection, Short Circuit Force calculation, Shielding study, Grounding study, Cable engineering, Auxiliary system AC / DC study etc. Indoor / Outdoor Lighting system design etc.

  • Understanding of CAD / CAE applications and tools.

  • Understanding of electronic records management systems.

  • High attention to detail and quality.

  • Add on advantage of experience in Rail power distribution systems. (DC / AC system)

What we offer:

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits,

  • 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year

  • Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression

  • When it comes to diversity and inclusion, we see things differently at Linxon - we encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations and more - so whoever you are, we hope you'll see things our way, too.

About Linxon

Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity.

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon.

Linxon's vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects.

As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a new company as it evolves and help shape it for the future. If you like new challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are interested in working with other motivated professionals with expertise in the Substations EPC business, then this is the new opportunity for you.

title: Environmental Consultant
jobDescription:
Overview

We are seeking an Environmental Consultant to join our growing team in this role in Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre (GTC); you will collaborate with multidisciplinary technical specialists and contribute to a diverse portfolio of projects.

Your role

  • Support the preparation and delivery of Environmental Impact Assessments (EIAs), screening/scoping reports, and environmental statements.

  • Assist in environmental planning and consenting activities, including evidence gathering, baseline studies, and policy review.

  • Prepare technical sections such as Land Use, Socioeconomics, Environmental Management, and Sustainability.

  • Conduct desktop research, data analysis, GIS mapping support, and preparation of constraints plans.

  • Coordinate with internal disciplines (ecology, transport, utilities, planning, air quality, etc.) to compile environmental inputs.

  • Support the development and implementation of Environmental Management Systems (EMS) and environmental mitigation measures.

  • Draft high-quality technical reports, presentations, and client deliverables.

  • Assist senior consultants in project management tasks—programme tracking, documentation, QA/QC, and reporting.

  • Engage with clients and stakeholders professionally when required.

About you

  • Postgraduate degree qualified in an environmental or related discipline.

  • 4+ years' experience in leading and coordinating planning and environmental consenting, Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) processes and the implementation of Environmental Management Systems (EMS).

  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, work under pressure, and maintain technical excellence.

  • Strong analytical and report-writing skills.

title: Environment Consultant II
jobDescription:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Environment Consultant specialising in stakeholder engagement and consultation to support the GTC Planning, Environmental Consenting and Communities (PECC) discipline for high-profile infrastructure projects across the UK. You will work closely with clients, multidisciplinary engineering teams, and statutory authorities to navigate complex environmental pathways and build community consents.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape major developments in the road, rail, utilities, water, environment, and energy sectors from inception through to delivery.

Your role

  • Analyse and interpret quantitative and qualitative feedback, translating data into key consenting and environmental themes.
  • Create compelling, accessible and visually engaging consultation materials, including public-facing communications, exhibition boards, summaries, and digital content that clearly articulate complex information.
  • Support and draft consenting inputs for major infrastructure projects, demonstrating familiarity with relevant legislation (such as DCOs, TWAOs, or DNS).
  • Work collaboratively within multidisciplinary project teams, coordinating input from project managers, EIA specialists, engineers, legal advisors, and planners to ensure alignment with consenting requirements, programme milestones, and wider project objectives.
  • Support projects from end to end, ensuring deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

About you

  • More than six years of experience delivering large-scale stakeholder and community engagement programmes for major infrastructure projects, ideally within the UK or similar frameworks. Proven expertise in stakeholder engagement on complex, multidisciplinary projects across sectors such as roads, rail, utilities, water, environment, or energy.
  • Experience working with statutory consultees, local authorities, community groups, and other affected stakeholders.
  • Experience in desk-based community needs assessments and baseline studies.
  • Experience in preparing large-scale infrastructure Environmental and Social Management plans.
  • Experience in consultation data management, analysis, and visualisation (e.g. consultation dashboards, Power BI, stakeholder metrics, and reporting).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor content for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Postgraduate qualification (preferably a master's) in Public Policy, Environmental Planning, or Environmental Stakeholder Management.
  • Strong attention to detail and highly detail-oriented individual.

title: Electrical Safety Champion
jobDescription:
Job Title: Electrical Safety Champion

Location: Chennai, India

Join us!

The Electrical Safety Champion is a pivotal role within the Linxon Business, reporting to the Global HSE Manager. The Electrical Safety Champion is accountable that electrical safety has been fully considered within all associated aspects of Linxon's'engineering design and operational activities. This role involves supporting high voltage (HV) and low voltage (LV) design, assisting with the effective management of impressed voltage, and providing comprehensive specialist electrical safety support to the project sites. The Electrical Safety Champion will support Hub and local HSE Managers to ensure that Engineering and Operations Teams, Project Managers, and Installation and Commissioning Management are adequately planning for and considering electrical safety, impressed voltage management, electrical installation and commissioning activities. Whilst there is a strong focus around electrical safety, the position will also include supporting the Global HSE Manager with general HSE responsibilities in a construction environment. This position requires a blend of technical expertise, leadership, and strategic thinking to uphold the highest standards of electrical engineering safety and operational excellence.

What will you do?

Objectives of the role

Engineering for Electrical Safety:

  • Procedure: Support the Engineering Teams with development and implementation of comprehensive electrical safety protocols and guidelines.

  • Process: Regularly review and update engineering safety procedures in conjunction with other discipline leads to comply with the latest regulations and standards.

  • Resources/Equipment: Specialist input into selection / development of electrical safety gear (PPE), electrical safety manuals, compliance processes and software, training materials.

Support HV/LV Working and Commissioning Activities:

  • Procedure: Support local HSE Organizations in providing oversight and authorisation for relevant personnel / contractors, ensuring the correct application of processes. This includes surveillance of planning for, coordinating, and overseeing HV/LV commissioning activities to ensure compliance and safety. Provide hands on support upon request by Global or Hub HSE Managers.

  • Process: Ensure development and implementation of commissioning plans is properly monitored, and that competence checks, pre-commissioning checks are conducted, and ensure all activities are appropriately documented.

  • Resources/Equipment: HV/LV testing / electrical safety equipment, commissioning tools, project management software.

Manage Impressed Voltage (IV):

  • Procedure: Accountable for strategies to ensure effective management of impressed voltage during operations on or adjacent to other electrical systems.

  • Process: Conduct inhouse training, identify external training as required, support the management of IV authorisations (Earthing Control Person-ECP / Earthing Application Person-EAP), specify IV Drain Earthing Equipment requirements, ensure that IV Drain Earthing Equipment is maintained, tested and regularly inspected,

  • Resources/Equipment: Voltage monitoring devices, IV Earthing Equipment data analysis software, Processes and Procedures, associated forms and documents.

IV Management Planning:

  • Procedure: Support the local HSE / Engineering Team with specifications for external IV studies, support Engineering and Project Management with the development and implementation of comprehensive plans for managing impressed voltage including stage by stage drawings to assist project managers, ECP/EAP and site management during the installation and build stages of projects.

  • Process: Support the Engineering Team (Lead Engineer) with HAZID Reviews with respect to uncontrolled and controlled hazards associated with IV, Identify potential sources of IV, assess risks, and establish mitigation strategies.

  • Resources/Equipment: IV Processes and Procedures, Planning software, risk assessment tools, mitigation equipment.

Provide Electrical Safety Support:

  • Procedure: Offer expert advice, support and training on electrical safety issues. adherence to Client Electrical Safety Rules, Lead / Participate in electrical incident investigation (for example – short circuit, arc flash, electric shock, SF6 release, incidents).

  • Process: Conduct safety audits, risk assessments, and provide recommendations for improvement.

  • Resources/Equipment: Audit tools, risk assessment software, safety training programs.

Drive Innovation and Continuous Improvement:

  • Procedure: Identify areas for improvement and implement innovative solutions.

  • Process: Conduct regular reviews, gather feedback, and implement best practices.

  • Resources/Equipment: Innovation management tools, feedback systems, continuous improvement frameworks.

Engage with Stakeholders:

  • Procedure: Maintain effective communication with clients, contractors, and regulatory bodies.

  • Process: Regular meetings, progress reports, and stakeholder feedback sessions.

  • Resources/Equipment: Communication tools, reporting software, stakeholder management systems.

Develop Emergency Response Plans:

  • Procedure: Support project management with the development and implementation of emergency response plans for electrical incidents.

  • Process: Support drills, train staff, and review plans regularly.

  • Resources/Equipment: Emergency response kits, training materials, simulation tools.

Experience Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field.

  • Equivalent experience in electrical engineering, along with other qualifications (in HV/LV systems), may be considered in lieu of a formal electrical engineering degree.

  • · Professional certification in electrical safety or commissioning and general safety qualifications (e.g., IEC, IEEE, HVSPA, NEBOSH).

  • · Minimum [5] years of experience in electrical engineering, with a focus on HV/LV substation systems.

  • Proven track record in managing electrical engineering projects from inception to completion.

  • Extensive experience in planning, coordinating, and overseeing HV/LV commissioning activities.

  • Strong background in developing and implementing electrical safety protocols and guidelines.

  • Experience in managing impressed voltage, including training, authorisations, and equipment management.

  • Experience in maintaining effective communication with clients, contractors, and regulatory bodies.

  • Proven ability to develop and manage budgets for electrical safety and commissioning activities.

  • Experience in providing technical assistance and troubleshooting for complex HV/LV electrical systems.

  • In-depth knowledge of HV/LV systems, electrical safety regulations, and impressed voltage management.

  • Proficiency in using electrical testing and commissioning equipment.

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage and motivate teams.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to plan, coordinate, and oversee multiple projects.

  • Ability to identify areas for improvement and implement innovative solutions.

  • Ability to engage with stakeholders and maintain effective communication.

  • Strong commitment to quality assurance and compliance with standards.

About Linxon:

"Building the infrastructure to power the world"

At Linxon, we are leaders in delivering innovative EPC substation projects essential for the energy transition. With expertise from Hitachi Energy and Atkins Réalis, we provide integrated, sustainable solutions that power cities, industries, and communities. We are committed to building infrastructure that supports a carbon-free future and ensures reliable and efficient energy transmission.

Why Linxon?

By joining Linxon, you will contribute to critical infrastructure projects in the UK, driving the transition to a carbon-free energy future. We value diversity and inclusion, offering a supportive and dynamic work environment where every employee can thrive.

Diversity & Inclusion:

We encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations, and more—so whoever you are, we hope you'll see things our way too!

title: Lead Environment Consultant
jobDescription:
Overview

We are seeking an Environmental Consultant to join our growing team in this role in Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre (GTC); you will collaborate with multidisciplinary technical specialists and contribute to a diverse portfolio of projects.

Your role

  • Leading and coordinating planning and environmental consenting projects, including Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) processes and the implementation of Environmental Management Systems (EMS).

  • Provide technical support across environmental services, including Net Zero, ESG, Sustainable land resources, Ecology, and Biodiversity.

  • Act as a Technical lead on projects, ensuring high-quality delivery.

  • Engage with clients, regulators, and stakeholders.

  • Manage projects, including budgets, programmes, and resourcing.

  • Mentor and support junior team members.

About you

  • Postgraduate degree qualified in an environmental or related discipline.

  • 12+ years' experience in leading and coordinating planning and environmental consenting, Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) processes and the implementation of Environmental Management Systems (EMS).

  • Passionate, proactive, and enthusiastic about environmental sustainability.

  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, work under pressure, and maintain technical excellence.

  • Strong analytical and report-writing skills.

  • Experience in preparing bids or tenders.

  • Proven experience delivering projects from the bid stage through to completion.

  • Membership of a relevant professional body or working towards Chartered RTPI/IES/IEMA/Environmentalist/Scientist status (or equivalent).

  • Desirable Skills: Experience using digital and spatial tools, including Arc GIS, QGIS, Power BI, and spatial modelling platforms.

Reward & benefits

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.

  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.

  • Generous annual leave balance.

  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.

  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.

  • Company gratuity scheme.

  • Discretionary bonus program.

  • Relocation assistance.

title: Electrical Revit Modeller
jobDescription:
Overview

Atkins Réalis is seeking a Electrical Revit Modeller to join our Global Technology Centre (GTC) in Mumbai. Electrical Revit Modeller with 8+ years of experience delivering high‑quality BIM models and electrical design documentation for medium to large‑scale industrial, mining, petrochemical, and nuclear infrastructure projects. Highly proficient in Revit Electrical, Navisworks, Auto CAD, and multidisciplinary coordination, with strong expertise in power and lighting layouts, RCP coordination, raceways, grounding, fire alarm, and low‑voltage systems in compliance with international codes and standards. Experienced in developing 3D models, construction drawings, quantity take‑offs, and material requisitions, performing clash detection and resolution, reviewing vendor documentation, and supporting client model reviews. A reliable team player capable of working independently, mentoring junior designers, maintaining QA/QC standards, and contributing effectively within a global delivery and multidisciplinary engineering environment.

Your role

  • Directly performs work of designers and drafters, this work includes the preparation of 3D model in Revit application and preparation of layouts, study drawings, detailed construction drawings using Revit or 2D CAD software like Auto CAD and Micro Station.

  • Proficient in Equipment design and development, System design, including concept sketches and layouts.

  • Preparation or review of engineering studies and reports

  • Is responsible for the accuracy of bulk material quantity take-offs and material requisitions for materials applicable to the discipline.

  • Reviews drawings and vendor equipment documentation, both within the discipline as well as from other fields, for compliance with project requirements and actively seeks resolution.

  • Proficient in Revit modeling, including equipment, raceways, grounding, lighting power, fire alarm, and low-voltage systems. Capable of working independently to prepare layouts, schematics, and schedules in compliance with codes and standards. Skilled in reviewing and updating drawings based on feedback, ensuring accuracy and consistency in electrical documentation across 2D and 3D design environments. Experienced in developing detailed models, producing construction drawings, and supporting client model reviews.

  • Proficient in Navisworks review capabilities, as required.

  • Should be able to work independently and handle an area with team of designers/engineers.

  • Interdisciplinary check of all Civil / Structural / Piping / Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation drawings

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to lower classification piping designers.

  • Review project parameters related to MEP requirements.

  • Experience of preparing Lighting layouts with RCP coordination.

About you

Required skills and experience

  • Engineering Graduate or Engineering or Diploma with experience between 8+ Years mainly for building services, Industrial Chemical, Mining & Metallurgy and Petrochemicals multidisciplinary of medium and large size projects.

  • Thorough awareness of international codes and standards used for MEP design in the industry.

  • Shall be Capable of Producing Revit Model Independently in coordination with other disciplines.

  • Maintain suitable records of correspondence and work completed for reference and auditing purposes.

  • Able to present / represent their technical work.

  • Working knowledge of standard codes and EDMS (Electronic Data Management System).

  • Familiar with planning, budgeting, and scheduling of basic drafting tasks in designated disciplines.

  • Shows flexibility in work tasks and locations.

  • An effective and reliable team member able to apply knowledge gained.

  • Responsible for completion of specifically assigned tasks to time and cost.

Desirable skills and experience

  • Must be an advanced user of Revit & Its equivalent tools for Plant Design with capabilities to federate individual discipline models, maintain and run clash related activities for discipline models.

  • Must be able to use Navisworks to generate clash results, manage clash resolution, redline BIM Models, capture viewpoints and cascade reports to discipline teams.

  • Preparation of reports such as feasibility studies, method statements, specifications, design reports, schedules, construction drawings and bills of quantities.

Required attributes

  • High performing ability to work and integrate into multi-disciplinary teams and work independently. Ensuring your work is to the highest appropriate standards and in compliance with Atkins Réalis quality systems and standards.

  • Energetic and enthusiastic, with the desire to take on extra responsibilities and constantly upskilling team and oneself.

  • Excellent written and spoken English communication within a business environment.

  • You will demonstrate a high level of commitment, flexibility and be eager to accept responsibility and learn new skills, whilst always exercising an active interest in helping to solve problems faced by another team member.

  • You will act with integrity and professionalism, gaining the trust of colleagues and setting an example to junior staff.

Teamwork

  • Be a member of the team as well as a leader.

  • Acts in best interest of the team always.

  • Being able to understand the implication of adjusting priorities of team members.

  • Willingness to share information and knowledge with team members.

  • Willing to participate and contribute to company social activities.

  • Work together with the group rather than in isolation to promote a team atmosphere.

  • Displays appropriate levels of assertiveness.

  • Offers technical guidance to team members.

  • Demonstrates imitative and basic leadership skills to give directions in a small work group.

  • Is responsive to meeting internal and external client requirements.

  • Coaches and mentors' members of the team.

title: AVEVA E3D Administrator
jobDescription:
Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced AVEVA E3D Administrator to manage and support 3D design environments for large-scale engineering projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for administration, configuration, and optimization of the AVEVA E3D platform, ensuring seamless project execution and data integrity across disciplines.

Your role

Responsibilities

  • Administer, configure, and maintain AVEVA E3D environments for multiple projects.
  • Manage project setup, database creation, user access control, and project configurations.
  • Ensure integrity, consistency, and security of E3D project databases.
  • Coordinate with engineering disciplines (piping, structural, electrical, instrumentation) for effective model integration.
  • Perform regular backups, system monitoring, and troubleshooting of E3D-related issues.
  • Customize and manage specifications, catalogues, and templates within E3D.
  • Support design teams with technical assistance, best practices, and issue resolution.
  • Conduct quality checks to ensure compliance with project standards and company procedures.
  • Manage upgrades, patches, and integration with other AVEVA tools (e.g., E3D Design, Engineering, Diagrams).
  • Mentor junior administrators/designers and provide technical guidance

About you

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Engineering (Mechanical / Instrumentation / Civil or related field).
  • 8 to 12 years of experience in AVEVA E3D / PDMS administration. Strong hands-on experience in E3D project administration, database management, and system configuration.
  • Good understanding of 3D design workflows across disciplines.
  • Proficiency in AVEVA tools and related software environments.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective communication and collaboration abilities.

title: Lead Engineer - Plant Design Configuration Management
jobDescription:
Overview

Atkins Réalis is leading some of the most challenging nuclear projects across the globe. We are responsible to deliver complex designs through the various stages of their maturity and hence responsible to ensure robust configuration control across engineering design, digital models, and project documentation

We are looking for Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Configuration Management within plant engineering discipline focused on maintaining design integrity, traceability, and alignment across all engineering outputs throughout the project lifecycle. The SMEs should have spent sufficient time in a highly regulated process industry leading configuration management domain.

They will report into the Technical Director leading the various Projects.

Your role

  • Independently implement Configuration Management frameworks across full project lifecycle (Concept to As-Built) ensuring Single Source of Truth, Controlled data flows between systems and Proper version and revision management.
  • Develop various Configuration Management Plans (CMP) and baseline governance structures.
  • Define and manage Configuration Items (CIs) and design baselines.
  • Establish and govern engineering change control processes in coordination with the project leadership.
  • Establish configuration control as an operational discipline within projects.
  • Manage configuration across mechanical, civil, structural, electrical, and instrumentation disciplines.
  • Establish and control the design baselines (FEED, IFC, As-Built).
  • Resolve cross-discipline data inconsistencies impacting design integrity.
  • Perform multi-discipline impact assessments for design changes.
  • Strong knowledge of engineering database structures and data models, including how systems, tags, documents, and assets are interrelated so that integrated configuration management across tools such as Aveva E3D, Smart Plant, Tekla, ETAP, and EDMS is achieved.

About you

  • Suitable degree in relevant engineering discipline with domain experience in configuration management
  • Experience in Nuclear, Power, Oil & Gas or other highly regulated industrial environment preferred.
  • More than 10 years of experience in engineering services and configuration management.
  • Experience in configuration management across plant cycle, including design, commissioning, operation and maintenance of plant systems or experience in configuration management in infrastructure industry.
  • Certification in configuration management and familiarity with relevant standards is preferred.
  • Experience in laying out configuration management methodology and governance.
  • Ability to manage design changes systematically and ability to track, control, and audit the changes.
  • Proven strong problem solving, organizational and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills with a proven ability to write accurate, detailed and concise technical reports.
  • Strong teamwork skills to coordinate with multiple departments and stakeholders
  • Flexible to relocate to Atkins Réalis India Office Locations (Bangalore/Gurgaon/Mumbai) flexible in travelling to Atkins Réalis' and client's'office locations around the world, if required.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer- HVAC
jobDescription:
Overview

We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer- HVAC to join our team. This role will be based at our Atkins Realis office in Bangalore, IN.

Your role

  • To perform this role successfully, the candidate will be responsible for, but not limited to the following:
  • Undertake Mechanical design to local and International standards, including Canada, USA and UK regions.
  • Understand and apply Canada / USA and British / European and Atkins Realis standards.
  • Undertake design and Revit Modelling of a variety of Mechanical design elements i.e., Air conditioning, ventilation, tunnel ventilation, and have an understanding of plumbing and firefighting design support.
  • Carry out Mechanical calculations using Hevacomp, HAP, IES, e QUEST, Revit and other equivalent software.
  • Ensures technical governance structures and processes are adhered to.
  • Develops technical capability of team/business.
  • Promotes technical capability within business e.g. papers, case studies etc
  • Responsible for the completion of projects within his/her team to time and cost.
  • Check own and team mechanical design deliverables and be able to check design prepared within own team and other groups within area of expertise.
  • Realistically estimate pricing associated with projects within their area of expertise
  • Undertake liaison with System engineers, third parties and specialist system suppliers and incorporate their requirements in the detail design.
  • Carry out feasibility studies and prepare reports for sustainability options within the building and infrastructure services
  • Coordinate with all other disciplines and improve inter-disciplinary working with other disciplines such as Architecture, Civil and Structural.

About you

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent; Previous mechanical engineering or design role within a consultancy
  • Working towards Chartered Engineer (PEng/CEng/IEng) or be able to prove progression towards Chartership.
  • Relevant and appropriate experience of 15 years as a mechanical engineer within building services.
  • Experience of working in Multi-D'environment and good understanding of co-ordination and interfaces with other disciplines.
  • Experience of infrastructure projects with recent Healthcare building & Rail / Metro experience is preferred.
  • May have performed the role of Project Manager (PM) for small/med complex projects while maintaining essential technical input.
  • Leads and guides the teams for quality procedures on medium to large (multi-disciplinary) projects.
  • Drives right behaviors within practice for knowledge management and support PHo D or Head of Discipline Influence teams for Continuous Professional Development events and support where required.
  • Manages a team or group of teams and support for the staff development.Be a competent user of IT tools in particular Word, Excel, Outlook
  • Wider knowledge of other disciplines is desirable.
  • Authors technical reports of acceptable technical and presentational quality. Able to present their work on the project presentations and meetings.
  • Able to deliver work and integrate with larger project teams.
  • Good report writing skills, experience of making presentations to and attending meetings with clients is essential.

Mandatory Requirements:

  • Proactive and member of ASHARE or IMech E or CIBSE and working towards PEng / CEng / IEng status would be preferred.
  • Relevant and appropriate experience as a design Engineer within building services.
  • Good command of the English and French languages and an effective communicator, both written and verbal
  • You will be a competent designer to CIBSE and ASHARE standards.
  • You will have experience of computer-based design tools such as Hevacomp, HAP and IES etc.
  • You should have hands-on experience in preparing Revit 3D models, review Navisworks files and managing design delivery using BIM expertise.
  • You will have experience in Revit and have delivered projects using Revit / BIM skills.
  • Demonstrates the necessary level of competence and responsibility according to the grade.
  • You will manage productivity and quality of your deliverables.
  • Maintains harmony and a productive atmosphere by being open about the work activities and project status.
  • Good command of the English language and effective communication skills, both written and verbal. Knowledge of French is beneficial, and willingness to undertake French language training as per business requirements.

Reward & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

• Comprehensive life insurance coverage.

• Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.

• Generous annual leave balance.

• Flexible and hybrid work solutions.

• Remote work opportunities outside of country.

• Company gratuity scheme.

• Discretionary bonus program.

• Relocation assistance.

• Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

We're Atkins Réalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

title: Security Engineer – Cloud and Infrastructure
jobDescription:
Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

What will you do?

We are seeking a skilled and hands-on Security Engineer to support and strengthen cloud and IT Infrastructure security and governance. This role is a blend of cloud and core IT security controls management operations. Experience in "Identify and Access Management (IAM), Privilege Access Management (PAM), Single-Sign-On (SSO), Log Management, Incident Management Access Governance, Patch Management and Endpoint Security"

This role will play a critical part in implementing and operating security controls across the IT Infrastructure.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Implement and operate various security controls in the Cloud / IT Infrastructure environments, and security focus areas.
  • End-to-End cloud security posture management
  • Implementing, Maintaining security controls in IAM/PAM environments
  • PAM Account Management, Monitoring Credential Vaulting & Session Monitoring
  • Managing security in Azure authentication federation.
  • Security Patch Management Reviews.
  • Perform Access Certification and User Entitlement Reviews.
  • Develop and Maintain Infrastructure Security Documentation
  • Co-ordinate with SOC team for asset integration with SIEM tool, monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Co-ordinate for various security assessments.
  • Security posture and trend reports preparation.

Experience, Education and other Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field.
  • 5–7 years of hands-on experience in Cyber security in Cloud & IT Infrastructure environments
  • Strong understanding of various security & compliance standards (ISO 27001, SOC2, CSA) in cloud and IT environments
  • Knowledge of various security assessments (VA/PT, Red Team)
  • Good knowledge of SIEM and Cloud (Azure)tools.
  • Any cloud (Azure) / technical security certification is plus.

What we offer:

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits,

  • 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year.

  • Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression

title: Product Owner – AI & IT Applications
jobDescription:
Job Title: Product Owner – AI & IT Applications

Job Location: Chennai, India

Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

The Product Owner is the single point of accountability for assigned applications across Linxon's engineering, enterprise, ERP, and Saa S landscape, ensuring applications are stable, governed, compliant, and deliver business value.

The role owns the Build – Run – Own lifecycle for applications, acting as the bridge between business users, architecture, delivery, security, vendors, and operations.

What will you do?

Application Ownership

  • Act as the named Product / Application Owner for assigned systems:
    • Engineering & BIM tools
    • Project Controls platforms
    • Enterprise and Saa S applications
    • SAP ERP and support‑function tools (where applicable)
  • Own the full lifecycle from onboarding to retirement
  • Ensure clear purpose, ownership, and accountability for each application

Business Demand & Prioritisation

  • Represent business stakeholders and users
  • Translate business needs into clear, prioritised requirements
  • Balance new demand with stability, risk, and technical debt
  • Ensure applications deliver measurable value and usability

Roadmap, Backlog & Change Control

  • Define and maintain application roadmaps
  • Prioritise enhancements, fixes, and changes based on impact and risk
  • Approve or reject changes with Architecture and Security
  • Prevent uncontrolled customisation and scope creep

Architecture, Delivery & Transformation

  • Work closely with Solution Architects and delivery teams
  • Ensure compliance with architecture, integration, and security standards
  • Support application separation and migration using
    Discover → Separate → Migrate → Stabilize
  • Participate in cutovers, hypercare, and BAU handover

Stability & BAU Management

  • Own application stability and operational health
  • Work with L2/L3 teams to reduce recurring incidents
  • Plan upgrades, patches, and releases in a controlled manner
  • Improve reliability and performance over time

Vendor & Licence Coordination

  • Act as functional owner for application vendors
  • Validate usage and roadmap alignment
  • Work with SAM & Vendor Manager on renewals and optimisation
  • Prevent vendor‑driven lock‑in

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with security, IAM, data protection, and AI governance requirements
  • Support audits with clear ownership and change records
  • Identify and escalate risks with impact‑based recommendations

Required Experience & Skills

  • 6–10+ years as Product Owner or Application Owner
  • Experience owning enterprise or engineering applications
  • Strong understanding of application and Saa S lifecycles
  • Ability to balance business demand, technology constraints, and risk
  • Strong stakeholder communication and decision‑making skills

jobDescription:
Job Title: Application Security & IAM Lead

Job Location: Chennai, India

Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

The Application Security & IAM Lead is accountable for end‑to‑end application security and identity & access management across Linxon's engineering platforms, enterprise applications, SAP ERP, Saa S tools, and AI‑enabled systems.

The role ensures applications are secure‑by‑design, access‑controlled, compliant, auditable, and operable, while supporting application separation, migration, ERP transformation, and responsible AI usage.

What will you do?

Application Security

  • Own application‑level security across:
  • Engineering & BIM platforms (Autodesk, Bentley, Trimble)
  • Project Controls systems (Primavera P6, MS Project, Procore)
  • Microsoft 365 and Power Platform
  • SAP ERP (S/4HANA, ARIBA)
  • Saa S and AI‑enabled applications
  • Embed secure‑by‑design principles across the application lifecycle
  • Participate in architecture reviews and mitigate application security risks
  • Oversee vulnerability identification, prioritization, and remediation

Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  • Own IAM for all applications, including:
  • Joiner / mover / leaver processes
  • Role‑based and least‑privilege access
  • Privileged access governance
  • Govern authentication and access controls (SSO, MFA, conditional access)
  • Ensure access ownership, documentation, logging, and auditability


Saa S, Cloud & Engineering Tool Security
  • Assess security posture of Saa S and vendor‑managed platforms
  • Embed security requirements into application onboarding, renewals, and vendor selections
  • Reduce security risk from tool sprawl, unmanaged accounts, and shared access


SAP ERP & Enterprise Application Security
  • Own application security and IAM for SAP ecosystems
  • Govern SAP roles, authorizations, and access models
  • Support ERP transitions (Oracle → SAP, Workday integrations) from a security and access perspective
  • Ensure SAP security aligns with enterprise IAM and audit requirements


AI Systems Security & Regulatory Awareness
  • Support identification and governance of AI‑enabled systems
  • Ensure AI solutions implement strong access controls, logging, and accountability
  • Contribute to EU AI Act readiness through security, access, and audit inputs
  • Work with architecture and data teams to mitigate AI‑related risks


Migration, Separation & BAU Alignment
  • Embed security and IAM into:
  • Application separation from parent IT
  • Migrations, cutovers, and hypercare
  • Prevent security or access gaps during transitions
  • Support L2/L3 teams with clear security and escalation models


Governance, Audit & Risk
  • Define and enforce application security and IAM standards
  • Act as security design authority for application access decisions
  • Support audits with clear evidence of access and control effectiveness
  • Proactively identify and manage application‑level security risks


Cross‑Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with Solution Architects, Engineering Managers, Product Owners, Dev Ops, and Vendors
  • Ensure consistent security application across in‑house and outsourced delivery
  • Influence without direct line authority

    Required Experience & Skills
  • 8–12+ years in application security and IAM roles
  • Strong experience securing enterprise and Saa S applications
  • Practical IAM expertise (RBAC, MFA, SSO, least privilege)
  • Exposure to SAP application security and ERP transitions
  • Awareness of AI‑enabled systems and governance expectations
  • Strong stakeholder communication and risk‑based judgement

About Linxon

Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity.

title: Lighting Engineer
jobDescription:
Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Electrical Engineer with strong experience in lighting design, electrical building services, and UK regulatory compliance. This role involves leading lighting and electrical design packages for commercial, residential, industrial, and public-sector projects across the UK. The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of UK standards, low-carbon design principles, and modern lighting technologies.

Your role

Lighting Design & Engineering

  • Lead the design of internal and external lighting systems, including concept development, detailed layouts, photometric calculations, and controls integration.
  • Produce lighting calculations using industry tools such as Dialux, Relux, and AGi32.
  • Prepare electrical infrastructure designs including LV distribution, power layouts, containment, cable sizing, and circuit schedules.
  • Ensure all lighting designs meet UK-specific standards such as CIBSE lighting guides, BS 7671 (IET Wiring Regulations), BS EN 12464, and Building Regulations.

Technical Leadership & Coordination

  • Supervise and mentor junior engineers, reviewing drawings, specifications, and calculations.
  • Coordinate closely with architects, MEP consultants, contractors, and local authorities.
  • Contribute to design team meetings, planning submissions, and client presentations.
  • Ensure designs incorporate UK sustainability standards including BREEAM, Part L (energy efficiency), and low-carbon strategies.

Project Delivery & Site Support

  • Manage project stages from feasibility and concept design through detailed design, tendering, and construction.
  • Conduct site inspections, lighting level verification, snagging, and commissioning support.
  • Prepare technical specifications, tender documentation, reports, and cost estimates.
  • Resolve technical issues during construction and coordinate with contractors for smooth delivery.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Ensure all electrical and lighting designs comply with UK regulations, including:
    • BS 7671:2018 (IET Wiring Regulations)
    • Building Regulations Part L'and Part B
    • CIBSE LG7, LG9, LG12, and other relevant guidance
    • CDM 2015 health and safety requirements
  • Implement robust quality checks and verify design accuracy before issue.

About you

  • Provide technical guidance during the delivery, commissioning, and handover of assets.

Key areas of accountability include:

  • Provide the technical input into projects.

  • Ensure we are compliant with engineering-based regulatory requirements in their area.
  • Support the establishment of a 'Centre of Excellence for engineering.

We're looking for you to:

  • Be a recognised senior engineer in civil engineering with extensive wastewater experience in the water industry.
  • Have highly developed communication, influencing, and interpersonal skills to collaborate with colleagues and other internal stakeholders.
  • Understanding the regulatory environment required to achieve compliance with our Engineering regulatory requirements.
  • Be knowledgeable in one or more of the following, wastewater infrastructure; including rising mains, wastewater network hydraulics, infiltration management and construction
  • Deliver continuous professional development and take an active approach to developing and mentoring apprentices, graduates and civil engineers in the Water Engineering team
  • Ideally we are looking to be co-located with our team in GTC India but there will also be a requirement to visit sites in UK region's.

What We Can Offer You:

  • Varied, interesting and meaningful work.

title: Lead Environmental Consultant - Sustainability Certification & Design Senior
jobDescription:
Overview

Collaborate with key team leads in key regions (e.g., Middle East and UK) to deliver high-quality services and strengthen Atkins Réalis' reputation as a trusted sustainability partner. Skilled in communicating complex concepts to diverse stakeholders, including clients and regional leadership.

Your role

  • Lead the Sustainability Certification and Design team for Atkins Réalis in India and support the Consulting, Strategy & Advisory (CS&A) capability practice.
  • Oversee the successful delivery of projects, ensuring delivery on time, on budget, and to the highest quality.
  • Lead business development and bidding activities for the team, supporting key regional markets such as the Middle East (ME) and liaising with the UK.
  • Ensure the continued commercial success of the team and contribute towards the sustained financial performance (utilization) of the team.
  • Strengthen and expand the team's capabilities, service offerings, project pipeline, and market reputation.
  • Serve as the client-facing lead on selected projects and opportunities in key regional markets, fostering client care, maintaining existing relationships, and cultivating new ones.
  • Ensure ongoing client satisfaction and retention, driving repeat business while also developing new client relationships.
  • Degree in relevant subject matter expertise (e.g., architecture, engineering, sustainability, environment, etc.)
  • Ideally post-graduate qualifications e.g., master's degree in relevant field.
  • A minimum of 15 years of professional experience in a similar industry, within the consulting environment.
  • Minimum 5 years strong management experience, leading a team of Sustainability subject matter experts.
  • Accreditation and experience with leading sustainability standards, including LEED, WELL, Estidama, Envision, BREEAM, and Certified Energy Manager (CEM). Additional credentials such as Certified Climate Change Professional (CC-P), ISSP Sustainability Excellence Professional (SEP), SITES AP, and Certified Sustainability ESG Practitioner are highly desirable.
  • Proven leadership experience in managing large, multidisciplinary teams across diverse areas of sustainability design services (e.g., sustainability certifications, Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), carbon accounting, energy modelling, waste management, climate advisory, etc.).
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrated excellence in providing high-quality client service.

About you

  • Independently lead and manage the Sustainability team to support key regional markets, including the ME with supporting the UK.
  • Oversee project execution and task delivery, managing day-to-day operations, team utilization, and resource allocation to meet regional requirements.
  • Ensure technical excellence and high-quality outputs through rigorous review and QA/QC of team's deliverables.
  • Provide clear career development pathways for staff, monitor and track performance goals and conduct performance reviews.
  • Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentorship to team members, contributing towards raising & promoting the level of technical excellence.
  • Lead and oversee select projects and bids independently, ensuring strategic alignment and quality delivery.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across Atkins Réalis to support complex regional projects and integrated solutions.
  • Foster client retention through proactive engagement and high-quality service delivery.
  • Champion innovation and digital transformation by introducing technologies and process improvements that enhance efficiency and client value, while promoting a forward-thinking approach to sustainable solutions.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Generous annual leave balance.
  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
  • Company gratuity scheme.
  • Discretionary bonus program.
  • Relocation assistance.
  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
  • Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make. Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 4–10 years of relevant experience bachelor's degree in engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
  • A master's degree in project management or equivalent is a plus.
  • Chartered status / Professional certifications (e.g., MAPM, Prince 2 practitioner, PMP, MRICS) is an added advantage.

title: Substation Design Engineer
jobDescription:
Overview

Using your experience and knowledge, you will be a part of the delivery of a variety of projects drawing upon the wider team for the technical engineering requirements and building a strong relationship with our clients. You will be client-facing, working with the team and making sure it meets our client's'expectations.

Your role

  • You will be taking up the following RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Technical Specification preparation
  • Design basis, feasibility report , technical reports etc
  • SLDs, Layouts, sections, calculations such as bus bar sizing, short circuit force, AC/Dc schematics, Erection diagrams, clearance diagrams, General arrangement of substation
  • You should have experience of substation for 400k V and above with latest international standards such as IEEE, IEC, etc
  • Complete design calculations – LVAC & DC System Sizing, CT & VT adequacy checks, Cable Sizing etc.
  • Contribute to Tendering activities by supporting with preliminary design documentation & drawings, Bill of Quantities, Engineering Man Hour Estimates etc.
  • Providing support for bids, cost estimation, preparation of tender documents etc
  • Mentoring other engineers and help them become better engineers.

About you

  • Graduate/Post-Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering with around 5 to 10 years of experience in Design and engineering of HV substations up to 400k V or above.
  • Hands-on Experience in design substations, calculations, and FEED engineering
  • Ability to complete design deliverables – as per the Client requirement
  • Preference shall be given to those candidates who have experience with UK or USA Clients.
  • Ability to produce design documentation – Design Basis Report, Case Studies and Project Design Specification.
  • Be competent to check the design drawings & documents produced by other engineers, before the final approval by more competent engineers.
  • Member of IET & working towards Chartered Engineer accreditation.
  • Desirable – Worked in projects for UK, USA and other international regions.

Behavioural requirements:

  • Strong English Communication Skills needed to co-ordinate with client and other internal stake holders.
  • Be a part of the team which is working at different geographical locations and co-ordinate for the needs of the projects


Software & Design Tools:

  • Engineering calculations

title: Designer - Civil 3D Highways
jobDescription:
Overview

Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) Canada Business is looking to appoint a number of Highways BIM Designer's to support the delivery of complex civil engineering and multidisciplinary designs across a range of major projects.

Drawing upon a diverse skill set and a proven track record of delivery, Atkins Réalis GTC's Canada business is playing an integral role in some of the most challenging and exciting engineering projects in the Transportation realm. We pride ourselves in offering a truly multi-disciplinary capability and bring exciting opportunities to influence major projects from beginning to end. Our vision is to be the world's best Infrastructure Consultancy by leveraging BIM and embracing the digital future to bring about transformational benefits for the Transportation Engineering industry.

This key post will be based out of Bangalore where we have thriving Atkins Réalis office, which deliver to all Atkins Réalis regions across the world. Our portfolio of work continues to grow, and we will offer a challenging and rewarding opportunity to apply knowledge, experience, and problem-solving skills.

Your role

Responsibilities

  • Produce Auto CAD and Micro Station 2D drawings and other deliverables.
  • Actively contribute to project design development by contributing to internal coordination.
  • Produce all types of Highways discipline 2D Drawings and other deliverables. Perform self-assurance of all Highways discipline drawing and model deliverables.
  • Provide quality control for compliance to company/project standards of deliverables.
  • Maintain a high level of competency of all BIM software tools used at Atkins Réalis.

About you

Requirements

  • A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 4 to 6 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.
  • Must be an advanced user or expert user in Autodesk Auto CAD, Civil3D, and Bentley Micro Station with a minimum of 2 to 3 years.
  • Auto CAD experience must, detailed understanding of the CAD user interface and all its features to perform.
  • Micro Station experience must, detailed understanding of the Micro Station user interface and all its features to perform.
  • Technical proficiency in the use of the latest common CDE systems: Bentley Project Wise and Autodesk Vault.
  • Must be well versed in best practices for use of Autodesk Auto CAD, and Bentley Micro Station and other industry standard BIM platforms.
  • Track record in BIM design and coordination including multidisciplinary projects and ideally demonstrable experience within a Civil Engineering Design environment particularly the Highways domain.
  • Technical awareness/knowledge of engineering design issues including awareness of health and safety risks.

Qualifications and attributes

  • Excellent time management skills.
  • Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
  • A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 4 to 5 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.
  • Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation
  • Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues
  • Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment
  • Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers
  • Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.

title: Lead Designer / Senior Lead Designer
jobDescription:
Overview

We are seeking a Structural BIM Lead to join our GTC Canada BIM team, supporting the design and delivery of complex structural systems across various industrial projects. In this role, the candidate will manage and optimise Revit/CAD structural environments, ensuring efficient workflows, standardisation, and compliance with project and industry requirements. The candidate should have strong interpersonal, organisational and communication skills and be able to maintain BIM model quality processes.

You will be responsible for creating and maintaining symbol libraries, templates, and databases, configuring project settings, and troubleshooting software issues to enable seamless collaboration. Additionally, you will lead automation initiatives, integrate engineering design data with other platforms, and support digital delivery strategies for smarter, connected solutions. The candidate will also actively support project teams on proposal and project delivery tasks.

Ideal candidates should have a Diploma/B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering, with 7–15 years' experience delivering multidisciplinary projects, strong knowledge of Revit/CAD functionalities, Navisworks & CDE platforms, and a passion for improving design efficiency through technology and innovation.

Your role

  • Should be able to produce structural drawings and BIM model with minimum supervision.
  • Should be able to maintain BIM model quality process.
  • Should be able to share the best practice to the wider team.
  • Should have experience in understanding the coordination process with engineers.
  • Able to attend the meeting with the internal and external clients and maintaining the Minutes of meetings.
  • Should be able to mentor graduate and junior BIM engineer.
  • Coordination of CAD and BIM model input to multi-disciplinary projects.
  • Should be well versed with Auto CAD.

About you

Qualification

  • Diploma/Degree with minimum 5years of relevant experience.

Requirements

  • Knowledge of multidisciplinary and multiregional project to comply with the relevant CAD/BIM Standard.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in Revit environment for senior role and at least 5 years of experience in Revit for intermediate role.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Ability to work using engineer's calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
  • Knowledge of Building design process working within a multiple discipline engineering environment and within a project and commercially focused business.
  • Identify, Interpret, and apply required industry/client/Internal CAD/BIM standards. To ensure that our finished product is project, Client, and BIM complaint.

  • Self -motivated development.

We are seeking a Structural BIM Lead to join our GTC Canada BIM team, supporting the design and delivery of complex structural systems across various industrial projects. In this role, the candidate will manage and optimise Revit/CAD structural environments, ensuring efficient workflows, standardisation, and compliance with project and industry requirements. The candidate should have strong interpersonal, organisational and communication skills and be able to maintain BIM model quality processes.

You will be responsible for creating and maintaining symbol libraries, templates, and databases, configuring project settings, and troubleshooting software issues to enable seamless collaboration.   • Should be able to mentor graduate and junior BIM engineer.
  • Coordination of CAD and BIM model input to multi-disciplinary projects.

We are seeking a visionary and technically accomplished Principal Data Scientist to lead advanced AI/ML initiatives across the organization. title: PECC/EIA - Principal Environment Consultant
jobDescription:
Overview

We currently have an opportunity for a Principal Environment Consultant to join the Atkins Réalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) in Mumbai, India, to provide support, guidance, and mentorship to junior members of the team. The GTC PECC team primarily work on UK projects and the successful candidate will need to demonstrate knowledge and experience of UK environmental legislation, particularly in relation to Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA). Opportunities to work on projects in other regions, such as the Middle East, Canada and others, may arise from time to time.

The successful candidate will have an opportunity to work across numerous infrastructure sectors including, but not limited to, highways, rail, energy, renewables, water, and master planning. There will also be an opportunity to support the growth of wider services including Planning and Stakeholder Engagement. Experience of working across multiple sectors would be advantageous.

We are looking for an experienced individual with a proven track record of working in an Environmental Consultancy, and ideally some experience of team management. You will be able to work on your own initiative, have excellent communication skills, and strive to deliver high quality work.

Your role

  • Work with the team to maintain productivity, identify training requirements, and providing encouragement and support to enable the team to maximise its full potential.

  • Act as a key interface between the UK and India PECC teams.

  • Managing Atkins Réalis project teams.

  • Project management of a wide variety of projects ensuring delivery on time, within budget and to high technical standards.

  • Liaison with clients, stakeholders, regulators, sub-contractors and other internal disciplines.

  • Preparation of proposals and input into bids for multi-disciplinary infrastructure projects.

  • Working with the local and wider Atkins Réalis teams across the UK.

  • Providing technical support and mentoring to more junior members of the environmental team

  • Undertake Continual Professional Development in accordance with requirements of chosen professional institute and work towards becoming chartered.

About you

  • 14-17 years' experience in conducting EIA, and Environmental Desk Assessments, Environmental consenting and permitting, environmental management plans for Infrastructure projects. Field work experience will be preferable.

  • A comprehensive understanding of environmental systems and the assessment methods for EIA.

  • Commercial awareness including the ability to deliver a defined scope of work against agreed budgets and programme.

  • Lead, implement and manage all aspects of environmental assessments for infrastructure development projects in accordance with UK environmental regulations.

  • Develop commercial proposals for bids and enquiries and support junior staff to contribute to the bidding process.

  • Effectively delegate tasks and activities to intermediate and junior staff and providing technical and supervisory guidance on assigned tasks.

  • Assist with and, as necessary, taking a lead role in the development of proposals, qualification documents and other business development related activities.

  • Post Graduate Degree qualified in a relevant engineering or science subject (e.g. geology, geosciences, chemistry, environmental science and hydrogeology).

  • Organisation, collation and assessment of desk-based information as part of Desk Studies

  • Have demonstrable ability to effectively communicate environment issues, approaches and solutions pragmatically with project managers, engineers, designers, and clients.

  • Is capable of organising and managing large / strategic environmental projects.

  • Can motivate, mentor, and provide guidance to junior members of the environmental team.

  • Has excellent project management skills, including technical delivery, management of finances, client liaison and programme delivery on complex and/or multi-disciplinary projects.

  • Combines excellent organisational, technical, numerical and communication skills to demonstrate logical thinking and concise reporting.

  • Knowledge of QGIS is preferrable.

  • Excellent working knowledge and demonstrable understanding of relevant planning and environmental legislation, and technical guidance and industry standards / best practice, particularly in relation to the preparation of EIAs.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

  • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.

  • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.

  • Generous annual leave balance.

  • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.

  • Remote work opportunities outside of country.

  • Company gratuity scheme.

  • Discretionary bonus program.

  • Relocation assistance.

  • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

jobDescription:
Join Us!

We combine Atkins Réalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

The BIM Modeler – will be a member of Linxon GETS-Chennai Engineering Team and will contribute towards the effective operation of the business unit. The BIM Modeler– OPC will work on project/Tender specific activities assigned to the OPC group along with skilled team on a wide range of international T&D substation projects, classified as medium engineering complexity. Individual contributor using prior theoretical learning or knowledge of methods and technologies to execute work assignments using established solutions. The position provides design for engineering discipline across multiple engineering projects within the OPC. Complete the assignments on major projects, cost-effectively and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards. Highest quality standards are applied, and safety requirements are taken into consideration.

What will you do?

  • Independently work Auto CAD/Micro Station platform for the 2D & 3D design and detail engineering of substation Projects
  • Independently work BIM/Revit platform for the 2D & 3D design and detail engineering of substation.
  • BIM Process knowledge of PAS 1192 add advantage. Develop the tender engineering drawings in short time with quality.
  • Secure the completeness of the assigned packages and correct function of the resulting substation system.
  • Confirm the engineering is developed, taken into consideration the complete information and all inter discipline checks has been conducted, the results are documented in the project specific storage area.
  • Solves the cad/Revit issues that appear during engineering development. Report and keep records for all engineering changes.
  • Cooperate with the engineering team and agree on the project specific impacts, caused by the changes.
  • Ensure compliance with Linxon and Client engineering guidelines, standards and quality across the complete engineering process and adhere to organisational QMS
  • Creates work plans and cost estimates in own area of responsibility.
  • Contribute to the Up-to-date design issue log.
  • Safety – Understand and follow Linxon OHS procedures and guidelines.
  • Participate at CAD design and BIM Model reviews.
  • Provide input for close out report and lessons learned and follow/review lessons learned for next projects.

Experience, Education and other Required:

  • Diploma/bachelor's degree / Power Engineering.
  • Good knowledge on AIS & GIS Substation design.
  • +6 years' experience in CAD/BIM design
  • Should have executed project engineering in Revit platform
  • Hands on Experience in preparation of substation deliverables like Overall equipment layout/section, Earthing layout, cable tray, lighting, lightning protection, cable trench etc.,
  • Revit tool hands-on
  • Any site experiences would be beneficial.

title: HV substations Engineer
jobDescription:
Overview

This role involves leading and delivering high‑voltage substation engineering projects, working closely with internal technical teams and external clients. The position is client‑facing and requires strong technical expertise, project coordination skills, and the ability to ensure engineering deliverables meet international standards, quality expectations, and project timelines. You will also contribute to bid and tender activities while mentoring junior engineers.

Your role

  • Using your experience and knowledge, you will be a part of the delivery of a variety of projects drawing upon the wider team for the technical engineering requirements and building a strong relationship with our clients. You will be client-facing, working with the team and making sure it meets our client's'expectations.
  • Technical Specification preparation
  • Design basis, feasibility report , technical reports etc
  • SLDs, Layouts, sections, calculations such as bus bar sizing, short circuit force, AC/Dc schematics, Erection diagrams, clearance diagrams, General arrangement of substation
  • You should have experience of substation for 400k V and above with latest international standards such as IEEE, IEC, etc
  • Complete design calculations – LVAC & DC System Sizing, CT & VT adequacy checks, Cable Sizing etc.
  • Contribute to Tendering activities by supporting with preliminary design documentation & drawings, Bill of Quantities, Engineering Man Hour Estimates etc.
  • Providing support for bids, cost estimation, preparation of tender documents etc
  • Mentoring other engineers and help them become better engineers.

About you

  • Graduate/Post-Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering with around 5 to 10 years of experience in Design and engineering of HV substations up to 400k V or above.
  • Hands-on Experience in design substations, calculations, and FEED engineering
  • Ability to complete design deliverables – as per the Client requirement
  • Preference shall be given to those candidates who have experience with UK or USA Clients.
  • Ability to produce design documentation – Design Basis Report, Case Studies and Project Design Specification.
  • Be competent to check the design drawings & documents produced by other engineers, before the final approval by more competent engineers.
  • Member of IET & working towards Chartered Engineer accreditation.
  • Desirable – Worked in projects for UK, USA and other international

Behavioural requirements:

  • Strong English Communication Skills needed to co-ordinate with client and other internal stake holders.

  • MS Office

  • ETAP
  • Engineering calculations

• Comprehensive life insurance coverage.

Technologies: M365, MDM, Endpoint Mgmt., Vo IP, MS teams, Azure AD, AVD, DHCP, End point Patching, End point Policies, App Packaging.

Work Time: UK Shift, Mon – Fri. (Rotational on call for Critical Incidents)
